// lum gyi snying po'i las tshogs kyi le'u/༈ gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni zhes bya ba ni skye ba bdun pa'o// sngags pas 'bras sa lu'i phye ma las bya'o// gang rnams bya na mi dang sogs so// kha'i dri zhim pa ni a ,Z ḍā ki'o// sems can gang dang gang gis ni zhes pa d'i mi skye ba bdun pas kun gyi gzugs su bsgyur ro// gzhan gyis ddud 'gro'i bdun pa ni ni rang rang gi gzugs su'o drus sbal gyis rus sbal rang du sgyur nus bzhin du mi nus des 'gre // phyugs nyid kyis ni zhes pa tshig gnyis mdor bstan/ de'i yan lag man chad rgyas bshad do// yan lag lnga ni rmig ru bzhi dang rwa dang lnga'o// yudangos grub gzhan la yang sbyar ro// glang po rta dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa de dag gis kyang yan lag lnga dang spu'o// rang dga'i gzugs ni lha'o// le'u zhe dgu ba'o// //yum gyi nye snying gi las tshogs kyi le'u/༈ lnga bcu pa 'dis ni yum gyi nye snying gi las tshogs te// 'di'i 'khor lo yang don bdun las drug ni snga ma dang 'dra/ 'bri ba'i thabs ni pa V 'dab brgyad la mu khyud gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ste/ de la sngags dgod pa ni/ g.yon skor du oṃ dang*/ ba dang*/ dz+ra dang*/ bā+ai dang*/ ro dang*/ tsa dang*/ ye dang 'bri'o// lte ba la swā hā/ na ma che ge mo rgyas par gyis shig ces pa bri'o// go mang pa ni ba lang sha/ myos byed chang ngo*// lag pa g.yon pa d'i lag mchod bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i g.yon pas dbang gi thab khung gi nang du bud shing bcer nas zhag bdun du bsreg rdzas des sngags bzlas shing*/ sbyin sreg byas na/ mkhas pa'i skye bo zhes pa sangs rgyas kyang dbang du 'gyur na gzhan lta ci smros so// de bzhin rang gi lus mnyes pa zhes pas lus so// mi ngan ni bsgrub bya'i ming ngo*// myos byed changs mar tshan do la bsros pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o// des ni 'phral du 'chi ba'am skrod par 'gyur ro// sbyor sogs ni 'dod chags kyi dus su'o// wa'i sha'i sbyin sreg ni rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ste/

rigs kyi dbul ba 'jigs pa ni rus gcig pa thams cad kyi dbul po yang ngo*// phyug por 'gyur zhes pa'o// sha chen gyi sha myos byed chang*/ lha thams cad bsgom pa ni rtsa ba'i lha thams cad tshang bar ram bcu bdun no// go mang yu ba lang sha'o// 'di la rab mchog ces pa yi dam byas pa'i phan yon no// nor gyi bdag po ni rnam thos kyi bu dang 'dra bar ro// lhag pa'i tshe ni dur ba'o// sku smad ni ga gon no// mud ka ni sran mud ka'o// ma sha ya sran ma/ tsa na ka yang sran ma/ ta ma la'i 'dab ma ni dud pa rkyang pa'o// de rnams cha mnyam pa'i snag tshas dur khrod ras la 'bri zhing*/ slar phye ma de nyid kyis bkang la skud pa nag pos dkri ste bya skyogs su bcug la dur khrod du sba'o// gnas ni sa dang por rab tu dga' ba'i sa'o des 'gre'o// nang gi bdag nyid kyi sa bcu yin no// gnas la sogs pa

c rnal 'byor ma'i brda skad du bstan pa'o// kun tu phyag du mar bstan zhabs su mar ldan zhing kun tu sgra thos ldan no// de nas dngos grub bsgrub bya la sogs pa ni le'u 'og ma dang mtshams sbyar ba'i tshig yin gsung ngo*// le'u lnga bcu pa'o// //lam dang 'bras bu thams cad mjug bsdus te bstan pa'i le'u/༈ lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'dis lam dang 'bras bu thams cad mjug bsdus te bstan pa ni/ nga yis rgyud du sbas pa ni rigs pa rgya mtshor ro// gos dang zhes pa nas sngags rnams kun gyis mchod par bya yan chad kyis lam gyi mjug bsdus pa'o// de ltar de nyid ces pa nas rnyed par dka' ba'i bar gyis ni 'bras bu'i mjug bsdus pa'o// lam la rdzus skyes kyi dbang du byas na dde nyid bcu bzhi ni / gos dang zhes pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'o dbsgom zhing gcig go /phyag rgya lnga la sogs ni dag pa dlus ngag yid gsum la sogs pa'o dste gnyis so // shes rab ni phung po dbdag bsrung ba la sogs pa byin gyis rlob pa'o dgsum pa'o // yan lag phur bu tra ni srung ba'i 'khor lo dsgom pa'i thun mtshams kyi ddus su yang dgos pa'o yang ngo dbzhi pa'o // ā li kā li zhes brjod pa ni stong pa'i byang chub dbsgom pa'i kyi rkyen bsdus pa'i rkyen ddang rjes kyi dus su dal bsdus pa'i yang dmjug bsdud do ngo*// rgyu la sogs pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so ddrug pa'o // stong pa sngon 'gro ni ye shes kyis tshogs so// 'jug pa na ི'byung ba rim brtsegs nas lha bskyed pa'o dbdun pa'o / dgra la sogs pa nas ni na da la 'jug pa'o// ji srid sdud pa'i sbyor ldan nyid ni sku gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin to dbrgyad pa'o // bdud rtsi tshims byed ni dphyi'i gtor ma ddang phyi nang dgi bdud rtsi myang ba gnyis so ddgu ba'o // mya drdzus skyes kyi 'khor bsgom pa dang lus sems ni bco lnga

ngan 'das pa ni rdzogs rim mo dbcu ba'o // lag pa'i mchod pa dlag pa la mchod pa dang lag pas mchod pa ni lag mchod gnyis so dbcu gcig pa'o // dbang bskur ba dphyi'i ni slob ma ddbang bskur ba dang sgrub thabs kyi dbye ba ddkyil 'khor gyi lha la bskur ba gnyis so// go cha chen po yang dag bsrung ni mnyam bzhag dla gnyis ka rjes thob dla go cha chung ngu kyi dbye ba gnyis so dbcu gsum pa'o // sngags rnams kun gyi mchod pa yin ni phyi nang dgi tsa gi pu tsa gnyis so dde ltar bcu bzhi'o // mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na gos ni ri bo drab la sogs gnas so dsgom pa'i mjug bsdud // phyag rgya lnga dthal chen dang ni drug dang dag pa gsum mo// shes rab yan lag sna tshogs gnyis so// phur bu dra ni srung ba'i 'khor lo'o// ā li kā li ni nyi zla'i sa bon no// rgyu la sogs stong sngon 'gro ni mngon byang lnga'o// sgra ni na da las ldang ba'o// ji srid bsdus pa'i sbyor ldan ni 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang nas bzlas pa'i bar ro// bdud rtsi tshims bya drim pa bzhi'i rnal 'byor ro// lhag ma bzhi snga ma drdzus skyes bzhin no// lam rdzogs nas 'bras bu bstan pa la gnyis las/ 'das pa'i 'bras bu ni mi mchog ces pa nas sa thob kyi bar ro// 'jig rten pa'i 'bras bu ni skye dang skye bar zhes pa la sogs pas bstan no// 'di ni rtag bsgom ni bde mchog go /sa la 'dod pa ni rgyal po dang 'dra ba'o// 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i rnam rtog 'di zhes pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyis shi zer ba las rnal 'byor pa la 'chi ba med do// rgyud 'di la ma dad na skyon ni ddpal ldan nas dbul po sogs so drgyud la mos par byas te rgyan dang lha bsgom pa ni // ri ste pa ni dgzhal yas khang gi gnas so// dkar mo ni dlha mo u ma bdag po'i dbang phyug go /rdo rje dril bu'i ddang bcas pas

yum la'o d'khyud pa // nyi shu rtsa bzhi dde ltar lha bsgoms pas sku gsum thob nas gzugs skus sna tshogs yis gdul bya la thabs sna tshogs ston pa ni dpa' bo kun bcos pa nas ston pa yin yan chad kyis ston ni 'khor lo gsum gyi yum mo// phyed ldan ni de'i phyed bcu gnyis te sgo mtshams brgyad yum bzhi'o// 'byin pa ni gzugs sku gnyis so// sdud pa ni chos sku'o// dchos bsam gyis mi khyab pa de rtogs dka' bas ma smad pa ni zab mo'i chos ni zhes pa nas dka' ba bzhin zhes yan chad kyis ston // de'i sras ni byang chub sems dpa'o// bsam mi khyab chen po ni 'phel 'grib spangs zhes pa'o// bgrod pa ni lam mo// sangs rgyas kyi rol zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi ston pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo// gsang mtha' ni gsang ba 'dus pa'o// gzhan ddpal he ru ka nas bla ma yin yan chod ni rgyud kyi che ba yin te thams cad go sla'o// rdo rje 'chang mtshungs bla ma dnā ro dang*// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// gsal ba'i sgron mer byas pa 'di// bar chod med par legs par rdzogs// mar ston dchos kyi blo gros zhes kyang bya chos rgyal zhes bya yis// dam chos ri la zin bris re// byas pa yin pas 'di la'ang*// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bzod par zhes// gsung sgros bris pa ma lags pa// skya ris byas pa yod re shi// kun la yod na ngo mtshar chung*// de bas sems kyi dkyil du chongs// rtsa rgyud ṭīk+ka rdzogs so// //zang zing dsgrub pa pos 'khor ma bsdus pas bla ma dam pa bsten// 'gro ba 'khrul pa 'dren la phyag 'tshal dbla ma dam pa bstod// mkhas d shes rab can gyis pas bltas na nges shes skye ba'i rgyud// rmongs pa rnams kyis mi shes bskur ba dphrag dog che ba 'debs// mkhyen pa rnams kyis 'gro ba'i dslob ma dam tshig can don du mdzad// skal ldan rnams dang

dlas dang po pa 'phrad par shog / 141) ༄// gnyis med rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud 'grel/ pha rgyud chos thams cad mnyam nyid la gnas pa'i le'u/ ༈ rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta gu ƒ taldz+ra shrī wa ra ma hā kalbādi/ bod skad du/ dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje dpal mchog chen po brtag pa dang po'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa yi// dus gcig tshe na bcom ldan 'das// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje// rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyi ni// £ ga la ni snyoms par zhugs// gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba// gsang ba chen po 'di lta ste// de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /gsang ba pa rnams ma lus pa'i// sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje// byang chub sems kyi snying po che// chos kun mnyam pa nyid dgongs pa'i// mnyam nyid gnyis su med pa'i ba chen po ji ltar lags// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung du gsol// de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin// 'khor rnams kun la rjes brtse bas// rdo rje gsang ba kun bdag nyid// rdo rje'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa// e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// chos kyi dbyings ni snang ba che/ rang bzhin 'od gsal yongs su dag /nam mkha'i dbyings bzhinang chen rnal 'byor bla med rgyud// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// stong pa snying rje dbyer med phyir// bde chen byang chub sems mchog gsang*// de nyid dpal ldan 'dus pa ste// zab dang rgya che'i snying po nyid// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// gnyis med mnyam pa ro gcig pas// phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'di ni// thun mongir// dri med ye shes 'byung gnas gter// lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag

/rdo rje 'chang ba chen po'i yul// thabs las ma lus sangs rgyas 'byung*// 'di nyid gsang ba'i chos nyid can// sku yi gsang ba ma skyes pa// sems can lus dang snang ba khyab// gsung gi gsang ba ma 'gags pas// thams cad sgra dang dbyer mi phyed// thugs kyi gsang ba skye ba med// phyag rgya chen po lam gyi mchog /'khor 'das chos dang ro gcig pas// sbas pa gsang ba mi shes rnams// lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni// dri mas khebs pa'i rang bzhin gyis// 'gro ba lnga sogs dag tu 'khod// gsang ba'i yi ge'i don ma mthong*// ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da Z na/ pa pha ba £ ma ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ ji srid ya ra la ha'i bar// ka kha ga mtha' na dzha'i mtha'// da Z'i mtha' dang ma mthar bcas// de de rtsa ba'i yi ge gsum// thog mtha' gsang ba e dang bam̐// dus gsum rdo rje'i yi ge'i gnas// 'byung dang 'byung las ghu.ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ oṃ aḥ/ a ni skye ba med pa'i tshul// shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba// dbyangs kyi yi ge tha ma'i bar// stong nyid nam mkha'i chos rnams kyis// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung dang mchog /snying po'i yan lag dag tu bshad// thub pa chen pos chos phung po// brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa las// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i snod yin te// de bas 'di ni rgyud kyi rtsa// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rdo rje sogs// rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa ni// snying po kun las 'di bsdus yin// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po'i gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// // rdo rje gsum bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'das te bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog rnams kyis// nges par bgrod pa'i lam gyur pa// rdo rje'i gsung gis bka' stsal don// bsgrub bya sgrub byed don bshad gsol// ces gsol ba btab pas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos ji lta bar mkhyen cing thugs su chud nas/

bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad kyi sgo la 'jug pa ngo bo nyid med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa'i// chos kyi dbyings ni spros dang bral// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ni// rang 'byung dag par 'char ba yin// rnal 'byor rnams la dngos grub kyi// 'bras bu nyams snang sna tshogs pa'o// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'byung*// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa// phrin las dag pa'i stobs su 'char// de nyid gzhan du mi rnyed de// shes rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir// 'brel pa can du brjod par bya// khyad par chos ni brtag dka' ba'o// stong gsum zhing 'di sprul pa yi// dkyil 'khor rgya che 'jig rten khams// gsal ba dri ma med pa ste// dag par rang 'byung ngo bo nyid// sna tshogs chos nyid gcig pa las// kun tu khyab pa dga' ba'i gzugs// rang bzhin sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sku// spro bsdu'i sprin gyis kun tu khyab// phyogs bcu 'od kyi phreng ba yi// snang bas rgyas pa 'phro zhing 'khrugs// gsal dang gsal min gnyis ldan pa'i// rin chen pa V gis// 'dod dang thar pa rab bsgrubs pas// dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur// dag dang ma dag gyur pa rnams// 'dir ni rigs la gnas pa ste// rags dang phra ba'i cha brten pas// lus sems chos ni rab tu dbye// lus ni nam mkha' lta bu ste// sems ni sgyu ma'i rnam par 'byung*// ngag ni brag cha lta bu ste// dbyer med rdo rje lhan cig skyes// rten dang brten par dbyer med pas// thams cad chos nyid sems la gnas// sems can sangs rgyas gnyis su btags// snod bcud snang ba'i yul rnams dang*// brtan g.yo khams gsum rang rig pa// srid gsum ma lus chos nyid de'i// snang ba gzugs dang sgra la sogs// dri dang ro dang reg bya dang*// thams cad chos nyid bag chags 'byung*// rgyu las 'bras bu bskyed pa'i phyir// gcig las du ma'i chos kun shar// du ma nyid du dmigs med de// thams cad stong phyir ma skyes pa'o// de skad ces gsungs pa dang*// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la sogs pa rnams rab tu dga' zhing yi rangs te/ bde ba dang yid bde ba bla na med pa thob nas lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje la rab tu gnas par gyur nas ched du rjod pa 'di ched du brjod do// e ma'o rang lus sgyu mar grub pa dag /nam mkha' lta bur skye ba med// dbang po'i gzhu dang mtshungs pa nyid// stong pa nyid ni rdo rje'i sku// lus ni rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// dag pa chen po ye shes lus// ngag ni brag ca'i sgra dang mtshungs// brjod pa'i dus na stong pa ste// pi wang sgra bzhin rten 'brel gyis// rang grags brjod pa tha snyad tsam// sems ni rang 'byung dag pa la// ye shes chen po rang gnas nyid// rgyu rkyen tshogs pa bral ba las// snang ba tsam du'ang mi gnas pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos chos thams cad la zab pa'i tshul la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs nas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje bla na med pa'i don bka' stsal pa/ ma skyes mi 'gag rol par gang 'byung ba// byang chub sems ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med ston pa'i sku// sgyu 'phrul rgyal po bde chen 'di nyid de// chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// mtshan ma med cing mi 'gyur 'ja' tshon ltar// gnyis med gnyis su med min mnyam pa'i sku// shin tu dri med nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// hūm̐ badz+ra _ི ka/ ¨áཾ dzi na dzika/ trāṃ ra* _ྀka/ hrīḥ.a ro lika/ khaṃ pradzñā _dz+ra ra ti/ ya ya māj krita/ ma pradzñā j krita/ ta paVÉj krita/ ka bigh+nāj krita/ rdo rje rin chen paV dang*// 'khor lo bsnams pa'i 'od 'phro ba// dkyil 'khor rdzogs tshul lha rnams kun// yab yum bde ba nyid du bzhugs// dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rdo rje gsum bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/// /

dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dang*/ gsung rdo rje dang*/ thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis chos thams cad las rnam par rtog pa med cing rdul med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ 'khor 'dus pa rnam tu 'da' dka' ba'o// mkha' dang mtshungs pa mnyam 'gyur pas// rnam par mi rtog ngo bo nyid// chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa las// yang dag sku ni rab tu 'byung*/ oṃ swa

£É ba shud ZÉཿsarba Zrmāḥswa £É ba shud Zོ±haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud ZÉཿsarba Zrmāḥyo ga shud Zོ±haṃ/ oṃ shū ‚ tā dzña na badz+ra swa £É ba ā/ ko±haṃ/ dag pa'i sngags kyi sgra rnams dang*// sngags dang rlung du sbyar ba nyid// rang bzhin dag pa'i ye shes lnga// chos rnams yi ge stong par brjod// rdo rje mi bskyod rgyal mchog ni// zhe sdang can gyi gdul bya la// rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis// gtum zhing gdug pa thams cad 'dul// dkon mchog dpal gyi rgya chen gyis// nga rgyal can gyi gdul bya rnams// rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis// ser snas 'ju+ungs pa thams cad btul// tshe dpag med kyi 'od byed kyis// 'dod chags kyis ni bcings pa rnams// paV rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis// srid pa can gyi gdug pa btul// thogs med grub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis// shin tu phrag dog che rnams la// las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis// sems can ma rungs las can btul// sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor yangs pas ni// rmongs dang ma rungs mche ba can// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /gti mug mun par tshud rnams btul// dkyil 'khor lnga yi sbyor ba yis// de nyid rigs ni lnga ru bshad// shin tu bsdus pa'i sbyor bas ni// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ye shes mchog /khru ni bcu gnyis tshad mnyam pa// ngos bzhi dag la mnyam pa yis// bcu gnyis sa ni mngon rdzogs pas// bcu gsum pa la gnas pa yin// gsung gi dkyil 'khor bla na med// khru ni nyi shu mnyam pa ste// ngos re la yang lnga lngar brjod// rlung bcu sngags bcur gnas pa ni// blo gros ldan pas shes bya ste// de brjod pas ni mchog tu brjod// sku yi dkyil 'khor khru bcu drug /ngos rer bzhi bzhir ldan pa las// bden pa bcu drug rtogs pa yis// ye shes skad cig de snyed do// mi bskyod rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// tshe dpag med pa'i snang ba dang*// rdo rje rtag pa chen po ste// bsdus pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje// lus ngag yid ni rnam dag phyir// yang dag don du snang ba'o// gcig nas gsum dang rigs lnga ste// dgu dang bcu gsum nyi shu lnga// sum cu rtsa gcig bar dag tu// rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dag tu 'gyur// rigs lnga dag las 'byung ba ni// de re nyi shur dbye ba yis// phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid las// nyi shu rtsa lngar yang dag pas// dam pa'i rigs ni brgya ru 'gyur// de bzhin gshegs tshogs mtha' yas pas// 'dus pa chen po 'dir brjod byas// rnal 'byor pa rnams shes par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ngo bo snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla na med par bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o//

// phyag rgya chen po don sgrub pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// thams cad chos ni ston pa la// gsang ba chen po rnam par rgyal// rgyud 'di yang dag ston par mdzad// rdo rje dam tshig gsum grub mchog /sku gsum rdo rje can du 'gyur// phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi// yid bzhin nor bu rgya mtshor gyur// phung po lnga rnams sangs rgyas sku// de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid can// sra ba sa yi khams yin te// zhu ba chu yi khams su 'dod// dro ba me yi khams yin te// rgyu ba rlung du rab tu bsgrags// mi shigs pa ni thig ler gsungs// bde ba nam mkha'i khams yin no// gzugs ni thogs par bcas pa ste// tshor ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// 'du shes dmigs par bcas pa ste// 'du byed lus ngag yid sbyor ba// rnam shes sgyu mas don sgrub byed// reg pa las ni sa yin te// lha mo na du shes par bya// dro ba me ru rab tu grags// gos dkar mor ni shes par bya// sdud par byed pa chu yin pas// mā ma kī yi ngo bor 'gyur// 'gro ba'i bya ba bskyod pa rlung*// sgrol ma'i ngo bor brjod par bya// thig le snang byed bde skyong ma// bde ba rdo rje reg bya ma// de nyid bde chen ye shes ni// skad cig tsam du nyams myong bas// 'phral du yid ches byed yin te// log rtog ma lus 'joms pa po// dngos dang dngos med log rtog dag /bgags nas rnam par mi rtog pas// bskal pa stong phrag du mar yang*// gnas nas ye shes sbyor bar byed// de yang cung zad goms byas pas// gong nas gong du khyad par 'gro// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad la rang bzhin gyis byin gyis brlabs pas yang dag pa'i ye shes khyad par du gyur pa bla na med pa las mngon du gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do// gang dang gang gis 'ching ba rnams// de nyid shes pas grol gyur te// 'di la nges par 'khor ba yi// rgya mtsho'i nang nas dri med 'thob// sems can rnams kyi ye shes kyis// rgyud ni nges par grol 'gyur pa// khyad par las ni rtogs pas na// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas gnas su 'gro// gang du yang dag bla ma yi// drin gyi ye shes yan lag bdun// phra ba'i yon tan mngon du byed// sku gsum dbyer med la phyag 'tshal// 'di ltar gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa// tshe 'dir 'bras bu thob pas na// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas pas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs// ring na bzhugs kyang gzigs 'gyur te// don kun sgrub par byed pa'o// dga' dang dga' bral dag gi dbus// mtshan nyid dmigs pa brtan par gyis// thun nam zla phyed zla ba lo// bskal par ye shes che la sbyor// mi rtog pa yi ting 'dzin gyis// sgrib pa rang dag lhun gyis grub// bde ba chen po mngon byas pas// stobs sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan// dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis// dngos po thams cad brtag par bya// de las byung ba'i thabs bstan pas// bde ba'i khyad par 'byung bar 'gyur// rgyu yi yan lag bdun 'byung ba// bla mas brten pa'i rten 'brel gyis// ye she+ugs// kha sbyar e bam̐ rnam pa gnyis// thabs dang shes rab rtsa yi gnas// bde ba chen po thig le yis// 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes can// snying rje chen po tshad med bdud rtsi'i rtsa// rgyun mi 'chad par bde ba'i byang sems 'bab// phrin las stobs ni gzhan don thogs pa med// de dag don du yang dag rang bzhin med// stong nyid rtogs pas dngos la chags mi 'gyur// 'di ni rgyu yi dus zhes bya ba ste// lam gyi dus ni dbang gi ye shes te// mtshan ldan rig ma yongs su dag pa la// sa phyogs gtsang zhing rab tu dben pa'am// rgyal nyid skyes gzhi zhi ba'i gnas rnams su// bshang gci chu la sogs pa byug pa'am// rgyal ba mchod phyir rtag par rab tu bya// nu ma'i da bu'i yan lag bdun ni tha mar brjod// rang byin brlabs pa'i lam gyis gang thob pa// mtshungs med 'dren pa bla med ngo bo nyid// nus pa brtan dang rdzogs pa mngon gyur pa'o// rdo rje gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang*// gnas ni gnas kyi rnam par bsgom par bya// sngags kyi mtshan gyis shin tu mtshan spras pa// cho ga 'di yis bsgrub pa nyid du bya// 'grub pa'i 'bras bu nus pa brtan pa yis// tshe 'dir skad cig gcig gis rdzogs byang chub// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi'o//

//phyag rgya chen po nges par 'byed pa'i le'u/༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la gzigs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi don gyi phyir yang dag par snang ba'i ye shes rnam par spro ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te gsang ba 'di lta bur gsungs so// 'khor ba dag la mi gnas pa'i// ye shes rdo rje khyod nyon cig /dngos po dngos min dang bral ba// dngos po gnyis ka spong ba ni// gnyis su med pa'i chos zhes bya// dag dang ma dag spang byar med// gzugs dang stong pa'i bar du yang*// dbus su mnyam par gnas pa yis// gtsang dang mi gtsang dbus su ni// ma 'dres pa de mnyam par sbyor// rten dang brten can dbus su ni// mnyam pa nyid kyis rgyal bar 'byung*// lus ni mnyam par gnas pa dang*// ngag dang sems kyang mnyam gyur pas// mnyam par lta ba mthong ba rnams// ye shes mnyam par rnam par rgyal ba zhes gsungs so// kun tu bzang po sems dpa' che// ji ltar mnyam par lta ba dang*// gnyis su med pa'i chos dag ni// bdag gis ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// ye shes rang bzhin gnyis med chos// du ma ma yin gcig min te// gsang ba'i rim pa bla na med// dang po las kyi rnal 'byor gyis// lam gyi rim pa rab sbyor bas// cig car 'jug pa phyag rgya che// zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa nyid// bde ba chen por rtogs par bya// chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pa ni// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun// ting 'dzin ro mnyam rdo rje yis// gsang chen gnyis med rgyal ba 'dir// gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung*// mi shigs thig le'i ngo bo nyid// rang lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin la// bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis// sa lam rdzogs tshul lugs 'byung dang*// lugs las bzlog pa rim min pas// rgyud du sbas pa rnams gsal ba// de nyid nges par bstan pa ni// tshe 'di nyid la mngon sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag shin tu rmad du byung ba'i tshul zab mo la ngo mtshar skyes te slar gsol pa/ ye shes thob pa'i lus can dag /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas pa// 'di nyid rnal 'byor ji lta bu// mi gtsang lus las ji ltar 'gyur// rnam rtog ngan pa'i bag chags kyis// dri mas bslad pas 'di ma mchis// de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje 'chang gis der bstan pa// dri ma bag chags bzlog bya'i phyir// lam gnyis rang gi gsang ba'i chos// 'dir ni rtog pa ngan pa'i tshogs// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i chos// rnam rtog bag chags nyes pa yis// 'gro ba gsum po rnam rmongs la// blo dang ldan pas legs bltas te// rnal 'byor rgyud ni sbyang bar bya// bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni// slob ma yongs su smin byas shing*// ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa yis// cig car lam gyis stobs kyis ni// 'dir ni yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// goms pa chung ba'i stobs kyis ni// yon tan mthun snang ma gyur te// dri nga'i lus ni rgyal ba'i sku// sems ni dri med pa V la// skyon gyi 'dam pas ma gos so// ji ltar 'dam pa'i lus dag las// ye shes lus ni rang dgar 'byung*// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor lam// rdzogs pas gnas lugs mngon byas te// ye shes sbyor bas rnam sbyangs pas// shin tu dri med dag par 'gyur// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin te// thabs kyi myu gu dag gis ni// baqà ka ni rgyas pa bzhin// sbrang rtsi bdud rtsi'i gnas yin te// yon tan dri med de nyid kyi// me tog rgyas pa'i chu skyes pa'o// rdo rje theg par sbas pa yi// rnal 'byor mngon par sangs rgyas pa// bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs pa las// spros bral mtha' dang bral ba'i chos// sgom pa'i lam zhes sa rnams bgrod// skad cig ye shes 'char tshu bzang po la sogs pa rnams bde ba dang*/

yid bde ba dang dang ba khyad par can thob nas stan las langs te/ phyag dang bskor ba du ma byas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do// e ma'o rang 'byung rgyal ba'i gzhi// rdo rje theg pa gsang ba las// phyi ma'i dus na gang byung ba'i// rnal 'byor pa rnams de bzhin gshegs// shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la// snyigs ma lnga ldan dus dag tu// rdo rje'i theg pa gang 'dzin pa// de dag sangs rgyas sras nyid 'gyur// rdo rje sku gsung thugs la nges gnas pas// byang chub sems mchog rnams la rtag mchod byed// ces gsungs te/ me tog gi char chen po mngon par phab nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la mngon par gtor to// rab tu gtor to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las phyag rgya chen po nges par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga ba'o// // ting 'dzin bla na med pa mchog tu bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// thams cad nam mkha' mi 'gyur che// gsang ba 'dzin pa thams cad la// mchog ni ston phyir yang dag bzhugs// e ma'o gsang ba'i gnas kyi mchog /e ma'o snying po kun bsdus pa// e ma'o chos kyi gnas zhi ba// e ma'o rdo rje rnam par rgyal// ston ka'i nam mkha' sprin med pa// zla ba'i 'od zer kun gsal ltar// gzung 'dzin spangs pa'i ye shes ni// bdag gzhan bcas pas snang ba'o// ston dus sprin med nam mkha' la// nyi ma gsal bar shar ba bzhin// thabs kyi ye shes gnyis pa ni// don dang sems bcas snang bar byed// sprin med mkha' dang mun lta bu// snang byed ye shes goms byed pas// rang rig rtsal las grub pa yi// sgyu ma'i lus ni len par byed// de yang yid kyi lus ldan pa'i// rnal 'byor pa yis khams gsum du// bdag dang gzhan gyi don byas nas// mthar ni rang gnas bde bar 'gro// sgyu ma'i lus tsam la brten la// ril por 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gis// dngos po thams cad bcom nas ni// de nas dag pa'i ngang du gnas// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyis// snang ba thams cad nub byas nas// rang 'od rig ma dbyings kyi dang*// snang ba'i ye shes khyab par 'gyur// bdag dang gzhan du rtog pa yi// rnam rtog dra ba bsal nas ni// bdag med dmigs pa med pa ru// mnyam nyid ye shes khyab par byed// snang ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// snang ba tsam yang 'dzin med par// yang dang yang du don dam pa'i// bden pa mngon du byed pa can// 'ja' tshon lus kyis 'bad med pa'i// 'dod pa thams cad nam mkha' las// 'bad med par ni stsol 'gyur te// bdag dang gzhan rnams bde ba'i 'tsho// rdo rje 'od kyi lus bzung nas// bdag dang gzhan don sgrub 'gyur la// dmigs pa thams cad zad byed pas// bgrod med gnas su bde bar 'gyur// rang 'od ye shes ldan pa'i sku// 'ja' tshon bzhin du mtha' mi dmigs// stong pa gsum la 'das pa po// thogs med snying rje 'byung bar 'gyur// dang po sa ni chu la thim// chu yang me la thim 'gyur te// me ni rlung la thim gyur nas// rnam shes bzung pa de nyid ni// 'od gsal bar yang 'jug par 'gyur// dang po sgyu ma lta bu la// dang po smig rgyu de nyid kyang*// 'od zer lnga dang ldan par mthong*// gnyis par zla ba lta bu dang*// gsum par nyi ma lta bu dang*// bzhi par mun pa lta bu la// lnga pa sprin med nam mkha' las// mi rtog mtha' dbus med par 'char// stobs dang mi 'jigs la sogs pa'i// che ba'i yon tan rnams brgyan pa// bden gnyis sbyor ba zung 'jug sku// bde ba chen po nges thob 'gyur// mkha' 'dra chos sku stong pa las// rtog med ye shes mkha' 'dra ba// tshams ni 'dul bar 'gyur// lhun grub bde ba chen po'i sku// rang snang rig mas nyer brgyan pa'i// 'og min gnas su dus rtag tu// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bas bzhugs// yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po ltar// 'bad med bdag dang gzhan gyi don// che ba'i yon tan rnams kyis brgyan// bde ba che las de 'byung 'gyur// rim pa thams cad kun rdzogs pa'i// mnyam pa nyid du gnas sems kyis// khams gsum pa rnams 'jig byed pa// thams cad nam mkha' bzhin du gnas// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po'i gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las ting nge 'dzin bla na med pa mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o//

//dngos grub mchog tu bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// byang chub sems kyi rdo rje che// dbyer med bde ba ston pa pos// gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to// mnyam nyid ye shes stong pa yis// bdag nyid gzugs ni sbyang bar bya// mnyam nyid gnas pas thams cad du// ye shes can gyis sgom gyur pa// 'jigs pa kun las thar bar 'gyur// gsang ba'i yi ge bder gyur pa// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen ni// sems can kun gyi lus la gnas// de nyid ye shes snang ba po/ ko ta

‹/ ko ta wa/ ko ta ‹ wa Z/ ko ta ba sha/ ku ti Z ri/ ko la ‹/ ko la wa/ kol lo wa/ ko la wa shu/ ko la tā\/ gnas bcu sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni// thabs dang lam gyi khyad par sku gsung thugs// lta ba sgrub pa ོda tshul bla na med// 'bras bu byang chub sems kyis dbang bsgyur bas// stobs bcu rdzogs pa gang yin rnal 'byor che// snying po 'di ni rgyud rnams kun tu sbas// dngos por 'dzin pa'i sems can rnams// dngos po'i rnal 'byor 'jig 'gyur ba'i// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par// paV'i gdan dag bsam par bya// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par// gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor can// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dag /rgyal po rol pas bsam par bya// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams la// ye shes chen po'i dngos grub gsol// 'khor lo 'di ltar bsgoms pa yis// shes rab 'bar ba'i lus su 'gyur// 'od zer 'bar ba ma bu ru// dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya// mchod pa'i mtshan nyid yongs ldan par// stong pa nyid du mnyam gnas pas// gnyis su med pa rnam rgyal ba// lhag pa'i lha ni bskyed bya ste// 'khor lo 'di ni bsgom par bya// mnyam par bzhag nas bsgoms pa yis// 'grub par 'di la the tshom med// mnyam med sngags ni bzlas nas su// sgrub po dang*// gcig nas gcig tu ldog 'gyur te// ya yi don gyis gang yang rung*// dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba ni// ra la sogs pa gsum po nyid// rim pas 'gro don la 'jug bya// me dang rlung dang dbang tshon dang*// chu ste so so'i dkyil 'khor du// thun ni phyed phyed dus su ni// las ni gnyis gnyis gnas par 'gyur// mchomed// dngos po'i rang bzhin gang med de// byang chub rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan// byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang*// ye shes ldan pas zhus pa'i don// dam tshig de nyid ston pa po// thams cad mkhyen pas 'di skad gsungs// sku gsum mi phyed dkyil 'khor du// yid 'ong phreng ba kun bsdus pa// rdo rje'i bzlas pa ye shes che// bla na med pa'i thabs mchog las// rdo rje sku yi bzlas pa yis// sangs rgyas skur ni byin gyis rlob// mnyam med ye shes thob pas na// rdo rje gsung gis ngag byin rlob// nam mkha'i rang las rang byung ba'i// thugs kyi rdo rje sems nyid kyis// gnyis med ye shes rtogs gyur pas// zab dang rgya che'i tshul gnas pa'o// 'dir ni rtog pa rnams spangs te// brtan pa dang ni myur 'gro nyid// de bzhin khyi dang ba lang dang*// srog song mi ste ba lang chen po'i sha// sna tshogs sha yi sbyor ba dang*// khu ba dang ni rak+tar bcas// mi bskyod pa dang snang mdzad dang*// go ro tsa na snying ga nas// gang byung gh+ri taṃ stobs ldan pa// sgo dgu las ni gang byung dang*// srog chags yan lag lus las byung*// rdo rje kha sbyar rdzas bcu dang*// rdo rje can gyi myos byed ldan// rim par sbyar ba skye bdun sha// gang las rnyed pa stobs mchog las// ril bu tsa na ka yi tshad// sbyar te zos par gyur na ni// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje can kun mnyes par byed// byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams// thugs rjes dgongs te gzigs 'gyur te// gtso bo gzi can mdangs ldan pa// 'dzam bu'i chu bo 'od 'drar 'gyur// mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len// rkang mgyogs mig sman sa 'og dang*// ral gri ro langs bum pa dag

/sbyor ba 'di yis 'gyur bar gsungs// dngos grub kun gsol dam pa yi// ye shes rgya mtsho nges 'thob bo// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dang dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las dngos grub mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang bar bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes chos thams cad zhi ba'i dam tshig gi mchog bla na med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa rdo rje dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba grub pa la sogs thams cad dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor 'dus pa chen po rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje nyid// ye shes snying po nam mkha'i dbyings// chos rnams kun gyi snang ba po// zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i// dkyil 'khor chen po bstan du gsol// zhes gsol ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis ye shes kyi snang ba'i tshul las byung ba 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ba ni rdo rje dkyil 'khor ye shes las grub pa kun tu snang bar byed pa mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od kyis khyab pa bkod pa tshad med pa'i phrin las yon tan thams cad rab tu 'byung ba'i gnas rin po che sna tshogs 'dus pa las rang byung ba/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs rim pa du mas mdzes pa/ rdul med cing rnam par dag pa'i ye shes las byung ba/ sgo phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ pho brang nang du ni dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i ka bas bteg pa/

rdo rje rin po che'i gdung gis bcad pa/ dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga rab tu gnas pa/ khyams phyi ma'i bar du ni dkyil 'khor drug dang*/ bar chad srung bar byed pa 'byung po kun 'dul dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor ro// mtshams bzhir ni 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor te bar bar du ni sangs rgyas stong mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bla na med pa 'thob pa'o// rin po che sna tshogs du ma'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyar ba/ ye shes lnga'i rtsig pas 'khor yug tu kun tu 'khor ba/ sgo bzhi blo 'bur du snang ba/ phyi nang med par gsal ba/ so so'i bye brag gi dkyil 'khor ni rgyas shing yangs la rnga ma dang mda'apo// nub tu 'jam dbyangs 'phags pa na ras gzigs// byang du sgrib pa rnam sel kun tu bzang*// mtshams kyi grwar ni gzugs sgra dri ro bzhi// phyogs kyi sgo skyong khro rgyal chen po bzhi// phyi rol mtshams bzhir mi g.yo mgon po dang*// 'dod pa'i rgyal po stobs chen dbyug sngon can// steng phyogs gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang*// 'og phyogs gnod mdzes rgyal po ste// lhor ni gsang ba'i bdag po dang*// byang du tshangs pa chen po'o// mtshams su 'jig rten skyong rnams ni// shar lhor yul 'khor skyong ba la// lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*// lho nub 'phags skyes po la yang*// gza' chen brgyad bcas gnas pa'o// mig mi bzang ni nub byang du// klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'o// byang shar rgyal chen rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin chen po brgyad ces pa'o// lha srin sde brgyad yongs kyis ni// tshangs pa'i rgyal po yongs su bskor// gsang ba'i bdag po chen po la// lag na rdo rje drag po'i tshogs// brgyad ces 'jig rten gsum 'dus te// 'di dag rnam par bshad pa'o// sangs rgyas stong phrag gcig ni khyams su bkod pa dag

/shar phyogs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang*// mngon dga'i zhing khams shel gyi 'od du 'bar// lho phyogs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang*// rdul dang bral ba bai ḍū 4 yi 'od// nub phyogs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga po// bde ba can zhes paV rā ga'i 'od// byang phyogs rnga sgra sgrogs pa gser gyi mdog /nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lngar yod pa dag /nyi shu dag ni rnam pa mtshon phyir gnas// rim pas phyogs su gnas pa dag /rgyas pa' dbye bas 'di bzhugs pa'o// dkyil 'khor dam pa bla med gzhal yas khang*// rten dang brten pa mnyam med chos kyi dbyings// dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa rnam gsal ba'i// rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams dang spros pa dag /'jig rten 'das pa'i sangs rgyas stong bzhugs shing*// 'jig rten mgon po lag na rdo rje dang*// tshangs pa mi mjed bdag po la sogs te// rgyud 'di la ni smin par byed pa'i dbang*// dkyil 'khor chen po khru ni brgyad cu bar// ngos re zhing ni nyi shur mnyam par brjod// rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sum cu gcig /de dag re re la yang de nyid kyis// rim bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor ro// thub pa'i dbang pos 'dir ni gsal bar bstan// lag na rdo rje'i 'khor dang rdo rje yi// drag po'i rnam par khro bo brgyad bkod pa'o// rdo rje gtsug tor rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*// rdo rje drag po rdo rje stobs nyid de// rdo rje rnon po be con rdo rje mche ba'o// rdo rje 'jigs byed tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// tshangs pa'i rgyal po'i 'khor du bstan pa ni// lha yi dbang po brgya byin rdo rje can// gnod sbyin rgyal po ra* ku be ra// ljon pa rta mgo gtsug na rin chen bcas// thags bzang ris dang mkha' lding rgyal po dang*// srin po'i rgyal po dri zar bcas pa'o// 'di dag gsal bar nges par mtshon pa ste// snying po bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid de// cho ga phra mo rim pa ji bzhin du// mdo rgyud rtogs pa rnams las rnam par rgyal// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dkyi+il 'khor chen po gsang bar ston pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o//

// mchod pa dang gsang sngags mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa de dag thams cad rang gi ba spu'i bu gar thim par mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rnam par rgyal ba 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang gi gzugs rnams bud med kyi gzugs su byin gyis brlabs nas de nyid kyi ba sbu'i bu ga rnams las 'thon par gyur to// de'i phyir btsun mo thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che'i mchod pa thams cad bkod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa chod par byed do// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la gnas pa 'di thams cad kyi sngags dang*/ bla na med pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*// oṃ āḥbadz+ra _ིka hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi sngags so// oṃ āḥbadz+ra spa7ེ hūṃ swā hā/ rig ma bla na med pa'i sngags so// oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ aṃḥr* _ིka hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro li ka hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ā pradzñā _dz+radz+ra rū pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghin Zེ hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā se hūṃ swā hā/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'o// oṃ āḥbadz+ra mai tri nā tha shri ye hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥk+ṣi ti ga2Ê ya hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇa ye hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ā kā sha ga2Ê ya hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ā4 ba lo ka te shwa rā ya hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥmañdzu shrī gho ṣā ya hūṃ swā hā/

oṃ āḥsarba ni ba ra ṇa biUཾ £ི ne hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥs maj £ drā ya hūṃ swā hā/ sems dpa' chen po rnams so// oṃ ā ya māj kṛ ta hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥpradzñāj kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpaVj kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbigh+nāj kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.ā4 a tsal hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.uṣatsi ṣa tsakra brti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥsuṃ £ rā dza hūṃ phaṭa ces khro bo'i rgyal po bcu'i sngags rab tu gsungs so// sngags 'di rnams kyi nus pa ni// thogs pa med pa nyid yin te// 'byin dang sdud par byed pas na// gsang ba'i sngags 'di legs par sbas/ zhes gsungs so/ oṃ shū ‚ tā dzñā na badz+ra swā £ ba ā/ ko±ba tu bskor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas thams cad bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gsang ba 'di gsungs so// thams cad lus la gnas pa rdo rje'i sku// mi chod mi shigs rang byung phra ba'i gnas// rtog pa'i rlung tshogs 'byung ba'i ngang du dag /rang rig sems ni gar yang g.yo mi 'gyur// rtsa yi 'khor lo bcu la gnas 'gyur gang*// rlung bcu 'od kyi snang bas khyab byed cing*// mi shigs thig le rab tu dang ba yi// bdud rtsi rab rgyas snang ba khyab byed pa'o// yi ge sgra yi rnam pa gar yod par// dran pa skyed byed srog gi rtsa bar 'gyur// kun la khyab byed snying po ye shes rlung*// rten dang brten pa mnyam gnas rin chen sems// gser dang gser 'od rab 'bar mtha' yas bzhin// ji ltar rgya mtsho rab dngas rgya che la// zla zer 'od kyis khyab cing snang ba dang*// nyi shar mdangs kyis snga phyi med par 'byung*// rtog pa med cing mun pa rang sar dag /blo yis snang ba rab tu rgyas par gyur// gang du lus can rnams kyis ni// 'byung dang byung las gyur pa yi// dngos pos snang ba bcings pas na// yid kyis lus ni brtag dka' bas// sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor ni// de nyid shes pa'i dkyil 'khor te// 'di ni bsgrub pa de nyid yin// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur da// rnam shes sgyu ma'i ye shes lus// yongs su rdzogs par rang byung ba// de nyid mi shes byis pa rnams// slar yang 'khor ba'i gnas pa'o// ji srid 'od gsal gnas kyi nus// 'byung ba thim 'gyur rtog pas stong*// de srid sgyu ma phra ba'i lus// rlung dang rnam shes ldan pas ni// 'byung dang 'jug dang gnas par byed// gzugs ni dngos por ma grub pas// thogs med rgyu zhing mtshungs par ldan// 'on kyang byin rlabs nus pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las// btsun mo'i £ ga der mi 'jug

/chos dang chos min ldan par 'gro// rang lus lus byung ye shes me// thams cad kun nas 'bar ba ni// me 'od 'bar ba mnyam pa'i 'od// ye shes 'khor lo bsgoms nas ni// 'og nas steng du blo yis ni// rab tu dmigs pas kha ba 'bab// thams cad du ni tshig par bsam// phyi nang gsang ba'i ye shes 'od// nyon mongs thams cad rab bsreg pa// sangs rgyas nyid du 'bras bu smin// mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed pa ni// bdag nyid nam mkha'i ngo bor 'gyur// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye ba yis// thabs dang thabs ldan byang chub sems// du ma nyid du mi dmigs shing*// rnal 'byor dngos po ldog par 'gyur// rnal 'byor zhes bya rdzogs ldan dus// rjes su rnal 'byor gsum ldan te// shin tu rnal 'byor gnyis ldan nyid// rtsod ldan dus ni rnal 'byor che// yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa dang*// rdzus te skyes pa dang po'i mi// 'od kyi lus tsam gnas pa dag /lha yi bdud rtsi ོda pa'o// de dag lus de spangs nas ni// shin tu phra ba'i khams zhugs shing*// sgyu ma'i lus su gnas gyur pas// srid pa mngon par len par 'dod// bag chags dri mas kun bslang ba'i// 'dod pa log pa mthong ba yis/ chags pa'i yid kyis lus la 'jug /tshor ba rnam gsum myong ba yin// sa zhag ro dang zas gzhan gyis// lus nyid rags pa nyer thob pas// dang po'i dngos po log gyur te// bu ga dgu ldan dri nga'i lus// nyon mongs kyis ni dkrugs gyur te// bsod nams stobs nyams dman sar lhung*// rdzus te skyes dang drod gsher dang*// sgo nga las byung mngal las skyes// 'di dag rim pa rnal 'byor can// snyigs ma'i dus su rab tu 'byung*// ji srid paV'i sems can gyi// lus ni shin tu phra ba ste// rnam shes lus byung sgyu mar gnas// rig dang ldan pas dus gsum shes// stobs ldan de la rtog pa yod// rang nyid sgyu mar ma shes pas// dngos 'dzin bdud gyis glags rnyed 'gyur// 'di dag rgyun las bzlog pa na// srid pa nye bar len mi byed// skad cig gsum gyis ye shes thob// 'chi med bde ba'i gnas thob ste// dag pa'i skus ni 'gro don 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po'i gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las mchod pa dang gsang sngags mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje sgyu 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dgu ba'o//

byang chub kyi sems rab tu 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i gsang ba chen po'i ye shes bla na med pa'i ngang las rab tu dgyes par gyur to// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po med pas sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgom bya min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs pa med pa'o// zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po 'di dag ma skyes pas// chos dang chos nyid med pa ste// nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing*// chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs// bdag med chos las kun tu byung*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal gyis gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa 'od zer 'bar ba rdo rje sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la// ngo bo med de sgom pa'ang med// nam mkha' gnas su sbyor ba yis// de ltar dngos por rab tu grags// zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pas gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra'i rgyal po gdon mi za ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyomams rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// srid med mya ngan 'das med pa// 'di ni rdo rje bde chen po// sgom pa med cing bsgom pa'ang med// dgos pa mchog tu bsgrub pas bde// zhes gsungs so// rdo rje btsun mo mā ma kīs sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

stong zhing snang med gnas kyi mchog /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can// sems kyi rang bzhin sgom pa ste// ji srid du yang med pa'o// zhes gsungs so// rdo rje btsun mo gos dkar mos sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su thams cad rjes su chags par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dbyangs dang yi ge rnam bral te// de ni sems dang thig le min// 'di ni dam pa'i bde chen te// dpri zhing bsnan pa yod ma yin// zhes gsungs so// rdo rje btsun mo sgrol mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi slu ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// chos rnams gzugs brnyan rang bzhin te// de bzhin bsgom bya'i dngos gang yang*// stong zhing snang med gnas mchog ste// de tshe sdig dang bsod nams dag /ces gsungs so// de nas lha mo gzugs rdo rje dam tshig mchog gis mchod pa bla na med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// dper na chu dang zla ba ni// bden min brdzun pa'am ma yin pa// de bzhin dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di/ rang bzhin gsal ba'i rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs so// lha mo sgra rdo rje nam mkha'i 'od kyi sprin rdo rje tshim par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ stong zhing snang med gnas gyur pa// rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te// sems kyi ngo bo sgom pa ste// ji srid yang dag bdag med pa'o// zhes gsungs so// lha mo dri rdo rje kho na nyid mngon par byang chub pa kun tu ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bde ba chen pos 'gro khyab pa// bde ba spangs na rig pa med// bde ba 'bar bas srid pa 'ching*// bde ba sus kyang bzlog mi nus// zhes gsungs so// lha mor rdo rje dam tshig chen pos mchod pa kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

chos rnams bden pa ma yin zhing*// brdzun pa'ang ma yin pa yi don// blang dang dor bar byar med pa// de nyid ye shes mchog tu bstan// zhes gsungs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i rdo rje spro ba'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bsam gtan med cing dngos po med// sngags med lha yang med pa nyid// rdo rje sems dpa' rang byung ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sku rdo rje zhi ba'i dam tshig mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ ye shes lnga yis rab sbyor bas// bsod nams med cing sdig pa'ang med// byang chub sems 'di bstan pa nyid// du ma nyid du mi dmigs so// zhes gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rdo rje dngos po med pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sngags med bzlas pa'ang med pa ste// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis// 'gro ba gsum kun yod pa ste// sgom pa med cing mngon rtogs med// ces gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dam tshig la gzigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ kun rdzob tu ni 'jig rten yod// dpyad pas 'jig rten gang na'ang med// rtag tu 'jig rten ldan par 'jug /dag pa dang ni gnas dag pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsung rdo rje ye shes mchog rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ skye ba med cing dmigs pa med// mi phyed nam mkha'i 'byung gnas te// zab cing rgya che'i rang bzhin can// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i rdo rje chos thams cad kyi tshul gcig pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas// don dam kun rdzob rten 'brel tsam// yang dag tu na gnas pa med// chos rnams dag pa ye shes che// gnas med dmigs pa med pa'o// zhes gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa' chen po dam tshig rdo rje chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

rgyu dang 'bras bu dag pa'i chos// 'gro zhing ldog pa'i khyad par gyis// rtog pa yang dag mi dmigs pas// spros med gos pa med pa'o// zhes gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos kyi dbyings thams cad dang mnyam pa rdo rje mi zad pa sgyu mar rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ chos dbyings ye shes khyab pa'i sku// rtog pa med cing dri ma med// kun tu 'byung zhing dus gsum du// phra zhing bdag med tshul mchog go /zhes gsungs so// de nas khro bo gshin rje gshed// rdo rje 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin// thams cad chos nyid dag pa las*// mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med// snang ba sna tshogs rang grol ba// sems kyi mtshan nyid rtag tu med// ces gsungs so// gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje yis// mngon par byang chub la zhugs te// sgyu mar snang ba rmi lam tshul// rtog dang nam mkha' dbyer med mtshan// 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes mchog /phyag rgya chen po yang dag pa'o// zhes gsungs so// khro bo pa V'i dam tshig mchog /rin chen 'byung gnas la brten te// chags pa med pa'i tshul mchog gis// skye med rten 'brel rang dag pa// chu rlabs g.yo ba rang bzhin med/ gnas pa med de ston pa po// zhes gsungs so// khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa des// byin gyis rlob pa'i ye shes tshul// 'gro rnams byang chub sems rang bzhin// khams rnams stobs su gyur pa dag /dag pa bde ba'i 'byung gnas te// ye shes brten pa de las 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo mgon// mkha' dbyings ting 'dzin la zhugs te// rtog pa thams cad dag pa'i dbyings// chos rnams thams cad rkyen la brten// rang 'byung ye shes thob byed pa// gnas pa med pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// khro bo ṭaki rā dza rgyal// bsam gtan rdo rjes brten pa nyid// yang dag ye shes dga' bas brgyan// lus dang lus med brten pa med// ye shes lus ni dri ma med// rtog pa med cing 'gag pa med// ces gsungs so// khro bo rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin// 'jigs par mdzad pa khros pa'i sku// snying rje chen pos gdug pa 'dul// ye shes chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu// byams pa'i thugs kyis khyab pa po// sems can mgon po dag pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gtsug tor dam tshig khro bo ni// rig pa'i stobs mchog la gnas pas// bka' yi 'khor lo rgyas pa po// bstan pa'i don ni thob pa ste// nyon mongs zad byed ye shes mchog

/gnas pa med pas ston par mdzad// ces gsungs so// rdo rje gnod mdzes khro bo che// rab tu 'byung gnas la brten nas// yang dag stobs ni dag pa che// chos kyi 'byung gnas 'gag pa med// rol pa sgyu ma ston par byed// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba chen po'i byang chub kyi sems rab tu 'byung ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu ba'o// // gsang ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa'i mchod cing bstod pa'i le'u/ ༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ lha mi rnams dang*/ rig pa'i rgyal po dang*/ khro bo'i tshogs thams cad la yang dag par bstod pa/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi sku// rtag pa'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// mnyam med dag pa mchog gi mchog /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che// 'dod chags pha rol phyi V'i rigs kyi yum gyur pa// gos dkar lha mo phyag 'tshal lo// badz+ra ra ti'i sngags las skyes// rlung gi khams ni rnam dag pa// las kyi rigs kyi yum gyur pa// sna tshogs sgrol ma phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po// rtsa rgyus khams ni dag pa'i sku// nyon mongs rnam dag byams pa ni// rgyal ba'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po// mig gi skye mched sbyong mdzad cing*// sa yi snying po de bzhin gshegs// sku yi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni// rna ba'i skye mched rnam dag pa// phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs can// thugs kyi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni// sna yi skye mched sbyong gyur pa'i// nam mkha'i snying po'i mchog gyur pa// ting 'dzin rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// lce yi skye mched dag byed pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug bla na med// gsung gi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba che// yid kyi skye mched rnam dag cing*// dag pa'i sems mchog 'jam dbyangs sku// nam mkha'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' theg pa che// lus kyi skye mched dag pa po// sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel mdzad// dam tshig rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal dbang po// 'gro ba'i sems rgyud sbyong mdzad pa// kun tu bzang po ye shes rol// chos dbyings rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gzugs ni yid du 'ong*// snang stong kun tu rol pa yis// chos rnams sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ston// gzugs kyi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje'i sgra ni yid du 'ong*// sgra dang sgra min las grol ba// stong nyid rang sgra 'byung ba po// sgra yi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje'i dri ni yid 'ong mchog

/sangs rgyas thugs mchod bde ba che// log pa sad par byed pa po// dri yi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje ro ni dga' ba'i sku// dri med bdud rtsi 'thob byed cing*// dkyil 'khor ma lus mchod byed pa// ro yi lha mo phyag 'tshal lo// ya māj kri ta sngags las skyes// sku yi gsang ba khro bo che// dbang po mnan cing shar phyogs bzhugs// gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// pradzñāj kri ta sngags las skyes// thugs las skyes pa'i khro rgyal ni// gshin rje mnan cing lha phyogs bzhugs// rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// paVj kṛ ta sngags las skyes// gsung mchog paV rang 'byung ba// chu bdag mnan cing nub phyogs bzhugs// gsung mchog rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// bigh+nāj kṛ ta sngags las skyes// phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po// gnod sbyin mnan cing byang phyogs bzhugs// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par rtog pas mi g.yo zhing*// ye shes gsang ba'i don ldan pa'i// khro rgyal byin za'i steng bzhugs pa// mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// brtul zhugs chen po mi bzad pas// log 'dren dpung rnams 'joms mdzad pa// khro rgyal bden bral steng na bzhugs// 'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo// gtum po srid gsum 'joms mdzad cing*// snying rje'i stobs dang ldan pa'i sku// rlung bdag steng gnas khro bo che// dbyug sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// ye shes mchog gis dbang bskur ba// khro rgyal dbang ldan steng bzhugs pa// stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dug gsum rtog pa dag byas shing*// sna tshogs sgyu mar gar mdzad pa// tshangs pa'i steng bzhugs lha yi gtso// 'khor los sgyur la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// spros med de bzhin nyid las byung*// kā la kro Z gnon mdzad pa// khro rgyal gnod mdzes phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems las rang byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi de bzhin nyid// sgyu ma dag la spros med sku// 'od gsal bde ba'i bsam gtan nyid// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya las// rlung sngags las byung rang dag cing*// thams cad chos ni yongs rdzogs par// snang ba ye shes rang bzhin tshogs// spro dang bsdu ba nyid gyur pa// zung 'jug ting 'dzin la 'jug gang*// dbye bas ye shes dag pa'i gnas// mchod pa yang dag thob par 'gyur// de nyid bla ma'i sku nyid do// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa dpal rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las gsang ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa'i mchod cing bstod pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// rdo rje mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po rdzogs so//

gsang ba'i mchod pa thog mar bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin las kyi bkod pa du mar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa du mas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i rdo rje mngon par rdzogs pa'i tshul mi zad pa rdo rje 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du sems can nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur pa'i khams brjod du med pa'i gnas kyi chos nyid dang gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyidang*/ rnal 'byor ma skul byed ma dang*/ 'od zer can dang*/ ral pa gcig ma dang*/ ri khrod lo ma can dang*/ ku ru ku Dpal mchog chen po snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di rtogs par byed pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo du ma las phyung ste/ gsang ba chen po'i chos gnas kyi don mngon par brjod pa rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa ston par byed do// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad dmigs med par/ sgyu ma lta bur bstan pa gang*/ gsang ba'i ye shes rang 'byung ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub kyis rnam par thar pa'i rdo rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ chos rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas// bcings pa med cing grol ba med// thams cad rnam par dag pa'i dbyings// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung gis rdo rje mi zad pa byams pa chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams rmi lam mtshungs pa las// nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas// dmigs pa rnams las yongs grol ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstanapa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas sgyu ma lta bu dmigs pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i bdag

/srid gsum mig 'phrul mtshungs med par// stong pa nyid ni dag pa'i dngos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byams pas gsang ba'i yi ge rnam par dag pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du chos dang chos nyid med// thams cad rnam par mi rtog pas// brjod pa kun las 'das pa ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ges ye shes sdong pos brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di la rtog par gyur pa med// chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa// dngos po nyid du rnam par grol// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rab rtsal gyis dri ma med pa'i snying po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba byang chub sems kyi gsang*// chos kun snying po rdo rje'i sku// lhun gyis grub pa ye shes dbyings// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa me tog kun nas gsal ba'i snying pos ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba mi zad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par mi 'gyur snang ba med// dag pa'i ngo bo ro mnyam pa// phung po lnga ldan nyid kyi ngang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer bskul ba zheses bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba gang 'gyur dbyings nyid la// ye shes rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// dam pa 'di ni 'dus par gsungs// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i ded dpon rgyal pos 'gro ba sems can thams cad yang dag par sgrol ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ji ltar paVོ chu klung las// rab tu skye ba zil 'phro ba// de nyid sdong bu 'dir rtogs bya// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lag chen rgyal pos 'gro ba thams cad yang dag par 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin mi zad pa'i tshul zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam med nam mkha' yangs pa ni// kun la gnas shing mi 'gyur ba// dri ma med cing 'bar ba'i 'od// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stobs mi zad pa'i dpal gyi ri rab brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du mi phyed rdo rje ni// stong nyid byang chub sems rdo rje// snying rje'i snying po dran par brjod// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu skar rgyal pos dran pa'i snying po rin po che'i snang ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni chos rnams stong pa nyid// chu dang zla ba mtshungs pa ste// sgyu ma nyid du 'gag med 'char// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtsi sman mi zad pa'i ye shes stobs kyi rgyal pos phun sum tshogs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du snang la rang bzhin med// stong pa mkha' dang mtshungs pa ste// rol pa rang 'byung mnyam pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snyan pa'i tog chen pos 'od mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang nyid rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas te// rtog pa'i dra ba rnam gcod pa// rang las 'char gyi gzhan las min// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chen po mi zad pa'i dpal gyis zla ba kun tu ston par gyur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gro kun brtan dang g.yo ba yi// dngos po mnyam nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas// gcig dang du mar dmigs su med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grol ba'i phung pos ye shes kyi sprin rnam par bkod pa 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam pa nyid la kun rtog bral// dus gsum mkhyen pa dus mi dmigs// yang dag nyid du kun grol ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi rgyal po mi zad pa'i snang bas chos thams cad yang dag par khyab pa mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snang ba rnam bral mun pa med// gang du rtog las rnam grol zhing*// grol ba'i rgyu ni bden pas stong*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying pos kun tu khyab par byed pa zhes bya ba'i byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje'i rtse mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'byung dang 'byung las gyur pa gang*// de nyid srog chags srog gyur pa// sems can byang chub snying po can// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis snyingV dang*/

u,la dang*/ ku mud dang*/ puṇ+ḍa ri ka dang*/ paV ge sar dang*/ dzim pa ka dang*/ na gā ke sa ra dang*/ mañdzu ṣa ka dang*/ mañdzu ṣa ka chen po dang*/ maq rā ba dang*/ maq ra ba chen po la sogs pa ste/ 'dab ma lnga pa dang*/ bdun pa dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ bcu pa nas 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i bar du me tog gis mngon par gtor/ rab tu gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor cing lha'i bu mo rnams mngon par rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis yongs su mchod par byed do// kun tu mchod par byed do// legs par rab tu mchod cing lha'i dbyangs gyis legs so zhes brjod par byed do// de nas lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis mchod pa la bod skad lha'i rgyal po mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang*/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po stobs bzangs ldan dang*/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu dang*/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can gyi bu mo yid 'phrog ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po ra* ku be ra dang*/ klu'i rgyal po gtsug na nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ nam mkha'i lding gi rgyal po gser lus stobs ldan dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pas so so na mchod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la mgo bos phyag byas shing lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas shing nam mkha' las song ste mi snang bar gyur nas/ skad cig tsam gyis so so'i gzhal yas khang du stan la gnas par gyur to// de nas sa gsum du khyab pa'i 'od kyi snang ba chen po mi zad pa byung ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang reg par gnas pas khyab par byas te slar log nas bdag nyid kyi sgyu lus kyi ba spu'i bu gar mngon par zhugs par gyur to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las 'dus pa chen po gsang ba'i mchod pa thog mar bstan pa ste le'u bcu gnyis pa'o//

kyi 'od zer rab tu skul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// stong pa dngos po yul gyis bral// lus kyis stong pa rten 'brel 'byung*// shin tu stong pa phyi nang med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod par gzigs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgyu ma'i sprul pa du mar 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyu mthun gang yin byed pa ste// 'bras bu dbang sgyur rnam par smin// dri ma med pa lhan cig skyes// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mthu dpung yang dag ldan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun tu brtags pa'i rnam pa can// de yi dri ma rnam sbyangs te// 'jug pa dang khyad par dbye ba med// skye ba med phyir brjod par bya// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa des pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs kyi snying po glog gi 'od zer gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos nyid yongs su grub pa las// ngo bo bden par 'gyur ba med// pha rol phyin pa'i tshul mchog ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal gyis debazhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyan yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'jig rten pas ni kun tu ston// 'das pa'i ye shes dag pa'i lam// mi 'gyur ba ni phyag rgya che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtan ldan dbang pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ljon shing rgyas pa'i bsil grib ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dod khams sgra dang dngos pos stong*// gzugs kyi khams ni lus kyis stong*// gzugs med khams ni yid kyis te// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i dpal gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byams pa chen po'i gdugs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam pa kun tu 'byung ba dag

/ye shes rig la rnam dbye bas// dman pa mchog dang bar ma ste// rigs ni chos kyi dbyings la gnas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so brjod// sprul sku sna tshogs 'gro don byed// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sgra can ye shes kyi snying pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btang snyoms tshad med pa rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sku gsum gcig tu bsdus pa ni// tha dad rtog pa spang ba'i phyir// snying po ye shes gyur pa ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bum pa bzang po lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba bla med khyad par ba// zung 'jug 'bras bu rab gyur pas// rim gnyis gcig tu sbyor ba nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi khang bzang bkod pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snying po kun tu bskul ba ni// ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul pas// myur du mngon par 'char bya'i lam// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshig bstan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dran pa yang dag pa

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba bstan pa mi phyed pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'gyings ba dpal gyi sdes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glang po'i stobs mchog snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi// srog ni rlung la brten pa yin// khyab cing snying por ldan pa ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad mi 'khrugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhing khams rab tu snang ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rig ma lha mo khro tshogs bcas// thugs ka nas ni bskul ba shis// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lhun chen 'bar ba'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyi phung po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam grol snying po du ma'i phung po dag /bcings pa med cing rnam par 'thor med pa// tshul 'di thams cad rgyu dang 'bras bur 'byung*// byang chub tshul 'di nges par bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i snying po rab tu 'joms pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan bzang po yongs su rgyas par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas rnams ni ye shes sku// bkra shis dge ba'i mtshan gyis spras// de nyid kun gyi rnam par stong*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sdom pa rab ldan dgyes pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpe byad yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sdom pa thams cad snying po ni// 'dir ni thabs dang shes rab nyid// gnyis med de bzhin gshegs pa yi// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bsnyen pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// srid gsum brtan dang g.yo ba yi// dngos po mi dmigs snang med pa// chos nyid mnyam pa nyid gyur phyir// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam du gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// de nyid ro mnyam gcig pa'i bdag

/rgyu dang 'bras bur bstan pa yin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pa V 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi sdes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdud kyi dpung rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// skye ba med cing gnas med pa// rang 'byung rang bzhin rang gnas pa// gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i ngang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'bar ba'i sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas ye shes 'od zer gyis// snying gi paVུma ma lus sangs rgyas shing*// dbyer med ye shes rgyas pa'i thugs// 'gro ba'i mtshan ma dmigs su med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen po dang ldan pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// tshogs drug rang snang rtog pa med// rnam shes brtags pa rnam bral ba// gzung 'dzin kun las rnam grol ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa snang bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa kun nas sgo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// don dam rnam par mi dmigs pa// yod med mtha' las 'das pa ste// gzigs byar med cing rtag tu stong*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mi zad pas bde bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snang la rang bzhin ma grub pas// mi rtag g.yo ba dngos la ni// bden pa dmigs su med pa ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i sbyin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying rjes bsnyel ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems 'di dri mar bcas pa dag

/bag chags rtog pas rab dkrugs pa// sa ler bzhag pas rang dngas 'gyur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtan par gshegs pas 'gro ba'i blo rang chags pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang 'byung ye shes nam mkha' ni// tha snyad rnams las yongs grol ba// 'char ba med cing nub pa med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod mthong bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rab tu rgyas pa'i nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dad dang ldan pa'i skye bo ni// shes rab snang ba rab bskul ni// mun pa la ni snang ba bzhin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus sbyin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri rab brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam rtog dri ma spangs shing gsal ba yi// kun nas kun tu 'jug pa'i yid dag kyang*// rgyun las bzlog na rang bzhin med par 'gro// nges par gsang ba byang chub bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bzang skyong gis 'gro ba thams cad kyi mun pa sel ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par mi dmigs mtshan ma med// bsam gtan ting 'dzin gnas med par// mnyam rjes mi dmigs grol ba'i mtha'// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dga' bos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab mo'i ོda yul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'khor ba'i gnas ni sgyu ma ste// sgyu ma tsam du'ang mi gnas pa// ye shes mngon par 'byung bas na// ngo bo nyid kyi tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las// dus gsum sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa dag
