/phyogs bcu chos kyi dbyings bcas par// dpag med dug lnga'i rtog tshogs ldan// skye bo shin tu gtum pa dang*// chags dang ser snas 'jungs rtsi ste// rdo rje phreng bar 'gyur ba dang*// dgongs pa lung ston gsang ba'i rgyud// ye shes rdo rje bsdus pa ni// khyad par ston pa 'phags pa'i chos// bzhis bsdus lha mo'i gsang chen dang*// thun mong ma yin ston pa yi// gsang ba bla med rgyud 'dis nges// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa mchog gi gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba bstan pa mi phyed pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi ba'o// // de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa ston pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'chi med bdud rtsi rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku bdud rtsi 'bar ba rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun// rang gi sems las gzhan med de// snang zhing gsal bar gyur pa nyid*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa rnam par spro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni rang rig nyams myong ltar// gal te sems nyid ma yin na// 'brel ba med phyir snang med 'gyur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos nyid dang ni sems nyid dag

/gang du rtog pas dpyang chub snying po can// gdod nas dag pa de nyid de// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya sna tshogs kyi yul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zab dang rgya chen dbyer med pas// snang stong tha dad med par 'dres// sangs rgyas zhes ni de la gsungs// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi'i kha lo sgyur bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ rang rig yin phyir mi rtog pa// rkyen skyes gzhan dbang yin pa'i phyir// mi rtog rtog pa skyed med pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha'i lhas dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang rig 'od gsal nam mkha' 'di// gdod nas ma bcos par rtogs gang*// sangs rgyas gzhan du btsal mi dgos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi lag pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// glo bur dri ma byung gyur kyang*// rang bzhin dag pa'i ngo bo la// gos dang ma gos med par gsal// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par mkhyen pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glang po'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yod med gnyis ka las 'das pas// phan tshun ltos pa ma grub phyir// tshu rol ma grub pha rol bzhin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas snang ba tog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yod med tha dad ma grub ste// gnyis tsam du yang med pa'i phyir// rnam par brjod med dmigs pa bral// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i seng ges srid gsum thams cad lhang nger gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma'o sems nyid dri med kyis// rnam 'phrul gzugs skus bsdus pa yi// zhing khams rnam par dag par snang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yid bzang gis chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa// ngo mtshar ba yi rnam 'phrul dag

/nam mkha'i mthas klas khyab par 'gyur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang zhig sgrub pa gang bsgrub la// de sgrub pa la gnas med med// bsgrub par bya ba sgrub ma yin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i 'od zer rab tu bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba mi zad chos kyi dbyings// ye shes rdo rje rol par bstan// bla med gnas ni tshul thob pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grags chen gyis pa V'i snying po kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'khor ba'i 'dam las skyes pa yi// rang sems paV'i sdom bu ni// zil par ldan pa dri ma med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug na nor bus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul rab tu spro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun nas kun tu sangs rgyas kyi// zhing 'di'i snying po dad pa ste// mos dang brtson 'grus stobs de bzhin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul can zhes bya ba'i zab pa'i snying po gzhal med khang rnam pa du mar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sa 'di kun gyi brten pa bzhin// byang chub sems la kun brten kyang*// gnas pa med cing 'gro 'ong med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// nam mkha' kun tu gnas med pa// de bzhin rtog bral dri med sems// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// shes bzhin smon lam dbang gis ni// mngal 'byung rim pa gang yin dang*// zhing dang zhing du so sor yang*// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni// 'dir ni yang dag brtul zhugs 'dzin// gzhon nu'i rol pa thams cad dang*// de bzhin bzo gnas yang dag bstan// thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin las// rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu spros// 'dir ni sngon chad ma byung med// sngon gnas pa ni sbyar mi bya// de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad pa ni// thams cad rdo rje'i dngos gzhi la// dus gsum lam gyi mthar thug pas// thams cad 'di bzhin blta bar bya// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa ston pa'i le'u ste bco lnga ba'o//

thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba rab tu bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ljon pa dri ma med pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs bcu mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa// rang 'byung lhan cig skyes pa yi// snying po sgyu ma'i snang ba nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par rgyal ba can de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po kun tu bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yang dag kun rdzob dag pa la// brtan g.yor bcas pa'i snang ba ni// rang bzhin med pa nyid du snang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab rnam par brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yang dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad sems yin te// sems nyid sgyu ma'i rnam pa dngos// de nyid kun rdzob stong nyid do// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes sgyu mar ston pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sna tshogs sgyu ma 'khor 'das dag /sems nyid dag dang ma dag pa'i// snang ba bag chags khyad par nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rgya mtshos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ོda pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yid bzhin nor bu rang las rnyed// de nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*// bla ma sangs rgyas drin gyis rnyed// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag skyes pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par grol ba'i ye shes la// yod med mtha' las 'das pa ste// mi rtog ye shes kun rdzob nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo mtha' yas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi 'jigs pa bzhin 'byung ba'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma ho sku gsum 'dul ba'i zhing*// ma lus lus pa med pa rnams// thams cad byang chub sems kyi rgyan// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pas bkra shis dga' bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma ho stong gsum ma lus rgyal ba'i zhing*// rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la rdzogs// thams cad ba spu'i tshogs las kyang*// spros nas byang chub sems gsungs so// zhes 'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen gyi tshul 'di gsungs so// e ma ho sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*// skye ba med las thams cad skyes// skyes tsam nyid na'ang skye ba med// gsang ba'i tshul chen bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs brtan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i dbyings la yang dag par dbang bskur ba'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma ho sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*// gnas pa med las gnas pa'i chos// gnas tsam nyid na gnas pa med// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bkra shis 'byung bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma ho rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsang*// dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs// dmigs tsam nyid na dmigs pa med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bde ba'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srid pa'i chu klung skems pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong*// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pa V'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nam mkha' rdul med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// e ma ho rtog pa rang 'byung ba// rtog tsam nyid na'ang rtog mi gnas// tha dad med pa'i tshul mchog gis// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sred med kyi bus rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rol pa lding ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bcings pa med cing grol du'ang med// lhan cig skyes pa rnam grol ba// ye shes brjod pa dang bral ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lag bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtse mo'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ chos kun brjod du med pa ste/ gsang ba zab pa'i gnas nyid la// brjod tsam nyid na brjod du med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'khor los sgyur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byung chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// don dam rtog pa'i yul min phyir// chos sku ye shes ngo bo nyid// rang rig ye shes sgyu ma'i dngos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das yon tan bde spros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rnga sgra kun tu sgrogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal po dpung bcas yan lag ldan// pha rol rgol ba bzlog pa bzhin// ye shes rgyal po stobs chen ldan// dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom lda 'das tshangs pas byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi phyogs bcur sgrogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// theg pa sna tshogs drang ba'i phyir// lam 'di rim par bstan pa yin// gsang ba'i theg pa gcig pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung 'a sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khri phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la smras pa/ gang du dpal rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos yin te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang yin pa ni rang bzhin med pa'o// rten 'brel las skyes pa'i chos thams cad ni ma skyes pa/

ma 'gags pa/ dmigs su med pa ste/ gnas pa med cing rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid de/ de yang dngos po bar dngos po med pa gnyis su dbyer med pa ste/ mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o// zhes smras pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus pa de dag thams cad kyi sems kyi rtog pa yongs su chod nas legs so legs so zhes brjod nas cang mi smra bar gyur to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba rab tu bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// // rab tu mi gnas pa'i ye shes bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i me tog de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi yongs su dag par dmigs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis// rang sems dri ma bkru bar bya// dag pa'i thugs ni ye shes che// byang chu+o dgyes pa'i rtsa ba ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sprin spro ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba chos nyid dag pa nyid// phyag rgya chen po'i tshul mchog gis// 'gro ba'i blo yis mun sel ba// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das blo grags pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyi dang nang du dngos po'i chos// du ma nyid du mi rtog ste// thams cad brten pa'i tshul 'byung ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das spobs pa brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang bzhin rtog pa'i tshogs 'byung ba// rnam par brtags pa rang byung gang*// sems gsum snang ba'i ngang du dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni gang du rnam shes dang*// ye shes gnyis su med pa ste// kun gzhi rtog pa med par gsal// byang chub rten 'brel tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par rol par ldan pa'i snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ji srid nam mkha' stong pa min// rang sems stong nyid nam mkha' las// rtogs pa'i ye shes stong nyid de// kun ston tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das mun pa dang bral ba'i rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes rdo rje'i dra bas yongs su 'brel ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po med cing rang stong ba// bde chen phyi nang dmigs med pa// ro gcig ye shes sgyu mar snang*// zhen med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi snying po dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dmigs gter gyi bum pa bzang po'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du chos don snying po ni// rgyu dang 'bras bur 'byung ba yi// zab mo gter 'dra rang las rnyed// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das nor bu'i 'byung gnas rgyal pa/zhes gsungs so// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das stobs kyis gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par 'byung ba thob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thog ma med cing tha ma med// dbus su 'byung ba yang dag spangs// ye shes nye bar brgyan pa gang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das blo gnas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par rol pa kun tu bzang po ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ri bo sna tshogs 'dus pa la// ri rgyal brtan par 'gyur ba gang*// rtog med lhun po'i gnas su spro// de nyid byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs mdzes pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi snying por bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings// kun tu rtog med lham mer gnas// de nya

V £ ga'i dbyings can te// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu 'phags pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul gcig pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yul gyur pa// chos kun bdag med mnyam pa nyid*// zab mo'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal seng ge'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzad pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du bdag gzhan tha ུngas so// yang dag ye shes bzang po nyid// rdzu 'phrul 'byung ba'i blo yi nor// bdud rtsi'i snying po rang las rnyed// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// sangs rgyas ye shes lhun grub pas// 'di nyid rtog med rab gsal ba// bsam pa'i dngos po 'jug mi 'gyur// sems kyi kun rtog rang zhi ba'o// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las rab tu mi gnas pa'i ye shes bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// // 'byung 'jug gnas par dag pa kun tu ye shes ston pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das klu'i 'od de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gdug pa can ma lus pa 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// shin tu rgyal ba dri ma med// sems kyi glang po bcing mi bya// rang grol gsal ba dag pa'i lam// rgyal bas tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das spos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ste// chos kyi phung po de snyed las// rtog pa'i ye shes gyur pa na// tshul 'di gcig tu bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog gi ri bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed par nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thog ma bar dang tha mar yang*// byang chub mchog tu gnas pa nyid// nges pa bskyed pa 'byung ba yin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das klu dga' ye shes 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glang po rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bde gshegs ye shes gdung rgyud ni// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'dzin// 'byung po du ma lam la 'dzud// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khyu mchog rlabs po che'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang sems rgyal po rang 'byung gnas// shar nub med pa'i nyi ma las// rtog med cir yang gsal ba nyid// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das stobs kyi lha sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de bzhin nyid kyis dbang bskur ba// thob pa'i khyad par sems las byung*// 'di ni dus gsum kun tu 'byung*// byang chub zab pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das phreng ldan yon tan dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dpal rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dkyil 'khor du ma gsal ba yi// yon tan rin chen tshogs spro ba// phyi dang nang du rnam phye bas// ye shes zab pa'i tshul brjod pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das klu'i lag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchod pa'i gnas kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir nazhin nyid 'di mi rtog pa// gsal ba brjod bral thams cad mkhyen// 'od gsal snying po ye shes sku// spros pa med pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das legs par sbyangs pa'i blo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi so sor ma 'dres pa dri ma med ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// khyab dang rdo rje sku nyid dang*// mi 'gyur dus ni thams cad du// brtan pa med par rang 'byung gnas// bla med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das zil gnon rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byangapar zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams ni// rdo rje gsum du rnam dag pas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das bden par gsungs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po 'od kyi dra ba 'char ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas sku ni kun khyab pas// de nyid sku la rab snang ba// zhing khams rdul phran skur 'dus pa// mi zad tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dag pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas gsung ni kun sgrog pa// de nas gsung du rab brjod pa// sna tshogs sgra ni gsung gyur pa// de ni gsung gcig tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nges pa'i blo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnas pa med pa'i ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas thugs ni bsam mi khyab// ye shes mkhyen pa gcig pa'i thugs// dri med mnyam pa nyid gang yin// rtog med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das mtha' yas gzugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po ye shes rdo rje mchog tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam nyid gnas pas blang dor med// dus gsum tha dad gzigs pa med// skad cig ye shes bde ba'i dngos// chos nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das 'od mi zad pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis phas kyi rgol ba zlog par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dpa' bo seng ge'i lta stangs kyis// mu stegs bdud tshogs las rgyal ba'i// tshad med snying rjes bskul bar bya// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen tog gis chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rdo rje 'bar ba 'od 'phro ba// ye shes zla ba la gnas pa// byang chub sems ni 'dzin pa yis// dri med chu rgyun tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas sangs rgyas the tshom rnam par spangs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi me tog gi snye ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gcig tu mchog gnas mi 'gyur ba// tshig don dbye ba dam pa'i chos// bstan pa'i snying po bla med lam// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus la// rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyis ni// kun tu khyab cing ston pa po// 'di ni ye shes kun gyi gter// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/

'byung 'jug gnas par dag pa kun tu ye shes ston pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa nye bar bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mtshan rnams rdzogs pa ye shes sku// dngos po med cing snang ba'i dngos// rtog pa med pa mi gnas pa// khyad par tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das don yod rnam par mthong ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par grol ba zhi ba'i lam// bcing med ye shes bkod ma'i chu// dam tshig gsang ba sdom pa las// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtogs pa mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par byang chub pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rtog med 'bras bu dag pa'i ngang*// chos rnams stong nyid snying rjer gcig /tha dad spangs pa lam gyi mchog /zab pa'i tshul bzhin bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog rgyal mtshan thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'byung ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bla ma'i byin brlabs bdud rtsi las// 'thung ba ye shes bcud kyis rgyas// tshe 'dir grub pa mchog ster ba// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das ri dbang gi rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che// dus gsum 'byung ba rtag pa gang*// /rigs kyi gnas su gang byung bar// sku gsung thugs ni ye shes can// dran pa ma lus tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don mdzad gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khams ma lus pa la byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thams cad ye shes gcig par sdom// de nyid 'gyur med zag pa bral// snying po rol pa rang byung ba// sangs rgyas tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa grags pa mtha' yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi me long zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri med ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang*// phung po la sogs rtog bral ba// 'di ni kun rdzob rnam thar sgo// rdo rje tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das sgra gcan lhas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi kun nas ye shes kyi sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// las dang las kyi 'bras bu ni// kun nas dkris pa sna tshogs pa// stong nyid ye shes mes bsreg pa// rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ri bo'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'khor ba sna tshogs pa'i mun pa sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par grol ba bde ba yi// 'jig rten lha las 'das nas ni// snang ba med pa'i dbyings su 'gro// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen snying pos srid pa thams cad dbugs 'byin pa byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gro ba'i mtshan ma'i dngos po rnams// srid gsum rang bzhin med mthong bas// ye shes 'od gsal mi phyed pas// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu mthor gshegs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid gcig pa'i lam zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snang ba dang ni mun pa dag

/rtog pa'i chos nyid gzigs med phyir// tha dad snang ba nub pa'i dngos// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das skar rgyal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor lo bskor ba chos kyi lam zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di ni sgrib pa med pa'i las// sdug pa rab zhi brtse ba can// byang chub sems kyi snying po nyid// dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug ring sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po mig 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thams cad ye shes snang ba'i dngos// sems can rtog pa yul med phyir// gnyis snang ma lus bcom nas ni// gnyis med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das nyi zla'i snying pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'pho ba med par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lus la 'pho ba'i ye shes gang*// rnam par shes pa'i gzugs brten nas// gcig pu mi 'gyur dngos med sems// rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i 'od ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dang po'i lus ni lha yi dngos// lus dben snang ba rten 'brel te// sems nyid ye shes stong nyid de// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das skar mkhan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i snang ba bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di ni kun rtog ye shes che// bde ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las// zug rngu bral ba byang chub sems// rdo rje'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs mi zad pa'i ye shes chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du gnyis med mnyam pa'i dngos// 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od// mi zad phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi// dbyer med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das dus mkhyen rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa bla na med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdag gzhan dbyer med byang chub sems// bde ba chen po sems las rnyed// ngal so'i gnas ni bla na med// dbyer med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ni// sku gsung thugs ni gcig sbyor ba// byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyis// rjes su bsngags pa brjod pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung thugs kyi snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa nye bar bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu dgu ba'o//

//sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung du bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das dpal gyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rnam par rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du srog dang snying po med// gnas pa med cing kun 'byung ba// bar ma do yi rnam shes ltar// 'byung ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das srid mtha' gzigs pa thams cad kyi snying po rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dbang po yul la rnam spro ba// de nyid bzlog ste sems gnas pa// lam du byed pa'i ngo bo nyid// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das glog gi 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsrung ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba ye shes 'od kyis ni// rtog pa'i dri ma rnam sel ba// de nyid rnam grol bstan pa gang*// gnyis med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das gser gyi ri bos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od mchog ma lus pa rnam par 'byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri med lhun grub ye shes rang 'byung ba// 'od gsal chos dbyings snying po bla na med// chos nyid chos can dbyer med bde ba che// mnyam nyid gnas pa tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa seng ges byin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam nyid mnyam pa'i ngo bo nyid// dag pa'i sa yi dbang phyug gar// rdzogs pa'i gtsug tor dam tshig che// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal bas rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi rang bzhin thugs// dus gsum sangs rgyas skye med ngo bor mnyam// rnal 'byor rang sems gcig pur gnyis su med// khyad par med pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas sangs rgyas mchog dga' grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snying po sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid// chos gsang ba gnyis po ni// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rang la gnas// rang nyid rtog med ye shes sku// 'di ni byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das grags pa rdzogs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdul bya'i snang ba nges par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lus med dbang po'i phug gnas shing*// ring du 'gro zhing gcig pur rgyu// gdul bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul byed// 'di ni byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das bstan pa dang bral bas 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// blo ldan sa gsum 'grub pa'i gzhi// yon tan 'byung gnas rin chen sems// bsam pa'i dgos 'dod stong byed la// khyad par tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das mchod 'os lhas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku// 'di nyid lus ni dri ma med// chos can ma grub rang sar dag

/byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma chen po zhes bya bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi g.yo ba'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phung po la sogs dngos med pa// gang zag bdag med stong pa nyid// chos la dmigs pa rtog pa bral// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub snying po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ril por 'dzin pa bsdu ba dang*// rjes su gzhig pa spro ba nyid// gnyis med bsam gtan la gnas pa// gcig pu byed pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das spos dri zhim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos bde ba chen po'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ye shes bde ba chen po'i ngang*// rtag tu bzhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid// rang 'byung 'gyur med snying po che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das yon tan mchog 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri med sgyu ma'i chos nyid ni// yod med tha dad las 'das pa// snang la rang bzhin med pa nyid// 'gag med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das mun pa dang rnam par bral bas 'gro ba thams cad kyi blo'i mun pa sel ba ye shes kyi rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di nyid rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su dag par shes par bya// zung 'jug de bzhin nyid las ni// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i 'gram pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rtog med dbyings zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam pa nyid las gang 'byung ba'i// bde chen rang 'byung rang nyid ni// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ste// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen grags pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnyis med mnyam pa rang byung rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba rang byung brtan g.yo bcas// thams cad rang nyid dkyil 'khor dang*// bde chen zab pa'i tshul rdo rje// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das skyon rab zhi bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes sgron me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rtag tu dmigs par bcas pa yi// phyag rgya chen po dngos med de// dngos med ngo bo nyid du dag

/rin chen tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das bdud rtsi 'chang bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mig 'phrul ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa ni// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gcig /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' che// kun tu bzang po slar gsol ba// dri med mnyam pa ye shes sku// sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid de// gnas dang ston pa rang byung ba// che ba'i bdag nyid slad gnas pa// dpal mchog gsang ba 'di nyid du// skal ldan rgyal ba bla na med// ces gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*// gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung du bstan pa'i bdag nyid rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las le'u nyi shu pa'o// //༈ de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bcas dpag med dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// rigs dang lha mor bcas pa dpag med dang*// khro bo'i rgyal po du mar bcas pa dag /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'dus byas nas// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gtso// byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i bdag po la// tshogs pa 'dus pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyis dpag med ldan// mchod pa'i rim pa phyi nang gsang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid rnam pa mtha' yas pas// ye shes rgyal ba mi zad dam tshig gi /rin chen sprin gyis yang dag par mchod de// mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas ni 'di skad gsol// phyogs bcu dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs// ma lus 'dus pa kun gyi gsang ba'i don// thog ma dbus mthar gnas pa ye shes che// gsang ba rdo rje snying po lhan cig skyes// brjod bya bla med gyur pas 'dus pa'i chos// snying po'i 'bras bu kun gyi rtsa ba gang*// thabs dang bstan pa de yi khyad par mang*// bcom ldan dri med gsang ba bshad du gsol// de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs// dpal ldan byang chub sems rdo rjes// de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams la// gsang ba byang chub bka' stsal to// phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor rnams la// rab tu gzigs nas dgyes gyur pas// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa rnams// gnas 'di zhus pa shidang*// thun mong gnas la dbang gyur pa// zab pa dang ni rgya che la// the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa// dkyil 'khor sa yi bdag po la// 'di skad ces ni zhus par gyur// gnas dang dus dang phyag rgya dang*// 'dus pa khyad par gyur pa la'ang*// gsang ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// tshad med ye shes zhing khams kyi// snang ba rab tu rgyas pa la// rgyu thabs khyad par gyur pa yi// gsang chen sku gsung thugs kyi gsang*// de nyid 'dus pa 'di mchog tu// ston pa 'phro bar ma gyur pa// de srid du ni kun mkhyen gyis// lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dus pa las// lus ngag yid ni byin brlab cing*// khyad par mchog dbang bskur mdzad de// phyi nang gsang ba'i rim phye ba// bum pa dang ni gsang ba dang*// shes rab ye shes de bzhin du// rab tu bskur bas smin byas nas// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// gsang ba byang chub sems rdo rje// rtogs dka' mi phyed dam tshig gis// gang phyir dgongs te bshad pa dang*// dgongs min drang ba'i don gyur dang*// nges don ji bzhin pa dang ni// ji bzhin ma yin rnam phye+ig ldan pa yi// thob bya thob byed khyad par pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mkhyen pa'i ye shes bla med pa// mngon pa'i ye shes bla na med// mngon par byang chub gnas gyur pa'i// 'bras bu yang dag thob gyur nas// gsang ba'i rgyud mchog bstan du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab gyur pas// de nas bla med bcom ldan 'das// de bzhin gshegs kun gtso bo yis// gsang ba byang chub sems rdo rje// de bzhin gshegs pa du ma rnams// stong pa nyid du 'jug pa yi// dpag med zil gnon rdo rje zhes// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs// de nas gsang ba'i bdag po de// 'od gsal dri med dbyings nyid la// ye shes 'jug pa'i ngo bo yis// dbyer med gnas par gyur ma thag

/rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa gnas ni// stong phrag bdun cu la sogs pa// rtsa yi bu ga khong stong dag// thig le zhu ba'i gzugs kyis ni// byang chub rdo rje'i rnam par ni// zhu zhing yang dag gnas par gyur// de nyid chos sku'i ngo bo nyid// bde dang stong pa dbyer med pa// snying rje tshad med rnam pa las// de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje// rnam par dben don nyid du gnas// sgyu ma sbyong ba'i dam tshig dang*// mngon par byang chub 'od gsal ba'i// stong nyid rdo rje rdzogs pa yi// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas// rig pa thabs dang shes rab dag /dbyer med bde ba chen po' ི sku// skyes bu'i rnam par gyur pa dag /gnas pa'i ngang las ldang ba ste// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// yul dang dngos po rnam dag pa'i// sku gsung thugs ni byin brlabs pa// ye shes chen po'i ngang gnas pa// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa// ston ka'i 'dam bu'i mdog 'dra ba// sprin dkar dag pa'i tshul can nyid// de ma thag tu snang bar mdzad// byin gyis brlabs pa'i rjes zhugs pa// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang*// rang 'byung ye shes lhag pa'i lha// thams cad bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa// sna tshogs rin chen gyis brgyan cing*// in dra nī la 'bar ba dang*// dang po mgon po rnam par sprul// dung dang kun da ltar dkar ba// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i rang bzhin gyis// rnam pa gsal ba nyid du gzigs// de nas sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin// rnam par snang mdzad chen po nyid// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// 'dod chags kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas// 'dod chags gsang ba'i tshul zhes pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi// bkod pa rab tu mi zad pa// de dag thams cad bsdus nas ni// nyid kyi sku la thim par mdzad// de nas 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis// dbyer med gnas pa'i ngang las ni// rdo rje 'dzin pa gsang ba'i bdag

/yongs su mnyes pa'i don du ni// nyid kyi sku las spros pa yi// ba spu'i bu ga'i 'od zer gyi// rtse mo rnamasadzad ye shes che// de nyid me long sogs bdag nyid// gsang ba 'dzin pa thub pa'i rgyal// rdo rje mi bskyod rgyal po nyid// gsang ba'i 'dzin pa ma lus pa'i// sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyal// snying po rdo rje ye shes so// de nyid rdo rje btsun mo rnams// gcig tu gyur pa'i mkha' dbyings ni// dam tshig chen po'i mkha' dbyings te// rnyog pa med cing rdul med pa'i// dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byin brlabs pa// phyogs mtshams mnyam par ldan pa la// grub pa'i gnas brgyad yongs bskor ba// zhing khams yongs su dag pa yi// 'dzam gling pad ma'i lte ba la// sna tshogs mi shigs e dang bam̐// gsal ba de yi ngo bo nyid// sna tshogs gzugs kyi kun tu rgyas// sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun tu khyab// 'od zer 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// de nas sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /gsang ba rab tu 'dzin pa po// dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga pa// sum cu gsum par ldan pa yis// pho brang yangs pa'i gzhal yas der// de bzhin gshegs pa stong dang ni// gnyis dang byang chub sems dpar bcas// phyi rol 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi// sna tshogs dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dbus su yang dag bzhugs gyur pa'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs// mi bskyod pa dang dkon mchog dpal// tshe dpag med dang gdon mi za// dpal ldan rnam par snang mdzad sogs// de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa'i rgyal// de nyid sku gsung thugs ye shes// phrin las ldan par bzhugs pa'o// de nas rang bzhin dag pa yi// chos kyi dbyings na gnas gyur pa// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i// sems can khams kyi snod bcud dang*// yul dang dbang po thams cad kun// rdo rje sems dpas byin brlabs shing*// dbang bskur sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// ye shes kyis ni dbang bsgyur bas// de dag thob pa'i khyad par ni// tha ma 'bring dang mchog rnams la// bde ba dang ni yid bde bas// gsang ba ye shes ོda yul thob// de las sprul pa'i sku byung ba// bcom ldan de nyid thugs ka nas// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dpag med pa// bye ba grangs med bkye nas ni// gdul bya gdul phyir dab gcig pas// mdzad pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa// rab 'byams cho 'phrul ston pa'o// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo nges par sprul pas rgyud nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// phyi rol yul snang rdzas su 'dod// g.yag rnga ne'u gsing lta bu la// bar du snang mun shong ba tsam// sems las tha dad par gnas pa// skad cig mi rtag par 'dod pas// yul sems tha dad bye brag smra// phyi rol yul dag phra ba rnams// 'dus nas rig pa 'byung ba ltar// yul dus rnam par nges pa las// rig pa 'dra ba'i rnam par gzhag

/yul dgag pa yi tha ma dang*// shes pa skye ba'i thog ma ru// 'phrad par 'dod pa grub pa'i mtha'// mdo sde pa yi dgongs pa smra/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems// rnam par rig tsam skad cig ma// rang gsal rgyun gnas spros bral 'dod// rang rig skad cig gsal ba dang*// mi gsal sna tshogs rtog bral du// rnam med rnal 'byor ོda pa smra// dngos rnams stong pa sgyu ma bzhin// snang yang bdag las rang stong pa// sems kyi rtog pa rnam bzlog ste// mkha' dbyings dri med rtog rgyun 'chad// 'di ltar srid pa zhi ba las// rnam grol stong nyid snying rje dang*// dbyer med byang chub sems kyi mchog /zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa// dpal ldan 'dus 'di grub mtha' kun// blo yi rim pas 'dir 'dus te// de bas 'dir ni chos kun gyi// snying po 'dus pa'i rtsa bar gsungs// gsang ba bla na med pa'i don// ye shes rnam gsum rim 'jug cing*// sgron me 'od gsal snang ba las// zung 'jug rdo rje mi phyed pa// lha yi 'khor lo sprul nas ni// dbyer med mi g.yo ting nge 'dzin// mchog ni dri med rang snang las// gnyis med ngang du rab zhugs pa'o// byang chub sems kyi rang nyid las// rtag tu 'od gsal bar gnas kyang*// 'gro ba'i don las mi 'da' bas// dam tshig 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin// byang chub sems kyi za ma tog /bde ba can ni mi shigs pa// rin chen 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin// bde ba chen po'i byang chub sems// 'gro ba kun la ster ba ni// ma chags pa yi ye shes kyis// 'dod chags 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin// rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma las// gdon mi za ba gnas med pa// 'od gsal 'bras bu mngon phyogs pa// dam tshig 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin// zag pa med pa'i dga' ba yis// ye shes chen po'i ros khyab pas// rdo rje 'dzin pa mnyes gyur pa'i// dam tshig bla med ting nge 'dzin// yang dag ye shes nor bu ltar// rin chen 'od 'phro sprin tshogs kyis// sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su yang*// mnyes byed rdo rje ting nge 'dzin// zag pa bsdus byas bde ba las// bcu drug 'gyur gyis khyad 'phags pa// 'dod chags rjes su 'dzin byed pa// chags par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin// sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje las// mi phyed 'od gsal bar thim la// sgyu ma slu ba rdo rje nyid// snang ba thim pas ting nge 'dzin// ye shes me long lta bu las// srid gsum snang bar mdzad pa ste// snang mdzad rdo rje 'khor lo ni// mi zad sku yi ting nge 'dzin// snang ba gsum las 'das pa yi// rang bzhin mngon par byang chub pa// rnam par dag pa rdo rje yi// 'od gsal ba yi ting nge 'dzin// srid zhi mnyam nyid mnyam pa'i sku// chos rnams gnyis med ro gcig pas// rin po che ltar 'byung ba'i gnas// yon tan gter gyur ting nge 'dzin// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// gang las 'od gsal chos kyi sku// mngon par byang chub pa yi tshul// mi phyed rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin// bla med mngon par byang chub pa// gsang ba lhan cig skyes pa yi// ye shes rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin// rtogs pa'i ye shes mchog tu 'gyur// chos nyid mi zad dbyings kyi ngang*// snang stong tha dad med pa ste// ro gcig 'du 'bral med pa nyid// stong dang snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin// chos rnams thams cad bdag med pas// kun tu stong zhing ma bcos pa// lhun grub rdo rje'i ngang gnas pa// phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin// rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyi// 'od chen rnam par snang bar byed// 'od gsal 'bar ba rdo rje yis// tshe dpag med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// snang ba'i dngos po sna tshogs pa// sgyu ma rkyen skyes zil gnon pa// rdo rje 'od gsal ting nge 'dzin// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje can// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs de dag dang*// byang chub sems dpa'*/kun gyi rtsa ba a las byung*// de las chos kyi phung po ni// brgyad khri bzhi stong dag tu snang*// dbyangs dang gsal byed ngag yin te// ngag ni rlung gi rtsa ba can// sgrar snang tsam nyid kun rdzob ste// thim pa don dam brjod pa'o// yang gnas 'di la sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i yul la rang gi bsod nams dang ye shes gnyis su med par da pa ོda par byed de// rang rig pa'i ye shes sgyu ma dang mtshungs pas da pa ོda par byed do// 'di ltar chos rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan dang*/

sprul pa dang*/ sgra brnyan dang*/ brag ca dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ chu zla dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ dbang po'i gzhu dang*/ sprin dang*/ mig yor dang*/ glog dang*/ chu'i chu bur dang*/ sgyu ma'i rnam par lta ste/ de lta na yang don dam pa ni rnam par dmigs su med do// chos thams cad ni rang bzhin med pa'i phyir rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba dgag tu med do// de yang dag par bden pas stong pa'i phyir ro// de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dmachog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes gtan la phab pa zhes pa'i le'u/rjod// ma ni lha mo gos dkar mo// yā yi rnam pa sgrol mar brjod// shru ni byang chub sems rdo rje// tam̐ ni shes rab pha rol phyin// me long ye shes e zhes brjod// ka ni mi bskyod rdo rje ste// smin zhes don yod grub pa nyid// rin chen 'byung ba sa zhes bya// 'od dpag med pa ma zhes brjod// rtag pa'i rdo rje ye zhes pa'o//

£ ni dri yi rdo rje ma'o// yi ge ga ni ro rdo rje// bān ni gzugs kyi rdo rje ma'o// sa yi rnam pa reg rdo rje// rba ni sgra yi rdo rje ma// ta ni chos dbyings rdo rje yi// thā ni sgrib pa rnam par sel// ga ni 'jig rten dbang phyug brjod// yi ge ta ni sa snying po'o// kā ni nam mkha'i snying po ste// ya ni phyag na rdo rjer gnas// bā ka ni kun tu bzang po'o// tsi ta ni byams par brjod par bya// ta ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po ste// hṛ da ya ni snying po nyid// ba ni dbyug sngon can du grags// dz+ra ni stobs chen 'bar ba ste// yo ni mi g.yo gtum po'o// ṣi ni bya ba nan tan te// £ ni gnod mdzes rgyal po'o// ge ni gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur// ṣu ni bgegs mthar byed pa ste// bi ni shes rab mthar byed do// dza ni gshin rje mthar byed de// ha ni mthar byed pad ma 'dzin// ra ni so sor rtog pa nyid// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba// phung po lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga// 'byung bzhi lha mo bzhi ru brjod// yul lnga 'dod yon lha mo lnga// rnam shes brgyad ni byang chub sems// lus tshigs la gnas khro rgyal bcu// bsdus pa ye shes lngar sbyor ba/ bde ba chen po ye shes ni// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi dngos// mig dang mi yi gnas pa las// de nyid kyis ni rgyal ba yi// de las gyur pa'i grangs rnams kyi// dkyil 'khor de snyed rnams su 'gyur// phyogs dang gdengs ka gdong pa dang*// ris byed rigs kyi phye ba gang*// rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyur pa ste// gzhan du 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// ka nas bzung ste rim bzhin du// de bzhin ha yi bar dag tu// de dag sna tshogs rgyur gyur pa// stong phrag sum cu'i bdag nyid do// thabs dang shes rab ngo bo nyid// stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur// rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa dang*// cha mthun yan lag rgyud gyur pas// de dag sde dang bcas pa yis// gsang chen rgyud sder brjod par bya// rnal 'byor rgyud ni thams cad du// lha 'di rnams ni thog mar bzhugs// 'dis ni rgyud rnams gsang chen kun// rnal 'byor rgyud ces rgyas btab pa'o// mdo sde rnams la gnas sogs pa// thun mong dbye bas phye ba nyid// yi ge bzhi ni thun mong du// bsdus pas chos nyid bdag nyid can// mdo kun yul du gyur pa'o// gsang ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni// nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs pas// rnam pa kun tu ma bshad de// 'di skad bdag ces dang por brjod// dus gcig dus gsum skad cig ste// ston pa rang 'byung che ba'i sku// de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar gshegs// de bzhin du ni rtag gshegs la// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zhes// paV'i ming can btsun mo'i gnas// der ni mngon par bzhugs par mdzad// btsun mo rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rin chen chos dang bcas pa yi// rdo rje las kyi sems mar brjod// de dag kun gyi bde ba'i gnas// bskyed dang sdud par mdzad pa po// thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// yul rnams thams cad rten pa'i gzhi// yang dag btsun mo'i £mas la bsngags pa yin// rmongs pa de ltar 'dod pa rnams// skye dang 'jig dang gnas pa dang*// rgyud gzhan rnams la nges bstan pa// rtag tu rten 'brel tshul de brjod// 'bras bu rgyus ni rgyas btab cing*// rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab par// bsam gyi gzhar du dngos grub ni// bskal ba bye bar yang mi 'gyur// rgyud kun la ni gsang chen gyi// snying po phyag rgyas rgyas gdab phyir// de nyid gsang ba yang dag par// mi phyed par ni bstan pa yin// sems can kun gyi lus gnas pa// sku yi gsang ba rtag pa nyid// sems can kun gyi ngag la ni// gsung gi gsang ba rang byung du// sems can kun gyi snying la ni// thugs kyi gsang ba snying po bzhugs// de nyid snying po gsum ldan pa/ོnga nyid ye shes dngos grub bo// de nyid byang chub sems rdo rje// bla ma nyid du bsdus pa yin// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'dzin pas dug tu 'gyur ba yin// dug nyid nye bar zhi gyur na// dag pas dug med byas pa yin// bdud rtsi rim gyis bsten na ni// bdud rtsi nyid du nges 'gyur yin// de nyid ngo bo yongs shes pas// rgyud 'dir lam du gyur pa yin// sngags 'dun thabs dang shes rab ste// dbyer med de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs// shes rab £ ga'i brdar brtags pas// dbyangs su brjod pa gsang ba'i tshul// ā li bcu gnyis rten 'brel te// ma rig la sogs 'gag par bstan// ro hi ta la sogs pa dang*// khyim ni bcu gnyis rlung dag ste// dus sbyor ba dang mtshungs pas na// lugs 'byung de nyid lugs bzlog par// de nyid yang dag rim pas bstan// kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi po// thabs kyi yi ge pha zhes brjod/

mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu bzhi// dag pa byang sems rang bzhin te// khams ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i// de dag dag pas ye shes che// dag pa'i dus ni dpe byad dag /nyis 'gyur dag gis bstan pa ste// thabs dang shes rab phrag gnyis bstan// ā li shes rab ma ning bcas// 'di dag mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis// cha gnyis rab tu dbye ba yis// sems can kun gyi lus gnas pa// kla zhes bya ba chu yin te// sla zhes bya ba sa yin no// D zhes bya ba me yin te// Q zhes bya ba rlung yin te// 'byung bzhi'i dbye ba ma ning ste// ye shes dag pa chen po nyid// yang dag lam gsal phyogs tsam dang*// mi gsal ba nyid rgyud las 'byung*// rkyen nyid tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed pa// bsod nams bla med 'bras bur 'gyur// gzhi ni khong na gnas pa'i don// sems can kun gyi lus la gnas// de yod pas na 'gro kun kyang*// ye shes snying po can gyur pas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyu ru bshad// ma ning ye shes dag pa nyid// gnyis med ye shes 'bar ba yi// ā yi snang ba thabs kyi cha// mched pa ka sogs shes rab che// ma ning thob pa gnyis med pa'o// sbyor ba don gyi yi ge bzhi// sbas pa'i tshul du bstan pa'o// char ni stong pa tsheg drag dang*// thig les brgyan pa bde ba che// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la// kun tu bzang po sems dpa' ches// gsang ba zab dang rgya che ba'o// lhag pa'i gsang chen rgyud kyi don// byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams// khyad par nges shes bskyed don du// dpal ldan 'dus pa nges gsal ba'i// bla med dgongs rgyud bshad du gsol// de nas gsang ba 'dzin pa po// rdo rje 'chang ba tshul 'di dag /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sbas pa'i don// gsang ba rin chen snying po gsungs// gsang chen gleng gzhi'i khyad par dang*// rim pa gleng slong gyur pa dang*// gsang bar bya ba'i gzhi gang dang*// gsang ba'i dam tshig nges pa dang*// gsang ba bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang*// 'jug pa'i rnaV ltar// ge sar kha dbye'i 'od 'bar ba'o// gnyis pa chu rgyun lta bu ste// dri ma sbyong zhing 'byed par 'gyur// gsum pa rab tu gsal ba yi// 'gro ba'i snang ba ye shes sgron// bzhi pa ye shes 'od 'phro ba// nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'char ba'o// lnga pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar// 'dzag dang smin cing sdud pas sbyor// drug pa sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan ltar// chos rnams rang bzhin shes pa'o// bdun pa lta ngan phyogs las ni// rgyal 'gyur seng ge'i rgyal po bzhin// ri bo mchog ltar ting 'dzin rgyal// ji srid rlung ni mi rgyu dang*// snang ba mi g.yo bar gyur pas// bdag gi dngos por rab tu brtag

/thabs ldan byang chub sems mchog gis// don mdzad 'khor los sgyur ba'i stobs// legs thob phyir mi ldog pa'i lam// sems dpa' chen po bla ma nyid// ji srid sprin ni sna tshogs pa// kha dog dbyibs ni tha dad pa// mkha' dbyings dag tu 'byung 'gyur zhing*// deng nyid du ni ldog par 'gyur// de bzhin rang bzhin thams cad kyang*// snang ba gsum gyi rgyun chad dngos// ma lus yul la zhugs nas ni// de nyid du ni rang thim 'gyur// snang ba gsum po dag pa'i lam// rin chen sprin gyis 'gro don du// bsam pa'i tshul gyis char pa 'bebs// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i dngos// de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i yul// 'di ltar zhe sdang rnam par dag /de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i gnas// gang du gti mug dag pa'i ngang*// de ni byang chub sems dpa' yi// snang ba dag pa'i yul gyur pa// thams cad 'od gsal ngang gnas pa'o// sangs rgyas thams cad mngon 'dus pa'i// 'od zer snang ba bsam gtan mes// dri ma ma lus sbyangs gyur pas// mngon par byang chub dag pa'o// ye shes chen po'i dri ma med// snang ba med cing dngos med pa'i// ma 'dres 'od kyi snang ba 'gyed// paVོ rin chen ge sar las// nor bu sna tshogs sdong pos brgyan// ma rig mun sel chu bo'i rgyun// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa// bde chen sa ni bcu gnyis pa// nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas// rab tu mi gnas dngos med pa'o// zug 'jug chen po dag pa'i sku// thams cad mkhyen pa rtog med pa'i// sku gsum rdo rjer gcig pa'i bdag /sar gyur pa ni bcu gsum pa// btsun mo'i £ ga bde can du// rang 'byung 'gyur ba med par bzhugs// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa gang*// dbang phyug brgyad ni dag pa'i dngos// sgom pa'i lam ni 'di nyid du// lam gyi khyad par bstan pa'o// mthong lam yan lag bdun ldan pa// sku gsum rtogs phyir yan lag brjod// tshogs lam dang po dag la ni// dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang*// smin byed dbang gis gzhi bzung bas// bum dbang lus ni lha ru ste// gsang dbang tshor ba bde ba nyid// gsum pa chos nyid ye shes dran// bzhi pa sems ni 'od gsal du// dran pa nye bar gzhag phyir brjod// tshogs lam bar pa nyid la ni// ting 'dzin ma skyes bskyed pa dang*// skyes pa brtan phyir bogs dbyung dang*// yang dag spong ba bzhi bo dag

/de nyid goms par byed pa la// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i phyogs gyur pa// spangs thob rim par ldan par brjod// tshogs lam chen por gyur pa dag /rdzu 'phrul rkang par bzhi nges pa// chu rlung rdo rje mgon po yi// mā ma kī yi rdzu 'phrul gyis// snying ga'i gnas su yang dag ldan// me rlung paVsa bya// re re'ang lha mo bzhi bzhi ste// dkyil 'khor bzhi dang ldan pa yi// lam du rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis brjod// gnad ni rnam pa bzhi dag ste// lus dang dus dang yul dang ni// rlung gi gnad du shes par bya// dang po'i ye shes bla na med// paV ltar gsal rab 'bar ba// sa ni thog mar mngon par bde// rgyu lam yan lag bdun ldan pa// 'jug gnas rgyu lam rang bzhin bcas// dbang gis 'jug dang rang byin brlab// phyi nang gsang ba mchog tu gyur// 'bru gsum e bam̐ ma yar bcas// 'bras bu snying po phyag rgya che// rang bzhin med pa dag pa'i dbyings// 'od gsal mngon par byang chub pa// tshad med snying rje bsdu dngos kyis// nges par rab gang mi dmigs pa'o// sems can sna tshogs 'dul don du// sangs rgyas rnams ni yang dang yang*// sems bskyed gyur pas lam sbyangs te// mdzad pa du ma'i cho 'phrul rnams// rgyun mi 'chad phyir sems bskyed pa'o// dri med sems ni rnam kun tu// rang rig ye shes thogs med pas// 'gag pa med cing skye med kyang*// sems can don du 'khor zhing lding*// byang chub sems ni mi zad pa// de phyir phrin las rgyun mi 'chad// rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pas// kun mkhyen ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings// gdul bya'i khams dang mthun par 'jug /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgyu 'phrul gar// deng phyug bcom ldan 'das// kha sbyar sbyor ba gsang ba che// rdo rje paV mnyam sbyor ba// me tog dang ni de yi dri// dbyer med rten dang brten par gnas// mchog tu dag pa bdag med pa// sku gsum tha dad bstan pa ni// gdul bya'i dbang la gyur pa yin// khyad par yan lag nges par ni// sku gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i don// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang chen mchog

/'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa zhes// thams cad mkhyen pas bshad pa yin// sbyor ba'i lam las yan lag bcu// rlung gi gnas su brjod par bya// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dbang po lnga// stobs lnga de yi khyad par te// yan lag rlung gi gnas pa yin// snga ma'i go rim la ltos nas// khyad pa gong du 'phel ba bsten// dad pa la sogs chos rnams yin// 'bras bu'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi// gsang ba ye shes stobs bcur ni// gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa sogs// khyad par thob pa bstan pa'o// mthar phyin lam ni rnam gnyis te// slob pa'i zung 'jug dang po yin// rang rang rig tu bcas pa yi// tha dad med pa'i bde ba'i lam// rang bzhin dag pa gzugs kyi sku// glo bur dri ma rnam bsal ba// mnyam rjes khyad par gang gyur pa// rtog pa sbyang ba sems mngon gyur// 'dir ni ngo bo nyid med pa// de nyid chos rnams chos nyid de// de ni yang dag mi slu ba// de rtogs sangs rgyas yin zhes brjod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes lam// sangs rgyas snying po byang chub sems// stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro yis// log par lta ba'i tshogs skrag mdzad// de las snang ba med pa'i dbyings// sku gsum yongs su 'byung dang po// mi slob zung 'jug gnyis pa ste// dbyer med rig ma'i skyes bu bcas// rgyas btab drug ldan bde ba che// lhan cig skyes pa'i rol par 'char// ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa ste// sems nyid 'od gsal snying po nyid// chos sku dri ma med pa las// lus sbyangs ye shes ro gcig pa// rdul bral bcing grol med pa nyid// ting 'dzin mnyam nyid tha dad med// byang chub mchog ces bstan pa yin// 'od gsal de nyid dus kun tu// chos nyid dang ni bsam gtan dang*// lam du byed pa'i ting 'dzin las// brgyal dang gnyid dang snyoms 'jug ste// thams cad du ni 'gyur ba med// rang gis 'phrog cing rang gis ster// sa bon rkyen dang phrad pa bzhin// myu gu rten 'brel tshogs las 'byung*// rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sa dang lam rnam par nges pas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// 'di ni gsang ba thams cad kyi// yi ge gnas kyi ston pa po// shrī gnyis med ye shes mchog grub pa// bde legs kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i// dpal ldan rnam par thar pa'i spro// shes rab snying rje dbyer med pa'o// gsang ba'i snying po bla na med// mthar thug chos rnams rab 'jug pa// sgyu ma'i rol pa bsam mi khyab// byang chub sems las kun tu 'byung*// bde ba mchog las mchog grub pa// 'khor 'das spang thob med pa nyid/

nga bzhin 'char// rnal 'byor rgyud kyis bdag dang gzhan// tha dad mi rtog da par bya// kun gyi bla mar gyur pa ni// mchog gi phyag rgya chen po'i gnas// kun rdzob snang ba sna tshogs pa// ngo bo nyid kyis rang stong ba// gnas gsum tshul ni rgyud gzhan las// snying po 'od gsal mngon byang chub// sgyu ma lta bu'i yul las gzhan// ting 'dzin nges par 'dir bstan pa'o// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang chen rgyal ba zung 'jug lam// sku gsum dbyer med nam mkha'i ngang*// ye shes tha snyad las 'das pa'o// yon tan rdzogs shing kun dbang sgyur// mchog ldan rgyal po mdzes shing 'bar// zab dang rgya che gnyis su med// rang bzhin gnyis med chen po yin// rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni// yang dag nyid du rnam bshad pa// lha mo rnams dang skyes bu yi// gsang ba'i rgyud 'dir gnyis med brjod// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las gnyis su med par ston pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen gyi gnas nges par bstan pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes gtan la phab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyer gnyis pa'o// //

shin tu bde ba chen po'i gnas mngon par ston pa'i le'u/༈ brtag pa gnyis pa rnam par nges pa gsal ba zhes bya ba ste gsang ba'i dpal mchog chen po ye shes kyi de kho na nyid rab tu brjod pa'o// de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// sku gsum mchog tu brtag pa nyid// mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi ngang*// brtan zhing mchog tu bzang po che// snying po byang chub bla med pas// gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal to// gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// rnam pa gsal zhing dag pa'i sku// bsdus pa'i pho brang rgya che bas// mi bskyod rdo rje sems dpa' dag /gcig tu gtso bor gyur pa'o// khyab par snang mdzad dkon mchog dpal// 'od dpag med dang gdon mi za// rigs kyi dbye ba lnga ru brjod// na dang mā ma kī mchog dang*// gos dkar mo dang sgrol byed ma// mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gnas pa yi// gzugs sgra dri ro lha mo bzhi// bar khyams gnas pa grwa bzhir dgod// byams pa sa yi snying po dang*/ phyag na rdo rje mkha' snying po// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs// sgrib sel kun tu bzang po ste// sems dpa' brgyad ni lha khyams la// khro rgyal bzhi dang ldan pas na// nyi shu rtsa lnga nang du dgod// phyi khyams dag la khro rgyal drug /de ltar sum cu rtsa gcig gis// rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yin// phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba// tshangs pa chos kyi 'khor lo ste// sum cu gsum par gnas pa'o// sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba mnyam pa nyid ye shes ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nyid du mngon par brjod pa'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi'i zla ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje mi dmigs pa'i ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams du mar snang ba'i dngos// ljon shing 'bras bu ldan pa bzhin// phra ba'i dbye ba shes par bya// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu gzigs pa de bzhin gshegasadas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'bar bas rab tu brgyan pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba dag par sdom pa'i ngo bo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du chos rnams dngos med cing*// ngo bo nyid dag ye shes sku// bden pa 'dis ni khyab par byed// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab brtsegs pa'i rtse mo rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgya mtsho ltar mi phyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/

'khor ba skyug bro rmongs pa can// rab rib ldan pa'i rtog pa nyid// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab brtsegs pa'i rtse mo rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgya mtsho ltar mi phyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dpag med ye shes rgyal mtshan tog /yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po las// rang bzhin bde chen gnas mchog 'grub// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen lha'i lha sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzi brjid mtha' yas pa'i 'od 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba ma lus kun gyi gsang*// ye shes rol pa bde ba che// tha dad spangs pa'i ting nge 'dzin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gnas gzigs pa dag pa'i dbyings kun nas sprin gyi snang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// tshad med bde ba'i char 'bebs pa// rang 'byung ye shes rgyal po nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam pa rdzogs pa dpal rgyal po bden pa gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo kun tu 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di ni rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// ye shes sku ste skyon med pa// bsam pa blo yi yul las snang*// byung chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yang dag par 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun snang ye shes cir mi rtog

/nam mkha'i dri med mtha' khyab stong*// rnam rtog ye shes me 'bar sku// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba rdo rje dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing khams rin po che'i sprin kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri ma med pa dag pa'i zhing*// pa Vོ rgyas pa snang ba'i dbyings// rin chen 'od 'phro mi zad dang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sra ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rol pa ston pa'i dpal rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas 'od kyi phreng ba dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ba dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dbyings// gsang ba 'gro snying rnam dag pas// blang dor med pa'i bde ba thob// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par dbyes pa'i sku'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyangs kun tu sgrogs pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dba' rlabs kun// dbu mar gcig tu thim gyur pas// ye shes rgyas pa'i snying po dbye// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa chos kyi 'od zer 'byung ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po'i ye shes 'byung ba dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun tu seng ge'i rtsal gyis ni// zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje zhes// yongs su bsdu ba'i ting nge 'dzin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gsal ba'i yon tan 'byung ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgyes pa'i yon tan du ma ston pa mi gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun nas snang ba med pa'i ngang*// rtog pas bskyod par mi 'gyur ba// mnyam nyid ye shes lhang nge bzhugs// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das zla ba'i zhal mnga' ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgyu ma'i rol ba sna tshogs su ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'byung ba rnams dang srog bcas dang*// mi zad rtsa lcug ma lus kun// de bzhin nyid las snang ba yin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ko// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dkon pa'i tog rang 'byung du 'char ba'i ye shes rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di ni rang 'byung ston pa po// ye shes 'jug pa 'bad med par// thob bya byang chub sems dpa' rnams// rang rig rang las rnyed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bla ma phan par grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun tu ston cing 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dus gsum pa yis sangs rgyas rnams// dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i 'khor lo dag

/gdul bya'i blo yis mthong bar byed// de nyid bsam pa'i tshul gyis 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// sangs rgyas byang chub rdo rje 'dzin// tshe 'dis 'grub gyi gzhan du min// lus ngag yid ni legs gnas pa// med par 'grub par mi 'gyur gsungs// gsung gcig rdo rje 'dzin pa che// thub pa chen po rnam par rgyal// gnyis med mnyam pa'i rgyal po che// 'dod pa'isang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las// shin tu bde ba chen po'i gnas mngon par ston pa'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o/// / sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mi zad pa'i ye shes rab tu 'byed pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nam mkha'i gnas mi 'gyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du dmigs pa kun bral ba'i// snying rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis// yul rnams sgyu mar da par bya// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer dpag med gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes snying po gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du stong nyid chos kyi sku// de nyid snying rje dbyer mi phyed// 'bras bu snying po byang chub sems// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gdugs khyab par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gro ba ma lus kun gyi snying*// mi shigs ye shes gcig pur bzhugs// 'gro 'ong med cing khyab par 'byung*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes stobs mchog seng ge'i sku can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gyis dbang bskur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ngo bo nyid kyis dus gsum du// phyogs bcu'i sems can ma lus la// rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur mdzad// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa'i blo can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// khams gsum skye 'gyur lus can gyi// lus ngag sems ni mi dmigs par// byang chub snying por dbang bskur mdzad// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bar dka' ba'i blo can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba rnams la yang dag par rtogs pa'i dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyis sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dbang*// rtag cing khyab pa'i tshul du bskur// de nyid rnam dag dbang bskur mchog

/byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phung po mi zad pa sang bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don thams cad gzigs pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lta ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos// chud mi za ba nges 'byung phyir// shin tu dag tshe sdugadi ni ye shes bdud rtsi yin// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpa' bo chen po rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nges pa'i lta ba yang dag pa dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dag pa'i 'bras bu bde ba ste// ma dag pa las srid par ltung*// rnam par nges pas ye shes che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byor ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nges pa'i lam rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nges 'byung lam// de ni thar ba'i rgyal mtshan te// rang sems dag pa tshul khrims mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungasaso// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rab rgyas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams mi zad pa'i gter 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di ུba kyi sems 'di gsungs so// byang chub ye shes nam mkha' ltar// bdag med phung po la sogs stong*// stong nyid sgyu mas snying rjer gnas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snying po thugs yangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gnas pa med pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas thugs ni chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur ba med cing kun rtog bral// mi g.yo mtshan ma med pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungasaso// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs skyes sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mi shes nyon mongs nad kyis gzir// de sel dam pa'i bdud rtsi bsten// bla med thugs rje'i sman gyis gso// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha chen po nor 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rol pa 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'phags pa rnams kyis sbyangs pa'i lam// nang las 'byung gi phyi las min// de nyid 'bras bu mchog las skyes// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yid gnyis spong sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi tshul byin gyis rlob pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i
