ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni khyad par byin rlob cing*// dpag med bde bar gshegs pa yis// dus drug tu ni byin rlob pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gnyis med ye shes dag pa las// ci ste min na ldog pa ltar// byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o//

//sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol ba bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpag med stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi// bdag po de nyid kun 'dus pa// rig pa'i rgyal pos byin gyis rlob// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu srid pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa rnams// so so'i rig pa'i rtsal gya'agro ba 'dul ba dang*// nam mkha'i dbyings kyis kun tu brdung*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi gnas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams rang byung stong nyid sgra// gdul bya mos pa'i snang ba la// sangs rgyas rnams kyis kun tu bsgrags// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bde gnas dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa'i gnas mi phyed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams zag med 'od gsal ba// skye ba med cing shin tu phra// mtshan nyid dngos pos stong pa'i chos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs tshogs can gtso bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin mi zad pa 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sna tshogs sems can sems rgyud ni// ngo bo nyid kyis rang stong pas// mi phyed ye shes gnas pa po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sesungs so// dngos po mi rtag skad cig ma// de nyid slu ba'i chos can phyir// 'dzin pa med pa'i gnas zhes bya// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sgo la 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i dngos// dbu ma ye shes rtog bral bas// mtha' las 'das pa zung du 'jug

/gsang ba gnyis med tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don gyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad skye ba med// chos gang 'gag par 'gyur ba med// rnam par rtog par rab zhi ba// de nyid byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bla med sman pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rtog pa'i dra ba gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag rtog pa med cing dmigs med pas// mtha' yas dri ma med pa'i sku// snying po byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i gdul dka' ba spangs pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'brug sgru'i dbyangs sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snying po rdo rje stong nyid dang*// dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag /rtog pa med cing dmigs med pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa po// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa'i stobs rims nad med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du nad rnams bya ba'i gzhi// las dang nyon mongs rtog lasom pa mchog /gsang ba zab dang rgya che'i dbyings// spang blang med pa grol ba nyid// gnyug mar byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pas byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes snying po don sgyu 'phrul ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sgyu 'phrul chen po lhag pa'i lha// gcig las du mar snang byed cing*// de nyid du mar yongs sprul pa// sgyu 'phrul byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam gtan 'dzin pa rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'byung ba rnams dang khams gsum dang*// rnam shes ye shes khams 'dus pa// rten dang brten pa sbyang bar bya// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bus byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi nyi ma'i snang ba kun tu ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snya

Vོ rnam par rol pa'i 'od zer 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhing khams kun gyi snang ba'i gnas// rin chen 'od kyis rnam par spras// sgyu ma tsam du ston pa nyid// snying po ye shes gzhir gyur pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing ma lus par bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba rgya mtsho sprin tshogs las// dus gsum kun tu dge ba yi// zhing khams ye shes 'od kyi sku// chos rnams sems kyi snang las 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// gsang ba'i dbang phyug bcom ldan gyis// ye shes ོda pas bsgyur ba yin// lhan cig ོda pa bka' bstsal to// ji ltar mi gnas nam mkha' na// khyab cing mtshan nyid med pa nyid// don dam de nyid dmigs med de// brjod pa spangs pa stong pa che// mi shigs gsang ba bla na med// kun tu bzang po zhes grags pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag rgya che// ye shes rtag pas chos kyi sku// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gang*// rnam pa gsal bar 'char ba ltar// ji ltar sangs rgyas ye shes ni// snang ba me long lta bur brjod// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// ye shes rang rig gzhan rig pa// tha dad med par thugs chud pas// de nyid mnyam nyid ye shes brjod// gdod nas dag cing skye ba med// rang bzhin gyi /shin tu rnam dag ye shes brjod// mchog gyur rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni// chos rnams ngo bo nyid med pas// rab tu ma gnas ye shes gzhi// dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o// rang byung dri ma med pa ni// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin gyis// gnyis kyis bag chags 'ching ba nyid// mi rtog pa yi rang bzhin gyis// bsam mi khyab pa nyid kyis gcod// rtog pa'i dri ma'i dra ba yis// rin chen sems ni dri mar byas// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid// dri ma bral phyir sangs rgyas brjod// zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la sogs pa rnams kyis gsang chen gyi gnas yongs su brjod pa la rab tu dga' ba'i don ched du brjod do// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang*// thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o//

// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// thams cad stong pa mi 'gyur che// ye shes dam pa ston pa pos// kun tu gsang ba bka' stsal to// dam chos snying po bcud las byung*// sangs rgyas mchod pa bla med pa// byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul// shes rab thabs ni tshul thob byed// ji ltar gdul bya'i chos rnams dang*// 'dod yon kun laspangs pas// rgyal ba chos sku ye shes nyid// bla ma'i byin rlabs skad cig gis// ye shes mi zad rgya mtsho ni// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// mi phyed rdo rje dbang phyug nyid// gnyis med mnyam par ro gcig pas// rdo rje 'chang chen rang byung du// grub pa bde chen ngo bo nyid// thob med thob pas cig car grol// spangs thob med pa mnyam nyid che// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi glang po'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi gnas 'byung ba rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa'i rdo rje ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni chos rnams thams cad kyi// snying po ye shes bde chen po// byang chub rten cing 'brel 'byung ba'i// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs mi zad pa srid med kyi bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dbyangs kun tu bskul ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdag med dngos po med pa ru// ma skyes zag pa med pa'i ngang*// spros pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba skyob dbul po nges pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glang po'i rtsal thogs pa med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid de// rang sems zla ba kun da ltar// sa bon gnas te rgyu yi cha// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa ye shes mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zab pa'i mdzod rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i thugs// rab tu mi gnas brjod med pa// byang chub sems su gcig pas na// thams cad dbyer med dag par brjod// ces gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i nor bu'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid gang*// stong gsum 'jig rten rang gi lus// phyi nang gnyis med ye shes che// gsang ba zab pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tog gi 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don du ni// sna tshogs gzugs can cho 'phrul gyis// gdul bya ye shes lam la bkod// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchog gi mchod pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mkha' lding rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du byams pa'i 'od kyis ni// 'gro ba kun la khyab par bya// des ni dpag med gzhan don du// mtshungs med ye shes gnas thob pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po sbas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bdud thams cad rnam par 'jigs par mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// byams pas bdud dpung 'joms mdzad cing*// snying rjes g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur// byang chub sems kyis phyir mi ldog /ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba ye shes rdo rje'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rin chen 'bar ba glog gi 'od// dri med chu shel zer 'bab pas// tha mal lus ni rgyal bar bsgyur// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes don grub sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad par rigs sna tshogs su ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du lha mo bye ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig tshogs// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs brgya dang*// bde gshegs stong sogs tshul 'dir bstan// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab lhun po brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snying po sgyu ma'i rol pa ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzi nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mchog tu sa yi mthar thug pa// bcu gsum ye shes rdo rje 'dzin// bde ba'i 'byung gnas bla na med// gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das pa Vོ'i 'od zer rnam par rol pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas mi zad pa 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du mnyam nyid ye shes dang*// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos don gyis// tshad med thugs rjes yongs su bsdu// de nyid mi rtog gsang ba'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom grags pa'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thamasacad kyi kun nas chos kyi sgra 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sdud cing spro ba dang*// mtshan bcas dmigs pa med pa ru// ye shes rgyal la phyag rgyas btab// 'di ni dag pa'i don ston pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes grogs rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba nges par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyis nam mkha'i khams// yongs su gang ba til 'bru bzhin// sems can smin cing grol byed pas// ye shes mngon par bsdus pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes nyon mongs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phro ba'i sprin bkod pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du dngos dang dngos med pas// mi phyed ye shes bde*// rang bzhin gyis ni mi dmigs bzhin// don dam thob tu med pa'i don// gzhi med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos bzang rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po'i 'od zer kun nas rgyas pas lta ngan skrag par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mtshan nyid dang ni mtshan gzhi med// gang du ro mnyam zung 'jug pas// dbyer med rtogs pa rgyal bo che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor rangs pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs pa dang byon pa rjes su 'phro ba ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mi g.yo 'gyur ba med pa las// de bzhin nyid du bstan pa yis// 'jug cing 'byung ba gsang ba che// snying po ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bde grags dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos grub snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud// grub pa'i bla ma'i gdams pa las// thob 'gyur de bas gzhan du min// gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mdzad pa'i sna tshogs gdul don du// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus par// phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul dag gis// theg pa mchog tu yongs grags pa'i// rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyur 'di// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa'i// thugs kyi snying po gsang ba yin// sku dang gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin// snying po kun tu 'dus pa'i phyir// rnal 'byor pa ni rtag tu spros// 'dir ni sngon chad bstan pa'ang med// ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'byung bar dka'// de bas gsang chen rnyed dka' bas// sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jig rten du// 'byung bar 'gyur ram ma byon yang*// gsang ba'i yi ge rnam dag pa// 'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i gnas// gsang chen rang 'byung mnyam pa nyid// dpal mchog 'di ni bsdus pa'i tshul// ye shes chen po'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsang ba 'jig rten du 'byung bar dka' bar gdams shing bstan pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o//

// gsang ba chen po'i ye shes kyi don gtan la phab pa'i le'u/༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid mtha' gzigs sangs rgyas thams cad kyis srid pa'i chu klung skems pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni srid pa'i dra ba dag /rnam par gcod cing ye shes mes// sdug bsngal gnas 'di bsreg par bya// de nyid bde ba kun gyi gnas// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba sgra gcan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i ngo bo 'joms par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rtog pa sna tshogs las bcas pa// g.yeng bas sdug bsngal phung por gyur// de bsal ye shes byang chub sems// blang dor med pa'i ngang du gnas// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun tu phyag rgyas rgyas btab pas// mi phyed ye shes bdag nyid gyur// de nyid phyag rgya bzhi ldan pas// thams cad sdom par shes par bya// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal mtshan seng ge'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems rgyud sna tshogs chos nyid gcig par gyur// de nyid ngang la dag pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog /dbyer med byang chub sems kyi snang ba las// gsang ba bla med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gtan dgyes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje rnam rtog gi ri bo 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du rtog las rnam byung ba// de nyid 'joms pa'i rdo rje ni// stong nyid bde chen byang chub sems// de nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi grub pa rdo rje gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsu snying po ye shes la rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sgyu ma'i dngos po snang med pa*// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don// gnas med bden gnyis dbyer med pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rin po che mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod pa mi 'gyur ba dbyangs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i dbyings// thos bsam bsgom pas rtogs dka' ba// gsang ba'i ye shes dag pa che// dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul gsang ba rdo rje dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam dag 'od gsal dri ma med// ma skyes nam mkha'i bdag nyid kyis// sgyu ma dngos las rnam grol byed// de nyid tshul 'di bshad pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pa

Vོ'i 'od zer snang ba'i ngos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi glu'i dbyangs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi bdag nyid can// 'dus byas rtog las rnam grol ba// 'dus ma byas pa rdo rje'i ngang*// de nyid dag pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mdzod spu ldan pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa// dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs// 'du 'bral med pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub gdul bya la ster bar mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni so so rang rig pa// ye shes rgyun chad med pa'i lam// de nyid lam du bsgom pa'i mchog /bsam gtan ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje nor bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi na bza' mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// nor bu'i snying po bsam 'phel bzhin// rtog med bsam pa rdzogs byed pa// rang byung chos kyi sgra ston pas// mi gnas ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khyu mchog rdo rje'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// srid dang zhi bar mi gnas pa// rdo rje gsum mchog dam pa'i dbyings// sku gsum lam gyi ye shes bcas// sa gsum dag pa'i dbang phyug thob// rjes su dran pa'i gnas ni mthong ba'i lam// ye shes skad cig dga' ba bcu drug las// phyi nang gnas pas 'od gsal don rtogs pa// stong nyid rang 'byung rnam dag tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang chen seng ge'i nga ro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mchod pa' ིrgya mtsho mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sna tshogs snang ba du mar 'char ba nyid// yul ni sgyu ma dngos po gdod nas dag

/dag pa'i ngo bo chos dbyings nam mkha' che// sems snang rol pa gsang ba 'dir bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rmad du byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ma btsal ma spangs ngang gis dag pa'i sku// rnyed par mi 'gyur rab 'byams bde ba che// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam nas lhun grub pa// byang chub sems chen gsang ba theg pa'i mchog /ces gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po grags sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba mtshan rab 'bar ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bde bar gshegs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad rnams// sems can kun gyi lus la nges par bzhugs// dbri bsnan med par 'char bas gsal bar byed// de nyid sbas pa'i don du tshul 'di bstan// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer bcu pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po gzhal yas khang nye bar brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang*// tshad med bkod pas rab spras pa// rgyan rnams bye brag mtha' yas tshogs// snang ba de nyid tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ma smad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yang dag par ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sgyu ma'i chos rnams mkha' lta bur// dag pa'i ye shes rang srog go /snying gi paV sad par bya// de las ye shes blo rgyas pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de dag kun gyi gsang*// ye shes dam pa mchog grub pa// gsang chen ye shes lam 'di yis// 'dod dang thar bar bsgrub pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba chen po'i ye shes kyi don gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o//

// dag pa'i skyes bu bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glang po'i 'gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i ye shes la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ye shes mchog tu gsang ba gang*// de nyid bsdus par gyur pa ste// rtog pa'i dra ba gcod mdzad yin// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yid 'thad dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer kun nas rgyas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyos par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sangs rgyas 'od zer snang bas khyab// de nyid 'dom gang 'od ni dba' rlabs gnyis// gnyis med gcig tu dag pas dbu ma nyid// dbyer med ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shing mchog la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rin chen brtan pa'i ljon pa'i shing*// de nyid byang chub sems las byung*// skyes pa sems bskyed rten gyur pas// rang byung tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nyan thos chen po rnams kyis dpag par dka' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zab pa shin tu zhi ba'i gnas// rdul med rnyog pa med pa'i thugs// bsam gtan rdo rje tshad med pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa chen po rnams kyis brtag par dka' ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gnas pa med pa'i gnas gyur pa// khyu mchog chen po byang chub sems// rang bzhan mi phyed mi dmigs pas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa kha lo sgyur ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas rgyun du zhugs pa rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'khor ba'i rgyun 'di mya ngan 'das// de nyid spang du med pas na// ye shes shes rab rab gnas pas// dag pa tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegag pa dge ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes phyir mi 'ong ba rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang phyir ldog pa med pa'i sems// 'di ni ye shes chen po'i ngang*// bla na med pa snying po'i sku// de bzhin nyid kyi tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug na rin po che'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// khams gsum snang ba sems yin phyir// sems de stong nyid rgyu med pas// gang du dri med gzhan don 'byung*// 'di ni tshul chen gsang ba yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa snyems bral sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zag pa zad pa rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du zag med 'byung ba med// khams dang dbang po yul med par// shin tu dri medayi// rdzu 'phrul snang ba bstan nas 'dul byed pa// rang 'byung bsam gtan thob ste ltos med pa// gsang ba 'dir gnas ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba tshangs pas dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thog ma med cing mtha' med pas// srid rtser mi gnas dbang phyug che// dngos po med cing rtag pa che// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med par grags pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas brgya byin gyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i tingigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// nyon mongs 'ching ba dag pa yi// sred len rkyen grol log pas na// dmigs med ye shes gsang ba nyid// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa dga' ba'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba khyab 'jug gis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang nas gang du khyab bya ngo bos stong*// thams cad bdag med stong pa zhi ba'i phyir// sems can khams med 'jug par mi gnas pas// ye shes chen po'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan lha'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba lha ma yin rnams kyis dmigs su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sa 'og sa steng dang*// sa bla rnams su bstan pa yi// dngos grub bdud rtsi thob byed pas// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal na tshod bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba klu rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku// dug med gdug pa rnam bral bas// skyon med gtsang ba'i rang bzhin can// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha dga'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa mngon par rol ba srin mo rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdag med mnyam pa nyid thob pas// grub pa med pa'i gnas la ni// 'chi med ye shes tshul mchog gis// gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sbas pa ye shes nam mkha'i bu mo'i rnams kyis dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya rnams kyis rtogs par dga' ba thams cad kyi gnas pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rin chen gter 'chang mdzod po che// nor gyi rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa// de nyid sa dbang bde gshegs rgyal// gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i gnas pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sbas pa 'jig rten pa thams cad dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi skye dgu'i chos las dben pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// skyes bu chen po thams cad kyi// ye shes gnas ni mnyam med pas// rang gzhan mi phyed byang chub che// sems dpa' tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gang du 'gro la gnas gyur pa'i// gsang chen 'dir ni gnas gyur na// gang la'ang dri mar mi 'gyur zhing*// dgag par bya ba ci yang med// las rnams thams cad byas kyang ni// rang byung skur ni rnam par grol// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las dag pa'i skyes bu bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o// //sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba mi 'gyur ba'i don bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu mthor gshegs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi mchod rten 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri med ye shes dag pa'i gnas// rin chen phung po gsal ba yi// dang zhing yid 'phrog 'byung ba'i gzhi// sa ler sgrib med tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par skye ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mngon par 'byung ba 'phags pa'i lam// nyes pa spongs pa'i tshul mchog gis// rnam par mthor gshegs 'og min te// zab pa brjod med tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros bzang po mthong ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgyal ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /chos kun mnyam dang mi mnyam pa// kun mkhyen kun 'gro thams cad pa// dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 'jig rten 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid gnas pa gcig pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa po// mnyam nyid 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun rtog pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin gnas// cher mi g.yo ba rang bzhin med// rtsol med 'byung ba dag pa yi// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skal ldan shing rta chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpe byad las 'das pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bcom ldan so so rang rig pa// gtso bo dpe bral ye shes te// bdag po kun 'gro kun khyab pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rgyal ba bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos po mi dmigs pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// byed pa po dang 'phrog pa'ang med// 'di ni dpal ldan rang byung sems// dngos po gsal dang mi gsal mdzad// ye shes snang ba'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba bkod pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes chen po bla na med pa bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gnyis med gnyis las grol ba yi// ye shes rang las skye bar 'gyur// de nyid mngon rgyu spong byed pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gdeg par mdzad pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad snang ba yang dag pa rdo rje gnyis su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po med pa sgom pa min// dngos por yang dag bsgom du med// gang du ro mnyam mchog gi dngos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi glang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems can kun gyi bsam pa 'di// 'jigs pa med pa'i ngang gnas na// bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis med gnas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros 'od 'phro'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes blo gros mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// shes rab mkha' la rnam par gnas// snying rjes sad pa'i mda' yis ni// bde ba chen po'i rnam par 'bigs// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ri bo'i rgyal mtshan rnam par grol ba'i dpal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems dang shes rab ting nge 'dzin// rnam grol mtha' la mi gnas pa'o// dgos pa kun gyi 'ching ba bral// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen spos bzangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje mi zad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chu kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gnyis med bde ba mchog tu zhi// mkha' mnyam rtog pa las grol ba// gnyis med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos bstan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnas pa che// brtan g.yo dag pa'i tshul mchog gis// dbyer med tshul 'di dag pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid drag shul can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud dpung thams cad pham par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rtog pa ngan pas brtags pa yi// phyi rol yul ni rdzas stong pas// thabs dang shes rab rnam dag nyid// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi nor bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dra ba gcod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bde ba chen po gcig nyid kyi// nang du snod bcud dngos po'i chos// kun rdzob bden pas stong pa'i phyir// 'dus pa der gnas tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bzang pos byin pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab skems par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du gnyis med ngang gnas pa// rang bzhin rtog tshogs rab zhi bas// snang gsum ye shes dag gyur pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i bla mas sangs rgyas srid pa'i tshang tshing 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyi rol nga rgyal log bcom ste// ye shes gcig pu bdag dag pas// rang byung bsam pa rnam par dag /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyis log rtog 'joms pa'i ri bo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungasaso// kun tu rtog pa rab spangs nas// 'dod chags chags bral ye shes las// dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur te// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang rig nas ni byang chub 'gyur// 'di nyid tha dad rtog min zhing*// gzugs dang rnam thar sgo thim pas// chos rgyun thob phyir bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// 'gro ba rnams kyi bde ba rtags dang bcas 'byung ba// gang yin mtshan ma spangs bar gyur pa'i phyir// rang byung ngo bo ye shes bdag nyid de// rtogs pas stong pa'i bde ba mi zad yin// rlung gi rtog pa'i rjes su 'jug pa na// bde ba rang sems ngo bo dam pas ni// tshim 'gyur de las gzhan du g.yo mi 'gyur// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid gnas pa yin// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i mdzod chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bstan pa'i don to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba mi 'gyur ba'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o//

//'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshungs pa med pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba dri ma med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs kun 'dus pa yi// sangs rgyas spro bsdu'i 'khor lo yis// rtse mor gyur pa'i phyag rgya yis// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs par skyes pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba chos rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang byung ye shes zhi ba'i dngos// dag pa rnam dben mngon par 'byung*// phun sum tshogs pa lam gyur gnas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa dpe med pa'i tshogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba rigs rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du lha dang lha mo dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// ye shes las skyes mtshungs med pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rigs rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gdug pa can rnams gdul bya'i phyir// snying rjes gtum pa'i nga ro yis// tshar gcad pa nyid bla med bsgral// de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lha dang lha min lto 'phye dang*// grul bum la sogs sna tshogs pas// bstod cing mchod pa'i ye shes gnas// rin chen 'khor lo brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dka' thub chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che'i nor bu rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de nas ye shes nor bu ni// sna tshogs 'dod pa don byed pa// dpag med yon tan 'byung ba'i dbyings// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pa

V'i phreng ba rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du 'dam skyes me tog dang*// chu skyes paV gsal ba yang*// 'bar ba kha phye 'od khyab pas// dag pa ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan brtsegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi las kyi ral gri rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du rtog pa gcod pa dag /rnam par bdud tshogs rab 'joms pas// ye shes me 'od rgyas pa yis// kun tu rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sna tshogs 'dul ba rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung*// gsang ba mi zad mchod pa'i gzhi// de nyid kun tu khyab byed pas// gsang ba dag pa'i mchod pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsung/byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dir ni brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// thabs dang shes rab sgra rnams las// sna tshogs skad du chos ston pa// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog 'byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugasabaden par gsungs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rin chen sna bdun rang byung ba'i// yon tan sgyu rtsal sna tshogs pa// thams cad bsam pa'i stobs yin pas// de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan pa// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'tsho byed gsung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las rdo rje rjes su dran pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs bzang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sna tshogs dbang po'i rim// de nyid thabs tshul tha dad pas// ldog pa'i dbye ba du mar bstan// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa na tshod bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rigs can sna tshogs du ma'i snang ba la// ye shes rang 'byung 'gag pa med par ni// thugs rje chen po mi zad stobs las 'byung*// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i tshogs can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khro bo rjes su dran pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du gdug pa 'dul byed pa// 'byung po ma lus tshar bcad cing*// rjes su gzung phyir khro bar bstan// de nyid thugs rje'i tshul bstan pa'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par nges pa'i blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems can rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du dmigs pas 'jug med par// sna tshogs khams gsum skye gnas pa// mi g.yo ngang las snang med par// chos dbyings gcig par tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid mtha' nor bu'i spos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ma skyes pa rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang gi skye bas bsdus pa'i dngos// stong nyid gcig tu ma skyes pas// skye ba med pa'i tshul can te// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rig pa rdo rje rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ngo mtshar sna tshogs 'phrul ba yi// bzo yi gnas dang gso sbyong sogs// mkhyen pas thabs lam mkhas par bya// de nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snang ba rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// blo snang yul dang dbang po yis// du ma'i dngos po snang ba la// ldog pa dang ni rjes su 'gro// de nyid gsang ba'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// lus gnas cha shas med par rtogs// nges 'byung de bzhin cha shas med// cha shas can dang cha med pa// shes nas 'dir grol the tshom med// dul med pas// sgra las 'das shing yon tan spangs// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// // rnal 'byor chen pos 'dul ba don yod pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du dngos po rnam dag pas// yul rnams sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid can// dus gsum gcig par bsdus pa yis// thams cad mkhyen par tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par sbyong ba'i tshul las ni// tshul bzhin ma yin rnam gcod cing*// dben pa nyon mongs las ldog gang*// tshul 'di gsang ba thob pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa rab zhugs te sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya mi zad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyir mi ldog paragazhan don du// byang chub sems kyi brtson pa yis// tshad med dbugs 'byin chen po nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul 'od zer sangs rgyas thamasapa thub pa brtul zhugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// snying po byang chub mchog sems las// tha dad rgyas thebs gcig pa'i sku// ye shes de nyid tshu /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i tshogs 'chang ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdud tshogs rnams las rnam rgyal ba// de nyid ye shes rlung las ni// zag med zhi bas mchog tu bde// gnyis med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhing khams rnam dag rnams dang ma dag dang*// gdul dka'i sems can rnams phyir 'dul bar ni// bung ba me tog bzhin du rab 'jug pa// byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glang chen seng ge sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje mi zad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ye shes gang du 'du ba yi// ye shes mngon par 'byung ba gang*// de nyid chags med rnam dag pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po dbang phyug gi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun tu rgyas pa'i gnas bstan pa// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dbang phyug gis// lhun grub phyag rgyas rab rgyas pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spong ba'i rdo rje mchog ces bya ba'i ta par ston par zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di ni dpal gyi stobs mchog ste// dri med chu skyes yongs 'dzin pa// phra ba ge sar mchog thob pas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya mtsho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul med pa'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam pa kun tu dri ma med// bskyod pa med cing 'dzin bral bas// chos nyid ngang du ro mnyam pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer mnga' dbang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'brug sgra dbyangs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams kun gyi snang ba ni// rtogs dka' bdag med mtshan ma med// byams pa'i rang bzhin gzhan phan brtson// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi ba'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun tu 'jam dbyangs ka la ping ka'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan gsung gi gnas// yan lag drug cu thogs med du// 'gyur ba'i brjod pa las skyes pa'i// skad du ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dgyes pa'i mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam par ma bzhag stong pa yis// rtag tu mnyam pa'i tshul gnas nas// 'gyur med sna tshogs khyab byed pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med pa' ི dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i chu klung skems par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// srid pa 'di nyid spang med par// mi gnas mnyam pa'i ngang las ni// bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rlung shugs bcu pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// skye gnas 'byung las gyur pa la// 'dod pa'i snang ba 'gro zhing lding*// de nyid sems can gnas mthong phyir// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs la dgyes pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha klu thams cad kyis mchod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du mchod phyir ye shes kyi// chags med kun tu bzang po yi// bden pa'i byin rlabs thogs med pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las rnal 'byor chen po'i 'dul ba don yod pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu gcig pa'o// //sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje gsang ba gsum gyi mthar// rdo rje bkod pa snying po che// gsang ba dam pa bka' stsal pa// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i// ye shes snang ba bstan pa'o// rang lus lhar gsal byang chub sems// gang du srog dbus bzhugs pa na// ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas// man ngag gis ni rlung bsdus te// de tshe bzlas pa brtan gyur pas// de nyid ye shes mchog thob 'gyur// mi g.yo mi rtog phra ba'i sems// mi mngon gsal min dbu mar bzhugs// de nyid rnal 'byor mchog ces bya// stong pa nyid dang mnyam sbyor bas// de nyid mngon par byang chub pa'o// de nyid gsal bas bde ba ni// sgyu ma goms pas 'chang bar 'gyur// ji srid sgyu ma ma gsal bar// de srid goms pas 'jug par bya// rab tu gsal ba'i gnas thob pas// rang dge'i ye shes thob par 'gyur// de nyid ye shes bde chen po// thig le'i gzugs can gcig pu nyid// snying dbus mi shigs sems gcig bdag

/de nyid ye shes rang stong pa// sgyu mar ngo bo nyid kyis gsal// gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor pas// ye shes 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i blos// mkhas pas mthong bas brtag par bya// thog mtha' med pa'i ye shes ni// ma byung bcos min lhan cig skyes// rang rig gnas ni 'dir thob pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba chen po la dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu dpal snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du ye shes sa gzhi las// sna tshogs myu gu bskyed pa'i rgyu// rten 'brel tshogs phyir thob pa nyid// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu stobs dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rgyal po rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyes par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lus kyang sems la mi gnas te// sems kyang ngag la mi gnas te// kun tu gnas med mkha' lta bur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sna tshogs mchod pa'i bkra shis rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms nga nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du 'dod chags la sogs pas// zil gnon de las thar ba yi// char pas zug rngu sel byed pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid sku rdo rje ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhing khams kun la khyab gyur pa'i// lus can kun la rnam par snang*// de nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid gsung rdo rje ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// stong gsum khams su grags byed pa// gling kun skad cig dbyangs kyis ston// du mar de nyid ston pa po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje ngo bo nyid ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du 'khor los sgyur ba yi// chos kyi 'khor los dbang bskur bzhin// 'gro kun ye shes dbang bskur ba'i// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid bsgyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gang*// chos nyid mnyam pa'i de bzhin nyid// mtshungs med da ltar 'dir rtogs na// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog gi rtse mo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun tu 'phrul pa'i ོda pa ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dpag med sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis// ma dag dag par gang bsgyur ba// thams cad blo gros bzang po thob// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgya chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdud kyi 'ching ba las 'das phyir// chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po yis// khams gsum kun la khyab par bya// de nyid gsang ba bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'jig rten snang bar byed pa re re zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'od gsal shin tu rnam dag pa// dngos po ma spang ye shes che// chos dbyings klong na bde bar gnas// byang chub kyi tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa dpal gyi 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i gdugs kyis khyab par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// skye bas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// skyob phyir tshad med gdugs kyis ni// kun nas kun tu khyab par byed// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdud 'dul bar mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bdud ma lus pa 'joms pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// log lta ma lus mun pa'i gzhi// sangs rgyas ye shes sgron me yis// skad cig gcig la sel mdzad pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa go cha bgos pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje mchog tu sra ba snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yan lag bzhi ldan mtshon cha mchog /de nyid bsrung ba bla na med// pha rol rgol ba bzlog pa po// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i phyag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kha lo sgyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyag rgya sna tshogs thabs rol pa// 'bar phreng du ma'i spro ba can// mi zad ye shes byang chub sems// stong nyid de nyid tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi dung bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas par// rab ston dam pa'i chos kyi sgra// rnam pa kun tu grags pa'i dbyangs// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mthon po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi rab tu brdungs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du chos kyi don ston pa'o// tshad med bsdu dngos bzhi dag gis// sdud cing grol byed theg pa'i mchog /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i sa 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos kyi rnga bo che sgrog pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rtog pa med pa rin chen rnga// bde gshegs gsungs ni bstan pa'i phyir// rtag tu skul ba'i sgra 'byung ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gyi blo mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gdul bya'i bsam pa mkhyen nas ni// rtog med ye shes khams 'jug pas// chos kyi 'khor lo bstan pa ni// byang chub tshul mchog bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen gyis// rig pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang*// thabs cig rol pa bstan mdzad de// gsang ba gsungs pa'i don brjod do// ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// dngos po ci bzhin rang rig la'ang*// rgyu 'bras bye brag tha dad pa// ma 'dres ye shes tshul du gnas// nang gnas ji bzhin phya snying po gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u ste so gnyis pa'o//

//mnyam pa nyid 'byung ba bstan par gyur pa'i le'u/༈ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag po chen po byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la mchod pa'i sprin du mas mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// gsang ba bsdus pa'i dgongs rgyud de// mi phyed ye shes mchog sgrub pa// bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol// zhes zhus shing gsol ba btab pa dang*// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag pos de bzhin gsheg pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab par mkhyen cing byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus pa chen po de dag gi sems kyi kun tu rtog pa yang thugs kyis mkhyen nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// gang du yang 'di ltar lhan cig g.yo ba dang ldan pas dbang po sgo lnga'i rjes su mngon par 'gro la snang ba dbang po don dang phrad par gyur pa mched pa gsal ba las dbang pos dngos por dmigs pa thob pa dang ldan pa'o// gal te sems nyid dngos po'i rang bzhin du ma gyur na de ltar na'ang 'di dag sems nyid yin pas rnam pa thams cad kyi phyi rol gyi don skye ba yod pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar ma lus pa'i rang bzhin 'di dag brtags pas stong pa'i sems nyid de/ skye ba dang 'gag pa dang bral zhing rang bzhin gyis dag pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par yongs su gsal ba'o// chos rnams thams cad sems yin te// lus dang sems ni dbyer med de// rten dang brten pa 'jug ldog gis// kun gyi gnas su shes par bya// mkha' dbyings rdo rje stong nyid de// dbus gnas mngon par byang chub brjod// de nyid me long ye shes ldan// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu brtag

/nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes te// bdun dang ldan pa'i dbus nyid du'o// sngags ni dbus su gnas gyur gang*// sa bon so sor rtog pa ste// mngon par byang chub pa nyid do// rdo rje la sogs gang gnas pa// sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya// yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs// zhal gsum rtsa gsum brjod par bya// sku gsum lus ngag yid yin te// de nyid mngon par byang chub brjod// rnam par 'phro bar bsam bya ste// rdo rje 'khor lo pa

V dang*// nor bu ral gri 'bar ba las// 'gro drug rtog pa gcod phyir te// ye shes drug pa'i bdag nyid can// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor bas// bla med mngon par byang chub brjod// lus ngag yid ni byang chub pa// gsang ba dngos po'i don yin te// lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// ngag ni 'byung ba lnga dag dang*// yi ge sgra dang sngags rnams te// brjod pa dang ni dbyangs rnams kyis// ngag gi chos ni bsdus pa yin// sems ni ye shes lnga dag dang*// thig le bde ba nyid dang ni// snang ba gsum dang mi rtog pas// sems kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// sna tshogs gzugs can sems kyi dngos// srid gsum chos dang chos min dang*// sa 'og sa steng sa bla ba// skye gnas 'byung ba brtan g.yor bcas// sems nyid lus ni nam mkha'i khams// gzhi dang rten dang khyab byed pa'o// mi gsal phra zhing brtag dka' bas// rnam par shes pa'i snang ba la// snang ba mngon par thob pa las// bag chags sa bon yul rnams kyis// thams cad rang las 'byung ba nyid// mi gnas ye shes lus la gnas// ye shes lus ni 'gag med de// dngos med stong bar mi 'gyur te// lus med lus ni ro mnyam pa// lus la thog ma dmigs su med// tha ma 'gag pa med pa ste// gsang ba gsum du rnam sbas pas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'di ni 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa// nyams dang myong ba dbyer med de// zhi gnas lhag mthong gzugs can yin// bde dang gsal ba mi rtog pas// snang ba gsum gyi rnam pa ste// de nyid zhen pas 'ching bas na// srid pa gsum ni rtag pa'i dngos// phra ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la// gsang ba'i sku gsung thugs ye shes// rdo rje gsum du gsang ba nyid// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa// 'gro kun bde gshegs rang bzhin can// lus ni sna tshogs mi bzad pas// sku yi gsang ba bsam mi khyab// du ma'i gzugs kyis ston par byed// 'gro ba chos lam dpal ldan pas// ngag gi brjod pa mtha' yas pa// gsung gi gsang ba bsam mi khyab// sgra dbyangs so so'i skad du sgrogs// sems can sangs rgyas snying po can// sems ni dran rtog dpag med pas// thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab// sems can sku gsung dbyer med pas// lus ngag yid gsum mi phyed pa// rdo rje gsum du rtag gnas pas// de phyir rgyal ba'i ye shes sku// dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa// brjod du med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// de nas byang chub sems dpa' che// kun tu bzang pos legs zhus pa// rnal 'byor rgyud 'dir gsungs pa yi// rlung gi dbye dus mtshan nyid dang*// spro bsdu rim pa rgyu tshul dang*// khyad par gsang ba bshad du gsol// de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang*// gsang ba'i dbyings nas bka' stsal pa// a ā/

i ī/ u ū/ e ai ma shar ba mnyam gnas rlung*// lte ba'i gnas su brjod pa yi// i zhes sgra tsam du brjod pas// rdo rje yon tan bzlas pa ste// cung zad dros pa'i drod yin te// snying ga'i gnas su mi shigs pas// yi ge ī ru mngon pa ni// rdo rje thugs kyi bzlas pa ste// phyed dus gyen du rgyu ba nyid// mgrin pa'i gnas las bskyed pas na// u zhes thung rgyu ngag tu gyur// rdo rje thogs med bzlas par bshad// phyed yol dus su rgyu ba'i rlung*// mig la gnas pa'i rnam pa yis// ū zhes rab tu brjod pa nyid// rdo rje 'dod chags bzlas par brjod// dgong ga rab tu rgyu ba nyid// rna ba la ni rab gnas pa// e zhes kun gyi brda ru brjod// mtshan mo'i chu la rnam par rgyu// sna yi rnam shes ldan pa ste// i zhes gsang ba ser sna 'dzin// rdo rje gti mug bzlas par brjod// srod la shin tu rgyu ba ste// lce la mngon par dbang bas na// o zhes sna tshogs sgra brjod pa// 'gog pa khro bo'i bzlas par brjod// nam phyed yang dag rab rgyu ba// ba spu'i tshigs kun khyab pas na// au zhes tshig tu smra bar ston// 'di ni dam tshig bzlas par gsungs// srog rtsol dbu mar 'jug pa ni// aṃ zhes bde bar ldan pa ste// rtsa gnyis gzung 'dzin rlung 'gags pas// aḥzhes stong pa'i sgo yin no// gung gnyis rtsa ba'i rtsa yin te// gzhan du yan lag nyid du 'gyur// ā li bcu gnyis dag dang 'dres// de dag dbye ba'i rim pa yang*// bla ma'i kha las rtogs par 'gyur// rlung gi bye brag bshad pa ni// tshes gcig snga dro zla ba ste// stong pa'i srod la nyi ma rgyu// tshes brgyad tho rangs rlung nyid de// nyi shu gnyis la cha snyoms pas// de yi grangs ni bstan pa la// chu ni nyis brgya nyi shu lnga// sa dang me dang rlung dag la'ang*// de nyid bzhin du mnyam par 'gyur// dbyug gu gnyis la chu nga ni// drug brgya 'byung bar rgyu ba yin// chu tshod sum cu gnyis la ni// dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi yin// de dag 'byung ba 'dzin pa ni// chu sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyu// zhi ba'i las ni nyi shu bzhi// sa ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi las// de yi dus su rgyas pa'i las// gnyis pa'ang de dang mnyam pa la// dbang dang drag po'i las la shis// rlung gi rim pa de dag kyang*// lugs 'byung dang ni lugs bzlog pa// dgra zun du ni rgyu ba dang*// ma dang bu ru rgyu ba dang*// rang thog tu ni rang rgyu dang*// gzhan thog tu ni gzhan rgyu dang*// pho mo phrad par 'byung ba dang*// ma ning dag tu 'byung ba dang*// bsnol mar rgyu dang rkyang pa ste// de dag don ni gsal rnyed 'gyur// sa dang chu ru phrad pa sogs// de bzhin gzhan la'ang sbyar bar bya// gsal dang mi gsal rnam pa yis// de yi bye brag shes par bya// phrin las bzhi yi bye brag gis// chu yi rlung ste ngos gzung ba/

/phyogs dang dbyibs dang mdog rnams dang*// ring thung rgyu ba phyi nang gis// lha mo bzhi dang gnas bzhi dang*// dal dang rtsub dang sbom pa dngayon dang g.yas su rab sbyor bas// rim pa ji bzhin rab tu rgyu// g.yon gyi mgrin pa nas brtsams te// lte ba'i dkyil 'khor mthar gyur pas// zla ba'i rtsa ni 'og tu blta// shel dang ā li rab 'bab pa// g.yas su'ang lte ba nas brtsams te// mgrin pa'i rtsar ni gyen bskyod pa// nyi ma'i rtsa ni gyen du blta// dmar dang kā li 'byung zhing 'bab// 'byung byed sna yi bu gar gnas// rgyu ba rtsa yi mtshan nyid can// 'jug pa g.yon nas thur du 'gro// 'byung ba g.yas rtsa gyen du bskyod// ji srid nyi ma shar ba nas// nub kyi bar la nyin mo'i cha// ji srid nub pa nyid gyur pas// nam langs bar du mtshan mo'i cha// mtshams las bar mar gyur pa dang*// nyin mtshan gnyis la zhag gcig ste// de las dus bzhir gnas pa yin// de las nyin dang mtshan mo yis// thun tshod brgyad du 'gyur ba yin// yan lag bcu drug dag yin te// thun ni phyed phyed dag tu rlung*// sna yi bu gar yang dag rgyu// yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas bzung nas// nyin zhag gsum du thun phyed la// zla ba'i rlung ni rab rgyu ba// de nas gzhan gsum nyi ma'i rlung*// 'dis ni go rim ji srid du// yar tshes bco lnga'i bar du'o// mar ngo'i tshe gcig nas bzung ste// nyin zhag gsum du snga dro'i cha// grags pa nyi ma'i rlung rgyu ba'o// de bzhin tshes ni bco lnga'i bar// thun re yi ni bzhi pa rnams// chu tshod du ni brjod pa ni// nyin zhag gcig gi dus kyi cha// sum cu rtsa gnyis brjod par bya// de las bsgres pa'i dbyug gu ni// drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs kyis ni// phyed phyed bstan pas dbyug gu yin// sna rtse'i rlung gi rgyu ba dag /'byung dang 'jug dang gnas pa las// dbugs gcig tu ni brjod pa yin// de nyid rlung gi sbyor shes pas// dbugs drug srog tu shes par bya// srog ni lnga bcu tham pa dang*// dbugs gsum rkang pa de dang ldan// nyi ma byang du rgyu dus kyi// nyi ma dang po'i dbyug gu yin// nyi ma lhor ni 'byung dus kyi// mtshan mo yang ni de bzhin 'gyur// dbyug gu re re 'phel 'grib ni// dus kyi dbye bas shes par bya// dbugs ni drag po bzhi char bcas// 'pho ba so so'i 'phel 'grib yin// dbugs kyi sum cha de'i bzhi cha'i// drug chas nyi ma re rer 'gyur// thun ni phyed phyed rgyu ba las// phyin ci log tu 'phor gyur na// rtsod pa la sogs nges 'gyur bas// mkhas pas 'di dag yang dag brtag

/nyi ma bdun gyi bar dag tu// phyin ci log tu rgyu ba ni// de tshe rtsod pa chen por 'gyur// zla phyed bar du log rgyu na// nad chen po ni yang dag 'byung*// zla ba gcig tu log rgyu na// snying brtse'i gnyen phyogs brlag par 'gyur// phyed dang gnyis su log rgyu can// thun mong dus su shes par bya// gzhan yang khyad par bshad bya ba// mnyam po drug tu nyin ma song*// gang tshe skyes pa nyi ma zla// de tshe rgyas pa zhes bya'i dus// 'chi bar nges pa'i dus yin no// dang po dus sbyor gang shes pa// gang zhig gzhan yang bdun de'i phyir// des ni nyi ma mnyam bdun song*// mnyam po drug ces bya ba bshad// nyi ma'i lam ni thams cad du// rlung ni rtag tu rgyu ba dag /rgyun mi 'chad par yang dang yang*// mkhas pas dus ni mtshon par bya// dus kyi skad cig gang la rlung*// bgrod pa bzhin du 'jug gyur na// de yi 'pho ba rdzogs 'gyur tshe// srog ni gtong bar the tsom med// 'dir ni 'chi bdag bzhon 'dod pas// nyin zhag gcig gi chu tshod kyi// brgyad cha re re'i bar dag tu// srog dang rtsol ba bsdams nas ni// rtsa gnyis nas ni 'byung ba dang*// 'jug pa dbu mar lam gyur ba// spar dang sreg dang bzhu ba dang*// shin tu 'bar ba'i dus dag tu// lo drug bar du gnas byas na// 'chi bdag 'joms par the tsom med// g.yas nas chu tshod bzhi dag dang*// de bzhin g.yon nas chu tshod bzhi// dbu mar shin tu bsdams byas la// bdud las rnam par rgyal ba thob// rdo rje gsang ba 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang bdud las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i tingange 'dzin tos pa las// chos kyi phung po de snyed thob// sa re thob cing rlung 'gags pas// bcu pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshe// dam tshig mngon du gyur pas na// nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa yin// sa brgyad par ni gyur pa'i tshe// nyon mongs phung po rags pa ni// khri phrag brgyad pos spangs pa na// phyir mi ldog pa zhes brjod do// lhag ma drug brgya stong phrag gcig

/snga ma'i gnas su rang dag ste// las kyi rlung rnams dag pa yin// khri phrag gnyis ni zag med rlung*// sa bcu pa la phyin dus su// grangs 'bum gyi ni rnam pa nyid// dam tshig dag tu bstan pa'o// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ni// sa bcu po la gnas pa yis// chos kyi sprin du gyur pa yin// phrin las rigs lnga'i bzlas pa yis// sa lnga pa ni mngon du byed// khro bo dam tshig bzlas pa yis// drug pa mngon du gyur pa thob// dus gsum dag pa'i bzlas pas ni// legs pa'i blo gros thob par byed// dam tshig mi 'da' bzlas pas ni// sa bcu mngon du gyur pa ste// rgyal ba'i rlung las 'phos pas ni// bsam mi khyab tu gyur pa ste// zag par bcas pa'i rlung dag ni// rags par gnas pa de snyed yin// phra bar gyur pa'i rtog pa ni// khri phrag brgyad las 'das nas ni// stong phrag bzhi bcu 'das pas ni// spang bya de snyed dang rtog pa// bag la nyal ba spong ba yi// zag med rlung ni khri phrag gnyis// ye shes dam tshig mngon 'byung ba// 'bum du brjod pas bsdus pa'o// khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag gcig /lhag pa drug brgyar bcas pa gang*// las kyi rlung du brjod par bya// de yang bsdus pas thun grangs la// dus sbyor chen po bcu gnyis te// dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin// ro hi ta dang mo hi ta// £ dra pri ṣa £ sha ba// ku ra ma ma ka raṇ+ḍa// ki ra dang bi dri ka /byā ku li dang swa pan// kā ma na ru brjod par bya// 'byung dang 'jug dang gnas pa dag /gcig tu gyur pa dbugs yin te// dbugs drug chu srang gcig yin te// chu srang sum cu dbyug gu phyed// dbugs drug gis ni dbyug gu phyed// dbyug gu gnyis la chu tshod gcig /chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis las/ོnga pas// rnam par dbye ba mkhas pa yis// zag bcas rlung ni khri phrag brgyad// lhag pa stong phrag bzhi las ni// zag pa med pa'i rlung gyur pa// khri phrag gnyis kyis dag pa yin// rlung rags pas ni rtog pa'i tshogs// de dang mtshungs par 'jug pa yin// rtog pa bag la nyal gyur pas// rlung ni phra bar gyur pa ste// phra rags rtog pa dag pas ni// rlung ni shin tu phra bar 'gyur// rnam rtog dang ni rlung gnyis gang*// mtshungs par mnyam par 'byung 'jug las// rlung gi 'jug pa 'byung med par// rtog pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas// de phyir las kyi rlung dag ni// khri phrag gnyis dang stong dag dang*// drug brgya dag tu shes par bya// yi ge'i dbye ba'i gnas kyis ni// rang bzhin de phyir gsang ba'i yi ge yis// thams cad za zhing lding bar 'gyur// nam mkha' mtha' med rtag pa'i don// sems can kun gyi gnas chen po// dpal gyis 'byor pa bla med rgyal// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i// ā li bcu drug phrag gnyis las// zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa 'byung*// de yi rtsa ba thig ler bcas// sum cu gsum du gyur pa yin// kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi dang*// ya ra la wa da Z ste// bzhi bcu mngon par gnas pas na// 'dod chags rtog pa de snyed yin// zung gyur drug ldan thig ler bcas// mtshan ma bdun gyis mtshon pa'i phyir// dbus ma la brten gti mug pa'i// rang bzhin ma rig gyur pa'o// snga ma g.yas rtsa la brten pa// skyes pa rdo rjer bcas gyur brjod// gong du g.yon rtsa las 'byung ba// bud med paVི ting nge 'dzin to// de nas gsang ba rab tu 'dzin pa pos// khyad par sems gsum rim pa bka' stsal te// snang ba zhes bya rnam par mi rtog pa// gsal ba'i cha ste gzung rtog spangs pa las// 'byung ba mi mngon rlung dang bcas pa gang*// lhang nger gnas pa skad cig dang po yin// mched pa'i snang ba rab tu mi rtog ste// ches gsal ba las 'dzin rtog ma zhugs pa// ye shes phra ba rlung ldan mi snang ba// lhan ne gnas pa skad cig gnyis pa yin// thob pa'i cha ni shin tu mi rtog pa// gsal ba tsam du'ang mi gnas shin tu phra// rlung sems mi phyed gsal bar 'char ba min// lham me gnas pa skad cig gsum pa yin// nye bar thob pa dri ma med pa ste// rang byung rang gsal bde ba dmigs su med// phra rags rab gsal ting nge 'dzin du gnas// skad cig bzhi pa mi 'gyur khyab byed yin// 'od gsal ba ni bsam gtan zag pa med// rdul med sa bon med pas mi g.yo ba// lhan cig gnas pa chos sku'i snying po ni// lhun grub byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid// sgyu ma 'di nyid yod med las 'das shing*// dbu ma tsam du'ang mi gnas kun rdzob ste/

chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma'i snang ba las// 'gag pa med pa'i rol pa rang byung ba'o// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i mtshan nyid can// chos dbyings chos nyid dbyer med dag pa'i sku// tha dad rnam bral mi phyed ye shes te// gsang ba chen po'i lam las 'dir rtogs bya// thun mong dbang phyug dang ni rtags bcas pa// dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'char ba 'di nyid do// phra zhing yang la phra bar nub /phung po khams dang skye mched bsdus pa yi// lnga po'i dbye ba lnga ru byas pa la// de bzhin bshegs pa so sor byin gyis rlabs// 'khor ba'i las rnams dag ni rnam dag pas// de bzhin dbang po'i phyi rol yul bcas lnga// re re zhing yang bde gshegs lnga rnams kyis// de la rang rang rtag tu byin gyis rlob// ye shes lnga dang gsum du gnas pas yang dag bsdus// zhes gsungs te/ gsang ba zab pa'i tshul bstan pa rdo rje mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*// gsung dang*/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las mnyam pa nyid 'byung bar bstan par gyur pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste so gsum pa'o// //

chos kyi tshul bsdus pa mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u/༈ rtag pa gsum pa rdo rje gsang ba ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba rab tu gsang ba'o// de nas bcom ldan bde gshegs kun// gsang chen ye shes rdo rje 'dzin// sems can don du yang dag 'byung*// blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// don kun thub pa rdo rje 'dzin// rgyal ba de la btud byas te/ gsang ba dam tshig mkhyen pa la// mchod cing bstod pas gsang chen gyi// rdo rje dbyangs ni bshad pa yin// e ma tshul bzang sangs rgyas pa// de nyid rigs brgya bsdus pa'i sku// de nyid tshul mchod byang chub pa// rigs kyi sangs rgyas lngar bsdus pa// byang chub snying po tshul zhi ba// gsang ba rigs gsum bla na med// gsang ba'i tshul ni gcig pa nyid// rgyas gdab rdo rje sems dpa' nyid// ye shes rim pa nyid du bstan// ma skyes pa yi rang bzhin las// khyad par ngo bo rang byung ba// yang dag rnam par mi rtog pas// bla med mngon par 'byung bar grags// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par// dpal ldan chos kyi rang bzhin sku// rtog pa'i dri ma 'gag byed pas/ sku gsum ye shes dkyil 'khor du// phra ba'i rnam par gzhug par bya// de nyid rnam shes 'pho ba'i dngos// gdan bcas sa bon thim par bya// sangs rgyas kun gyi bar snang khams// khyab cing bzhugs par rab bsgom pa// yi ge gsang ba rang sngags la// thim pa gcig tu bsdu bar bya// thugs kyi ngo bor bsam par bya// thams cad sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dngos kun rang bzhin mtshungs par blta// sangs rgyas thams cad sems su yang*// slar yang bsgoms nas de rab bsdu// gsang ba gcig tu dbang bya yi// 'pho ba sku gsum rim par 'byung// chos dbyings mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin// mi shigs 'od kyi gong bu las// nā da tsam du snang ba gang// mi 'gag rang bzhin dag par gnas// gsang ba rdo rje'i rin chen gyi// rab snang byed pa'i ting 'dzin bshad// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas bsags pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par rol pa 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams bdag med pa yi dngos// gnyug ma dbyer med stong nyid dang*// zad pa med cing 'phel med pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'bar ba'i tshogs can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dri ma med pa'i me 'od rin po che mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pa

Vོ rnam par rol pa'i 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa// skye med snying gi paV la// sa bon rdzogs pa'i snying po gang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'bar ba'i phung po sangs rgyas thams kyi rang byung gi rgyal po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zla ba'i snying po 'od 'phro ba// chu rgyun 'bab pa'i zer ldan gyis// bsam pa'i ye shes rgyun gyis ni// thogs med ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das srid pa las rgal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la rol pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sna tshogs dngos po'i chos nyid ni// spros pa med phyir snang med pas// theg pa mchog gi chos nyid kyis// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa ldan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i
