dngos// rtag dang chad pa las grol zhing// yang dag don mthong rang grol gnas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs snyan par sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri ma med pa'i chos nyid ni// gdod nas dag pa de bzhin gshegs// snying po ye shes byang chub pas// gsang ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes seng ge'i rtsal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las// thub pa don kun rdo rje 'dzin// mchod de rdo rje dbyings 'dir gsungs// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs chen gtso bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gnas 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byam chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gnyis su med pas 'du 'bral med// rnam par grol ba'i phung po can// bde chen sku ste skyon med pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phung po lnga dag pa'i stobs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ji srid 'gro ba'i bya ba dag// 'dus pa las ni skye bzhin pa// de yang yul las rab tu 'byung// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis byin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi grangs chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de nyid mnyam pa med pa yi// rdo rje zla ba 'dus las 'byung*// tha dad dmigs pa rab zhi bas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes skyob pa bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mkhyen pa dag pa chos kyi dbyings// rnam pa kun tu rang byung bas// 'gro ba'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa// thub pa ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen pos khyab par mdzad pa sangs rgyas

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can gsal ba'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 'gag pa rol pa'i sgra rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhing khams bye ba mtha' yas par// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbyings gcig gis// tha dad du mar khyab byed pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa mtha' yas chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi rtog pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ rtog pa sna tshogs bsdus pa yi// ye shes gcig gis gnas pa las// tha dad ting 'dzin dag pa'i ngang// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don yod 'od zer sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i yul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// ye shes rdo rje ro gcig par// pa ste// ma 'ongs bla ma'i gzugs kyis gnas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul mi zad pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// brtan g.yo ma lus snang ba'i gzhi// de nyid kun tu sgyur ba po// de nyid de bzhin gshegs pas sprul// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dge 'dun brtan pa'i bla sangs rgyas thams cad kyi klu dbang gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gdug pa ma lus gdon byung ba// de nyid rtog pa'i dra ba las// kun byung dag par 'dul byed pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gsang ba'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis// de nyid byang chub sems dpa' la// rab tu bskul te bstan pa gang// rab tu nyon cig rdo rje 'dzin// dkyil 'khor gang du bsgrub pa yi// gsang ba mngon par byang chub pa// rgyu dang rtags dang go cha dang// rnam pa lngar ni bstan pa ste// 'jug pa sbyor ba'i rim pa yis// dmigs pa bsdus pa nyid yin no// rlung dang sngags dang sgra las ni// rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'o// gang du sems kyi snang ba las// rab dben rim pa gnyis par brjod// rmi lam sgyu ma'i chos can las// bdag byin brlab pa'i rim par gyur// bsam gtan sbyor dang 'od gsal ba// mngon par byang chub rim pa nyid// de las gnyis med de bzhin nyid// rim pa lnga pa zung 'jug lam// lus sems ngag gi chos bsdus pas// tshul gsum mngon par byang chub pa// de nyid ye shes lnga dag tu// rigs kyi dbye bas bstan pa yin// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang// gsung dang// thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las chos kyi tshul bsdus pa mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u ste so bzhi ba'o//

// yongs su dag pa'i gnas rdo rje'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bzang tog skyes bu kha lo sgyur ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thabs dang bsam pa gang gang gis// lus 'di ོda pas bsgyur bas na// sems ni ting nge 'dzin gyis te// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ku sha'i rtse mo ltar phra mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi rol pa yi// bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes sku// rang rig nyid las tha dad med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkod ma'i chu 'dzin pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bde gshegs gdung ni rgyas pa gang// thugs rje dag pa'i stobs yin te// 'gro ba gso ba'i tshul gyis ni// byang chub ye shes bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rlung gi shugs 'chang ba ltar gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sman pa'i rgyal po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gro ba kun gyi 'khor ba yi// nad sel thabs mchog byams pa'i dpal// brtse sems tshad med srung ba po// zab pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs bsam grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi blo'i dri ma sel bar byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byam chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang bzhin rtog pa'i dri ma rnams// gzung 'dzin chos kyis bsdus pa'i dngos// dbu ma'i ngang du rang dag pas/

byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes chu bo'i rlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi chos kyi lam// tshul gcig theg pa gcig pa nyid// byang chub chen po bla na med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i tshogs chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhal med kyi gnas ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thams cad rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings// gzhi med rtsa bral 'dus ma byas// brjod med nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'grib pa med par bsrung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul rin po che'i zom zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos dang chos nyid med pa ste// pha rol phyin pa mnyam pa nyid// snang ba med cing rnam pa med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa don gyi blo gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi blo gros snang ba bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting te 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'jig rten mun pa sel mdzad cing// sa gsum gsal bar byed pa yi// glog gi 'od kyis 'char ba po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pheg rdob pa'i sgra snyan lta bur ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du chos kyi don 'byung ba// bla na med pa byang chub sems// ye shes rgyu dang 'bras bur ston// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grogs brtan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba'i mig ston pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis ni// lam gyi rim pa thams cad par// 'dam bzang chu yi bdud rtsi ltar// skal bzang de nyid tshul shes byos// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gnas mtshungs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhon nu'i zla ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub sems kyi 'di gsungs so// chos kyi tshul ni zhi ba nyid// bcu drug ye shes brgyan pa nyid/ skad cig bden pa byang chub pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i zhal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer kun nas snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gis// kun tu dbang bskur gyur pa yi// skal ba can ni kun tu bzang// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thar pa'i gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du rtog pas brtags pa yi// snang ba 'di ni sgyu ma tsam// de nyid las dang bag chags bral// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ngos bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku nyid ni// rnam pa du mas spungs pa gang// phra rab dbyer med dag pa'i rgyal// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpa' bo chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun tu ye shes rgyal ba yi// drod dang rtags las 'das pa'i chos// bsgom bya med cing dmigs med pas// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzi brjid snang ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin snang ba med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ི ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du// rang sems nor bu'i rgyal pos 'grub// 'di nyid rin chen mdzod chen po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs par gnas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bskul pa tshad med pa bla ma'i snying po rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi 'byung gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dkon mchog gsum gyi dpal ldan pas// rang rig ye shes gcig la rdzogs// rgyun du bde ba ster byed pas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bden par ston pa yang dag pa'i gnas blo gros bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bgrod med lam ni gcig pa'i chos// ye shes mig gi yul gyur pas/

mthar thug snying po byang chub mchog// rgyal ba'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsarnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las yongs su dag pa'i gnas rdo rje'i le'u ste so lnga pa'o// //gsang ba bla na med pa'i don yongs su skyong ba'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa blo bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rten 'brel yang dag 'byung ba las// kun rdzob nyid kyi chos nyid ni// dbyer med don dam rnam par dben// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa stobs sbyin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin chen sgron me 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po 'di dag ma skyes pas// de nyid dngos por mi gnas shing*// rang bzhin 'od gsal rtag pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bsta'adi bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gi tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog pa'i dba' rlabs g.yo ba med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rdo rje gsang ba bla na med// mnyam sbyor bde ba dri ma med// mi 'dzag mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rlung gi shugs kyis bskyod pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun tu mngon par mi gnas pa// gnyis med ye shes chos kyi rgyal// rnam par mi rtog chags med pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog ster mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnga sgra'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// snang srid ma lus bcom ldan 'das// thams cad stong pa nyid las skyes// de nyid ye shes rgyu 'bras can// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshim par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// stong nyid nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// sems nyid mnyam par mtshungs pas na// mi 'gag go 'byed khyab gyur pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye dgu'i bdag po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// stong nyid dngos po ma yin te// dngos min gyur pa'ang stong pa min// ngo bo nyid ni rnam dag pa// stong nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa chen po rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya smin par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byam chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'byung ba bzhi dag nam mkhar gnas// de nyid gang la'ang mi gnas te// sems can sangs rgyas la brten pa// sangs rgyas mi gnas tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi tshugs pa thub pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnga sgra'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gzod nas ma skyes dag pa nyid// srid zhi mnyam nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro 'ong rnam bral tshul thob pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpag bsam gyi shing lta bur bskyed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sa bon myu gu dang*// sdong bu 'dab ma 'bras bu'i bar// tshul brgyad 'gyur ba'i bye brag gis// rten 'brel de nyid tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ljon pa'i shing chen po ltar rgyas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gro snying rnam rtog zhes bya gang*// rang rig byang chub snying po'i gnas// de las yon tan brjod mi lang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs par gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha'i sil snyan 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mi rtag bdag med zhi ba yis// 'du shes sems pa sngon rgyu las// bag chags spangs pas gnas thob gyur// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i mthu rtsal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgra bung ba lta bur lding ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam par rig byed las 'das shing// de spangs bsam pa'i ldog pa yis// dbye bas tha dad shes par bya// 'di ni snying po'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes la dgyes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal zhing khams bkod pa phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi zhing khams gang*// snang mdzad rgyal po'i 'od kyi skus// rten mdzad ye shes snang ba nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa lha bden sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snang ba bai ḍū

4 ston pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'gyur ba med pa'i rin po che// gcig tu sgyur bar byed pa can// nor bu rtog pa'i blo bral ba// nges par tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mun pa smag rum sel ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'khor ba'i mun pa sel ba yi// byin rlabs 'od kyi sgron me yis// snang ba ston cing 'joms pa gang// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ye shes kyi snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtog pa'i rgyal po dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'dite/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// nges 'byung rnam par mi gnas pa// 'khor ba dag pa'i sems gnas pa// de nyid ye shes tshul gsum gyur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gang du sngon byung sangs rgyas dang*// ma 'ongs byon gyur de bzhin gshegs// da ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams// gsang ba 'di las yang dag 'byung*// sems kyi bslab pa la phyogs shing*// zab pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang*// de nyid mdo sder gang bstan pa// phyi nang gnyis su bstan pa yin// gsang ba bla na med pa'i don// snying po don rnams ston byed pa// 'bras bu rtogs pa'i ye shes ni// tshe 'di nyid la mngon gyur pas// thabs kyi khyad par gyur pa ste// rdo rje theg pa zhes brjod do// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba bla na med pa'i don yongs su skyong ba'i le'u ste sum cu drug pa'o/// /

theg pa'i lam rnam par dag pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u/ mnyam gyur pa// rnam par mi rtog ye shes las// sgyu ma tsam du bstan pa yin// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bur ni// gnas pa brjod bya don gyi chos// de nyid nges par don ston pas// rjod byed sgra yi phyogs su bshad// gsang chen theg pa snying po'i don// rgyal po che ba rang la gnas// mchog tu brtag pa 'dus pa ste// bden gnyis zung 'jug ston pa'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa lha'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de nyid gsang ba'i ye shes che// snying po phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*// zab dang rgya che'i tshul gnas pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs dbu sgyu ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba kun 'dus rig pa'i ngang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa gnas pas// sku bzhi ye shes mchog rtag pas// dri med 'dul ba'i tshul mchog go /zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dal gyis bzhud pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub sems// 'bad pa med par 'byung ba ni/ chos rnams dbyer med gcig pa'i sku// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs dka' thub sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpa' bar 'gro ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mthong chos don yod snying po ni// 'bras bu grub pa'i rkyen 'byung ba// de nyid sad byed rnam par thar// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsung/zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bden pa dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bsam gtan sbyor ba sgyu ma yi// nye bar 'grub pa yang dag pa'i// gsang mtha' tshul 'di nges bstan yin// di rgyan// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de nyid stong nyid mtshan ma med// smon pa med pa byang chub gzhi// rnam thar ye shes 'bras thob pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can bzang pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgyu ma lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos gang skye ba med pa dang// 'gag pa med par 'byung ba gang// bla med gsang ba'i don bstan pas// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smig rgyu lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams gzugs brnyan rmi lam dang*// sprul pa mtshungs par ston pa gang*// de nyid rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dngos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams rmi lam gzugs snang ltar// bag chags snang ba rang dag par// dri ma sbyang phyir bstan pa dag /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba'i me tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chu zla lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gcig gis du mar khyab pa yi// ngo bo rang stong thig le gcig /zhen med phyag rgya 'byung ba yi// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dri za'i grong khyer lta bur 'char ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i// dag pa'i ye shes yang dag pa// bcings pa med cing grol ba'ang med// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skrun par mdzad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// de sprul dman par mos pa 'dul// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mdangs 'gro dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chu'i chu bur lta bur mkhyen pa bla na med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lan tshwa rgya mtshor thim pa ltar// dba' rlabs zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis// thob med ye shes sbyor don 'gro// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa don legs nges sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mig yor stong pa'i dngos po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sad pas sad byed pa// kun nas ldang ba zhi ba yi// bsnyengs med don gsal byang chub pa// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khyu mchog tshad med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// srid las grol zhing bde thob dang*// mchog don gnas pa dag pa'i gnas// byang chub tshul dag 'khor lo yis// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lag bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang po'i gzhu dang mtshungs par ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bstan pa 'di ni byang chub lam// de nyid snying po sdom pa nyid// bslab pa yongs dag 'ja' tshon ltar// nges pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi glog gi 'od 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po ni// glog ltar 'byung ba'i yid kyis ni// kun tu phrin las bya ba las// 'jug pa'i tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsam pas byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprin 'phro ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas dus gsum thams cad du// dri med rtag par 'byung ba'i gzhi// legs mchod bsam pa'i rgyun 'bab ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas gsang ba'i rgyal po che// 'bras bu ston pa'i lam byung ba// mi phyed ye shes mnga' bdag 'chang*// zab dang rgya che'i tshul bstan pa'o// de nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i che// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dngos po kun// khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' yis// gzod nas dag pa'i ye shes gnas// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas med// gsang chen bde ba'i go 'phang can// zhes gsungs so/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*// gsung dang*// thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las// theg pa'i lam rnam par dag pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //gsang ba dag pa mchog gi le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rgyal po'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dul ba'i stobs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rtog pa'i dra ba bsal ba yi// ye shes rnam thar dag pa yi// gsal ba yongs dag rjes 'gro bas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje dbyings 'byung zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba chos 'byung yangs pa yi// dag pa dri med gnas kyi cha// cha dang cha min rnam spangs pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i sde sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nam mkha' dag pa'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos dang dngos med las grol zhing*// 'bar ba thig le nā da bral// ye shes sku ste rnam dag pas// gsang ba tshul 'di ba// gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan dang dpe byed dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lha dang mi rnams kun la yang*// de nyid ye shes skal ba can// bzang po srid gsum ga ye shes snang ba can// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bkra shis gdugs lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub sems 'di gsungs so// gling rnams kun gyi sems can khams// byams pa'i gdugs kyis khyab byed pa// mtha' sko chad med par gzigs// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'gros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pa V lta bur ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus// drang por smra ba'i ljags dbang po// ge sar dmar po ltar ston pas// de nyid tshul 'dibastan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid drag shul can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dung lta bur ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// tshad med thugs kyi gter chen po// rnam par dkar ba'i chos phyogs kyis// bar mtshams med par gnas thob pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bum pa lta bu rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdud las rnam par rgyal ba yi// bum pa chen pos don byed pa// thog ma med pa'i byang chub sems// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal gyi be'u rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du tshangs dang brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong bar bcas pa yi// mchod cing rdo rje'i dbang phyug sku// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa'i// kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu ltar// mi nub dam pa'i gtso bo yis// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid rnam par mdzes pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhabs dang phyag gi mthil 'khor lo'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thub pas 'gro ba'i ngan song rgyun// yongs su gcod cing sbyong mdzad pas// rnam par gnon pa'i mchog mnga' ban la chags med tshul du bskyang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sbrang rtsi'i zhal mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snyan par smra ba'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// skabs dang 'brel pa'i don 'gyur bas// cung zad yang dag don sbyor ba'i// phan pa ster ba'i byang chub kyis// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don mthun pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mthong na mi mthun med pa*// gtso bor gzhan don sems pa gang// kun snang dpe med mkhas pa po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu zhi bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi gnas pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ri rab rin chen lhun po ltar// brjid cing dpa' ba'i thub pa'i skus// sprul pa dngos por mi gnas pa// de nyid byang chub tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrug pa mi mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du tshogs nags khrod du// thub pa dpal gyi rgyal po ste// shākya'i dge slong li ts+tsha bī// gzhon nu 'phags pa'i blo can gyis// rim dang cig car rgyas par 'gyur// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*/
gsung dang*/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ gsang ba dag pa mchog gi le'u ste sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //

dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi cho ga ston pa'i le'u༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// stong khams kha lo sgyur byed pa// chos kyi rgyal po dge ba'i stobs// dpung chen thabs la mkhas pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi yon tan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang sems dag pa'i nor bu ni// yon tan du ma 'byung ba'i gzhi// mi zad dge ba rdzogs las 'byung*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhing bzang po mtshungs med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos 'dzin pa'i btsun mo rin po che 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba// mnyam med bla ma mchog dgyes pa'i// tshul 'di dri med 'od du 'gyur// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje rab rib sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'dam skyes pa V mdangs thon ltar// rang rig gsal ba'i ye shes nyid// skyon gyis ma gos phra ba nyid// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snang bar byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dri med u,la 'bar ba la// rnyog pa'i dri mas ma gos ltar// rang grol byung ba'i ye shes mtshungs// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sbyin byed 'od 'phro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgron me lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// mnyam nyid mi 'gyur snang ba bral// thob med thob bral 'gro 'ong med// dbri ba dang ni gang med pa'i// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa paVོ'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid las// 'gyur ba med cing 'pho ba med// rnam pa kun tu mkha' dbyings klong*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen bkod pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun tu son pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// skye ba med las gang skyes pa// de ni ma skyes sbyor ba'i dngos// tshad med ting 'dzin sbyor ba po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kun tu rol pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du 'gag pa bral ba yi// chos nyid rang byung lhun gyis grub// de ni 'gag pa med pa'i dngos// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul dang bral ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de bzhin nyid las dben pa yi// don dam dmigs pa'i yul min phyir// 'dres pa rdul tsam med pa las// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thugs shin tu zhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri bo gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gnas pa med pa gnas pa'i mchog /mchog gyur rang byung mkha' la ldir// thugs stobs chos kun 'bras bu che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mi zad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri rab lhun po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi nam mkha'i khams// yongs su gang ba'i chos can ma// til gyi 'bru bzhin rgyas pa yi// sangs rgyas tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud dang bdud kyi ris thams cad 'joms par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bdud dang log 'dren ma lus rnams// byams pa'i ye shes chen po yis// log rtog ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sna tshogs dag pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal be'u// 'bar ba 'od 'phro nyi ma'i dbus// dra ba rin chen nor bu ste// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i gzugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhal med kyi gnas dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dpe med ye shes dag pa'i gnas// bkod pa mdzes spras rnam brgyan pa'i// rang gzhan dkyil 'khor snang ba 'byung*// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa 'od 'phro ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// kun 'gro dbang phyug rdul bral ba// de nyid byang chub dam pa'i yul// btang snyoms dag pa bla med pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' dri med rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dren pa mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lta bas mi ngoms chog mi shes// rig pa dang ni zhabs mnga' ba// ngan 'gro'i srid pa legs skyob pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes grags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yongs su dag par bsngo ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yul dang dngos po byed pa po// rnam par mi dmigs stong pa nyid// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ste// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'gro ba'i sde dpon dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thar pa'i lam na theg pa che// gsang ba dam pa chos 'khor lo// rnam pa bcu gnyis yongs bskor ba// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par rtog pa'i dba' rlabs gnon pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dpag med ye shes phra ba yis// dngos por 'dzin pa'i byis pa rnams// skrag nas lam mchog dgod mdzad pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// ye shes bla med gnas thob pas// gtsang ma'i gnas mchog legs gnas pas// bcom ldan 'a sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi don 'byung ba rdo rje'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs thams cad/ dper na nam mkha' gang du yang*// mtshan can kun la mi gnas te// de nyid khyab cing bdag med pas/tshig las byung ba// de nyid sgyu mar gyur pa dang*// khyad par cung zad yod min te// rmi lam dang ni dngos snang gnyis// khyad par cung zad yod min te// gzhan du de nyid rtogs par bya// rlung dang bcas pa 'pho ba'i gnas// 'gro ba kun gyi mgrin par skyes// yi ge oṃ bcas gnas pa nyid// a nu ta ra brjod pa gang*// gzung zhing bsgyur dang spel ba dang*// sgyu mar dran dang rgyas gdab pas// rmis pa bsam gtan lam du 'gyur// kye bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmi lam de ni bdag gis khams gsum du rmi lam mthong bar bya'o snyam du'ang mi sems so// skyes bu de yang bdag gis rmi lam gyi chos mthong ngo snyam du'ang sems pa med de/ de bas na khams gsum du snang ba'i bya ba de rnams kyang*// bag chags gzugs su snang ba'i phyir// rmi lam lta bur bstan pa yin// 'khrul pa de nyid rgyu med pas// rmi lam nyid dang mtshungs par bstan// snga ma mi gnas rang grol te// phyi ma 'byung ba mi 'gag phyir// rmi lam las ni 'byung bar bshad// de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed pa rnams dang*/

sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang rmi lam la bdag med pa rdo rje yang dag par bden pas stong pa'i gnas su rtogs par bya'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgra rnam par bsgrags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gsang ba dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams rnam par dag pas ni// khams dang dbang po mtha' yas dang*// bsam pa'i dri ma rang dag pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rtag par brtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems can tha ma 'bring dang ni// mchog rnams bdud rtsi thob bya'i phyir// lhag par spro ba bskyed pa gang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pa V nas de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul rmad du byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'jig rten khams ni du ma yi// gling rnams kun du 'jug byed pa// cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa ni// 'byung ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnyog pa sel cing bsil ba tsaqna ltar ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du skye dang 'chi ba dang*// na dang rgas dang rgud las grol// chu bo che las sgrol ba po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa glog gi tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spros pa tshad med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gtong ba spro dang smra ba dang*// mtshungs pa rgyan las 'byung ba gang*// de nyid dad pa'i sems grol bas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od mtshungs pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'di yi 'od zer gang spros par// ting 'dzin bskyed dang dad pa thob// bde ba skyed la sdug bsngal zhi// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma can sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma rig pa dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byang chub sems gcig dag pa las// gzhan du ye shes ma rnyed pas// btsal du med pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rdzogs ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'du byed rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sangs rgyas zhing dag pa// de snyed byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags pa'i tshogs// rnam dag tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs paV'i snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ming dang gzugs rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du bsam pa dug med pa// phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi can te// zla ba tshes pa'i ngo bzhin te// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bul ni// bsod nams tshogs ni sgyu ma ste// ye shes tshogs ni nam mkha' ltar// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul sde can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi reg pa rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yan lag bzhi ldan dpung tshogs bcas// bla med rnal 'byor pa yi gnas// zhing dang bsam pa dag pa yis// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams gzi brjid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshor ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sgyu ma lta bu'i sbyor ba yis// 'gro ba kun la snyoms pa gang*// brtul zhugs khyad par bstan pa ste// tshul 'di byang chub snying po yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal mnga' ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sred pa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal dgyes pas khyab pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin lams par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed// dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas gang*// zhing khams gcig par yongs su dag /de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lha'i sgra can sangs rgyas kyi srid pa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyogs bcu rnam pa thams cad du// gang zhugs bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs// mdzad pa gcig pa'i rnam thar gyis// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye ba rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du ma byon 'byung ba dang*// 'das dang da ltar bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas khams rgyud gcig pa'i ngang*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kha lo sgyur ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rga shi rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos kun rtog pa zhi ba yi// zab pa dang ni rgya che'i bdag /mdo dang rgyud dang rtog pa las// byang chub sems 'di bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skye dbang mtshungs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten 'brel dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems can smin par byed pa dang*// sangs rgyas zhing sbyong phrin las dag /de nyid mtshungs pa gcig pa'i sku// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'dzin pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so// bsam gtan gnas su bde ba'i stan la ni// gnas nas dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// dmigs te sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin 'khrigs pa// dang por spro tshogs blo ldan gyis bya zhingakyis dge ba mdzad rnams la// de dag kun la rjes su yi rang zhing*// byang chub bla med gnas su bsngo bar bgyi// sems kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs// snying rje dam pa mi zad pa yi thabs// rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi// bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*// sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi// dngos rnams ma lus ye shes ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// 'ching ba mtha' dag gnas las grol 'gyur zhing*// snying rje mchog gis bsgrub pa'i dpal dang ldan// rab dga' la sogs sa la nges bzhugs pa'i// brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la bdag skyabs mchi// bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas// sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag don// lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi// sems ni dam pa byang chub mchog tu bskyed// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi lam gcig po// sbyin pa la sogs dkar po'i yon tan bcu// rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos// yang dag tu ni rnam par gnas par bgyi// snying rjes 'jig rten sems can ma lus pa// lta bas bcings pa du ma dmigs nas ni// yang dag byang chub sems ni mnyam med pa// sngags pas rig pa 'di ni bsam par bya// ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste// de bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med// rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos po ni// ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol// tha dad dmigs pa'i 'du shes log pa yi// dri ma'i dra ba rnams ni legs bsal nas// rtog pa ma lus ye shes rgyal ba yi// snang stong dri med ngang las 'di don brjod// oṃ swa £É wa shud ZÉཿ

sarba Zrmāḥ sra £É wa shuKོ±haṃ// oṃ badz+ra swa £É wa shud ZÉཿ sarba Zrmāḥ swa £É wa shuKོ ±haṃ// oṃ shū ‚ tā dzñā na badz+ra sra £É wa ā/ ko±haṃ// de ltar ma lus 'dod pa spangs pa yis// bdag nyid dam ni gzhan dag rang rig nyid// gzugs ni lhar gyur pa la yang dag mchod// dam tshig 'di ni bde gshegs rnams kyis gnang*// rjes su mthun par 'gro ba'i don rnams dang*// ma lus rgyal ba mchod par yongs su brtags// lus la sogs pa'i las rnams de dang ni// rtag tu legs par mnyam par gzhag bya ste// rnam pa 'di 'dra'i sems dang lus dang ni// ngag gi las rnams ci yang rung ba dag /phyag rgya dang ni sngags kyi rnam pa ru// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis de gsungs so// de bas lus sogs dge dang mi dge ba'i// rnam pa'i las rnams sems kyi dbang las gsungs// de ltar rtog pa ma lus spangs pa yi// sems ni nag po'i las su ga la 'gyur// dngos po gcig la'ang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i// kun tu rtog pas bsags pa'i rnam pa las// sdug bsngal bde dang grol ba skyed byed pa'i// las kyi khyad par mang po 'byung bar 'gyur// 'dir ni rab tu mi gnas ye shes sku// 'khor ba dag cing rnam par grol ba'i thugs// byams mgon rdo rje de yang de ltar snang*// tshul 'di rtogs dka' phan pa sgrub pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi don 'byung ba rdo rje'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dus pa chen po'i le'u/༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog gi dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsum ston pa snang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dbang phyug chen po ye shes kyi// 'byung ba sku ni 'byung las gyur// rten 'brel snang ba gsal bar 'char// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcan 'dzin rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer phreng ba 'khrigs pa ltar snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sna tshogs 'od ni bkye ba yang*// rang rig bsam gtan las byung ba// byang chub don gyi rgyu chen por// don 'byung tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rtsi sman rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kun nas 'od zer don chen byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sku yi tshul gyur pa// rdo rje skyil krung gnas pa yi// sna tshogs rin chen brgyan pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu skar rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs pa dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsung gi dbyangs snyan ma lus pa// brjod pa 'gag med rang byung bas// 'di nyid gsang ba don sdud pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bla med sman pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi mchod rten dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dbyings dang ye shes tshul gcig tu// mi gnas ldog pa med pa yi// byang chub sems kyi ngang gnas pas// bla med ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams glang po ye shes thogs pa med pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje'i ngang*// ro mnyam ye shes mtshungs med pa// gcig dang du ma las grol phyir// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rtog pa gcod par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshe la dbang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// de bzhin gshegs pa kun 'dus pa'i// yon tan tshad med phreng ba can// dpag med rin chen gter 'chang mdzad// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par grags pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas kun gyi las la dbang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi semasin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po las// bsrubs pas bdud rtsi'i zhun ma ni// 'chi med 'gro ba tshim byed pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi mdzod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab la dbang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// srid pa'i 'jig rten thams cad du// gang dang gang du skyes pa rnams// sems can 'dul ba'i thabs tshul gyis// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros bzang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhing khams kun tu sa g.yo zhing*// 'od dang sgra dang me tog char// dad ldan tshul dang lhan cig tu// dgongs pa ye shes tshul bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dbang mtshungs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mos pa sgyur ba la dbang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dran dang 'dun dang mos pa dang*// ye shes thogs med dbang phyug ces// rtog pa yong bral mi phyed pa// dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa rdo rje'i sde sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam la dbang ba sangs rgyas 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// zhing khams gcig nas gcig tu bgrod pa dang*// 'jug par sgyur ba'i tshul ni mi zad pa// bla med 'phen pa rnam dag khyad par 'phags// ye shes dri med tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab brtsegs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes la dbang ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ye shes gang du ye shes kun// 'du ba rgya mtsho'i chu bran bzhin// sdud pa yongs su dag pa nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa legs par gnas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la dbang ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te// byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// bden pa bzhi dang gnyis dag gis// yongs su sdud pa bcu gnyis dang*// bcu drug rnam dbye chos 'byung ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa blo dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du sbyangs pa'i yon tan ni// bcu gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa yi// sbyor tshul ye shes gsang ba yashes rab yongs grol skye// de nyid byang chub dgra bcom 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas gos pa med pa'i tshul rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thim pa rdo rje ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lan tshwa chu la thim pa ltar// 'dres pas so sor dmigs pa bral// gcig tu byed pa'i bsam gtan mchog

/de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs pa dang bzhud pa dmigs pa med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsaganas pa// mtshan med spros pa med pa yi// rdo rje glu yis yongs bskul ba'i// lha mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig rol// sems dpa' gsum dang ldan pa yi// sbyor ba rang gzugs rgyu mthun pa// dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas pa yi// gtso bo sangs rgyas bdag po'i sku// rig ma mngon par bsngags pas ni// gnas bzhi rnams su lha mo bzhi// rtag Vོ rdo rje mnyam sbyar ba'i// gsang sngags rab tu bsam pa nyid// 'od zer lnga ni 'bar ba yi// sbyor ba rdo rje 'dzin gyis bsam// rang lus ngag sems rdo rje la// bde ba phab pas bde thob 'gyur// bsrub dang srub pa'i tshul gyis ni// ye shes yang dag bskyed pa yi// 'byung gnas dbu ma'i rtse ru gzung*// rnam par bzlog cing drangs pa yis// rlung dang rnam shes bde chen du// ro gcig rtog pa nub pa yi// khyab pas rlung dang dbyer med par// gnas sogs rnams su rgyas byed pa'i// kun tu 'phel ba'i stobs rgyas pa'i// dbang bskur dam pa gnas par byed// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dus pa chen po'i le'u ste zhe gcig pa'o// // sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu mi gnas pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par shes pa'i rtse mo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid ni// ngo bo nyid med spros las dben// mnyam pa nyid la rtog mi mnga'// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tog gi 'od sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i 'dren pa gcig pu pa ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po'i chos las 'das pa gang*// dngos med nam mkha' dag pa yi// ye shes 'di ni rmad po che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'dren dge ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// brtags pa rtog pa rab zhi ba// yul snang rnam rig ma grub pas// lugs 'byung dag pa'i nam mkha' nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dpal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nang stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// phyi nang tha dad mi gnas pa// sems de gang du'ang gnas med de// mdor na dngos med rang bzhin can// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skyes mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yang dag bsdus pa'i chos can la// ma grub pa yi ngang la gnas// de su med pa'i 'od gsal ba// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa klus sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// ye shes sgron me 'bar ba ni// mi zad du ma ro gcig pa'i// dran pas stong pa bde ba nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa'i tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du bsgom du med pa'i dngos// bsgom pa tsam du 'dzin med de// mtha' las grol ba mi gnas pa// gsang ba tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dpal brgyan pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dus byas stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rang rig las ni byang chub 'gyur// rtog pas stong pa'i chos nyid las/ ba las 'das pa nyid// lung du bstan pa'i phyogs las ni// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od 'phro sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// brjod pas brtags pa rang stong pa// lung ma bstan las 'das pa'i dngos// mi phyed brjod bral ye shes che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs byin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// byang chub sems la rgyu med phyir// thog mtha' stong pa chos kyi dbyings// ye shes lugs las bzlog par 'char// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dor ba med pa stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos gang spang bar bya ba dang*// brten bya tha dad med par ni// len pa med par rang grol du// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer sna tshogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya ba rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gdod nas zhi ba'i chos nyid la// ma skyes skye med dag pa'i sems// 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag

/byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dpa' bo chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /kun tu bzang po bde ba che// mi zad lhun gyis grub pa'i don// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pa V'i gnas dpal phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'ong ba med cing 'gro ba med// nyi tshe'i stong nyid las 'das shing*// rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog rgyas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// dus gsum rjes su mi dmigs pas// thog med ye shes bstan pa nyid// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal stobs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos po med pa stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dngos po rtag pa'i chos nyid med// mi rtag 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid can// stong nyid nam mkha'i chos nyid de// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// lta ba ma yin mi gnas pa// kun gzhi dag pa'i snying po nyid// zab cing phra ba brten gyur pas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mchog rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin snod bcud rnams// thams cad bdag med ngo bo nyid// stong pa nyid du'ang mi gnas pa'i// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// stong pa nyid du mi bsam zhing*// stong min bar yang bsgom pa min// de nyid byang chub dam pa'i gzhi// byang chub sems zhes brjod pa yin// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsung ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rab tu mi gnas pa'i don bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu gnyis pa'o//

gsang ba yongs su mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas su bstan pa'i le'u/༈ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin// dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'khor lo'i gtsos// tshangs dbyangs rdo rje'i nga ro yis// chos 'byung rol pa ston par mdzad// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skar mkhan thams cad kyi bdag rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sa bon dang ni myu gu'i bar// rim gyis bskyed pa yongs dag pa// de nyid 'bras bu ro 'byin pa'i// thabs tshul 'di ni dag pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid phung po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srog rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rnam dag zhi ba'i chos nyid ni// btags pa'i gnas las rnam grol ba// ye shes rgyal ba kun khyab pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems can rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tingi gso ba skyes bu rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// btags pa'i yid dpyod ma zhugs pa'i// snang las ma nges grol 'gyur zhing*// sgrib med rang gsal mthong ba ni// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag rgyas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gang zag rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// yul rkyen rdzas las grol ba yi// the tsom rnam bral sgro 'dogs chod// rigs med phyir na ye shes che// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor shes rab mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shed bu rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// khams rgyud dag pa'i sa gnas pas// sa rnams bgrod pa go 'phang mchog

/rtse gcig rang byung rang grol bas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid tshim mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shed las skyes rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs// dag pa ye shes bdag med pa// gnyis med mnyam pa rnam rgyal bas// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab byin pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byed pa po rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// thos bsam sgom pa'i yul min zhing*// gsang ba'i shes rab ral gris ni// log lta'i phung pa// sbrul mdud lta bur bcings las 'da'// de nyid ye shes tshul bstan pa// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gtso bo ye shes mthong ba po rnam par dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// stobs ldan skyes bu mchog gis ni// gang du rtsal gyi rten mthong bas// shugs kyis 'gro ba mda' bzhin no// ye shes tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi slong ba po rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gang du spong ba sor zhugs shing*// rang bzhin dag pa'i ngo bo nyid// yongs su shes na rnam grol gyis// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'jig rten dag pa rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// dbang po'i gnas las lhag pa'i stobs// stong gsum chos kyi dpal ldan pas// ye shes char 'bebs ston pa po// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po shugs 'chang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las sna tshogs ston pa rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// gsang ba'i ye shes bsam mi khyab// nam mkha'i gzugs su yongs bzhugs pa// 'dus pa bla med dgyes par rol// de nyid tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal sku'i ting nge 'dzin rdo rje gsang ba la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so// sems kyi gsang ba dag pa ste// sems kyi las ni yongs dag pas// sems can khams dang mthun par 'jug

/bsam gyis mi khyab bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de nas gsang ba 'dzin pa pos// thub pa don gyi ye shes can// sku bzhi ye shes rab rdzogs pa'i// de bzhin nyid 'di gsung bar mdzad// gang du gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du ma 'byung ba rnams ni ye shes dgos pa chen pos khyab cing gnyis su med pa'i mnyam pa nyid bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob la/ des chos thams cad yongs su dag cing phyin ci ma log par khong du chud pas gnas par byed do// 'jig rten gyi lha chen po tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ gu lang dang*/ drag po'i rigs su gyur pa rnams kyis kyang yang dag par chos 'di la bsrung ba'i phyir de 'dzin pa dag la mchod cing bsten par byed do// 'di ni rgyun du bzhugs pa'i 'byung gnas so// phyir mi 'ong ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas so// lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas so// dgra bcom pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas so// 'phags pa rang rgyal ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas so// byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung gnas so// byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas so// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin par rig par bya'o// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla na med par rig par bya'o// dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa yang 'di las byung bar rig par bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni gsang ba chen po ye shes kun tu 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig par gnas pa nyid do// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa rnal 'byor chen po gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba las gsang ba yongs su mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas su bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o//

//de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas gsang ba chen po thun mong ma yin pa zhes pa'i le'u/༈ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te thog mar byung ba dang bar du da ltar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la gnas pa'i don dang*/ tha mar phyi ma'i dus na nges par 'byung ba'i gsang chen nges par 'pho ba'i tshul gyi rnam grangs du ma nga yis bshad par bya yis/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i gnas dang dus dang chos kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa du ma 'byung ba nges par zung cig 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba// bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la// 'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon 'byung ba// de tshe sems can thams cad ni// shin tu srog gcod brtson par 'gyur// bskal pa drug 'dzin zhes bya la// sangs rgyas zla ba mi 'khrugs pas// thams cad zhe sdang can gyur la// srog gcod pa la brtsams pa yi// dam chos dgongs te bshad pa la// slob dpon chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// dge slong nag po gtum zhes pa//mi bskyod rdo rje can gyis ni// zhe sdang rigs can 'dul bar mdzad// srog chags gsad par gyis zhes pa// khams gsum sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du// 'khor ba'i rnam rtog bsad na ni// de ni mi bskyod zhing du skye// rdo rje can gyi sdom pa las// zhe sdang rigs kyi dam tshig yin// 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba'i// bdag nyid chen po rtog pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la// 'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba// de tshe sems can thams cad ni// rnam par shes pa gti mug pas// ma byin len la brtson par 'gyur// bskal pa gzung dka' zhes bya la// de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi mchog /seng ge 'od kyi rgyal po la// bstan pa'i dam tshig gnas pa'i tshe// thamags te// sangs rgyas gar mkhan gar mdzad pas// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin gyis ni// gti mug rigs can 'dul bar mdzad// khyod kyis ma byin longs zhes pa// chos rnams rmi lam lta bu las// 'phags pa'i nor rnams blangs nas ni// stug po bkod pa'i zhing du skye// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sdom pa las// gti mug rigs kyi dam tshig yin/

VV byung ba'i// bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la// 'gro ba'i tshul ni sngon byung ba// de tshe sems can thams cad ni// shin tu le lo'i dbang gyur cing// brdzun du smra ba dga' bar 'gyur// bskal pa gzi chen snang ba'i dus// bde gshegs rnga sgra'i rgyal po zhes// sangs rgyas de yi bstan pa la// 'gro rnams shin tu phrag dog can// de la brdzun tshig gis grol zhes// rgyal bas dgongs te bstan pa la// slob dpon rta mchog ces bya bas// dge bsnyen zla ba zhes bya la// gsung rab don rjes bstan pa las// shin tu 'khrul bas gnas par 'gyur// ji bzhin sgra ru rnam da pas// drag byed 'khrul pa can zhes pa// chung ma nyi shu'i tshogs dang bcas// thams cad dbang sgyur bdud kyi lha// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed gnas su skyes// de ltar rdo rje can gzigs te// sangs rgyas gar mkhan gar mdzad pas// gdon mi za ba'i phrin las kyi// phrag dog rigs can 'dul bar mdzad// khyod kyis brdzun du smros zhes pa// chos rnams dri za'i grong khyer las// thams cad brdzun pa slu ba'i tshig /sgyu ma lta bur bsgrags nas kyang// kun rdzob ོda pa'i gnas bstan pa// 'brug sgra can gyi zhing du 'gro// las kyi rigs kyi sdom pa las// phrag dog rdo rje'i dam tshig bstastan pa de la gnas pa'i tshe// phal cher nga rgyal gyis non cing*// ngag ma bsdams pas gnas par gyur// rtsub pa'i tshig rnams smras pa yi// des ni thar pa thob ces pa// rgyal bas dgongs te gsungs pa la// slob dpon nyi ma'i dpal zhes pas// dge slong 'byor pa can zhes la// bka' yi dgongs pa bstan pa las// gsang ba'i don la rnam 'khrul*// lang ka pu ri'i rgyal por gyur// de ltar rdo rje can gzigs te// sangs rgyas gar mkhan gar mdzad pas// gsang chen rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// dug lnga'i rang bzhin gyis bsdus btul// nyon mongs ma spangs lam 'gyur zhes// chags sdang rang bzhin shes nas kyang*// dug gsum ye shes gyur pa ni// gsang ba rdo rje theg pa'i lam// rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing du skye// bla na med pa'i sdom pa las// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam tshig yin// dug lnga'i rang bzhin gyis bsdus btul// zhe sdang can la khyab 'jug dang*// gti mug can la tshangs pa dang*// 'dod chags dbang phyug chen po dang*// phrag dog dga' rab dbang phyug dang*// nga rgyal can ni brgya byin gyi// rigs dang mthun pa'i char bsgyur nas// sems can log pa'i lam du btsud// rang gi ོda yul mi 'da'i phyir// de la bar chad sna tshogs pas// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul// de ltar rdo rje can gzigs te// sangs rgyas gar mkhan gar mdzad pas// lha rnams gdul bar mdzad nas ni// gsang ba'i ye shes ston par byed// de ltar gdul bya gang dang gang gi don du dgongs te gsungs pa rnam par nges pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu gsang ba nges pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la bka' stsal pa// gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni gsang ba mchog tu mi 'gyur pa rdo rje btsun mo'i £ ga zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling gru gsum chos kyi 'byung gnas so// 'di ni mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi zhing khams kyi snying por gyur pa'o// dus phun sum tshogs pa ste dus rnams kyi snyigs ma la bab pa thog ma dang dbus dang tha ma rnam par dag pa ste gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul lo/

/'chad pa po ni ston pa ste/ 'dir da mi zad pa'i don la rab tu dgongs pa dag go /de nas gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bshad par bya'o// 'di lta ste 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ni rgyal po zas gtsang mar gyur to// 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug dbyangs ni lha mo chen mo sgyu 'phrul zhes bya bar gyur to// lha mo dpal gyi lu gu rgyud ma ni grags 'dzin mar gyur to// rdo rje sems dpa' ni sgra gcan 'dzin to// byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa kun tu gcod pa ni shā ri'i bur gyur pa'o// kun tu bzang po ni gnas brtan kun dga' bor gyur to// kun tu bzang po rnam par rol pa'i sku can ni maung gal gyi bur gyur pa'o// lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni gnas brtan lha sbyin no// tshangs pa chen po ni byang chub sems dpa'i snang ba'i 'od du gyur pa'o// dpal rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni yang dag par rdzogs te// gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ni phyag na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa can gyi kun dga' bor gyur to// kun tu bzang po ni maung gal gyi bu'o// sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba ni kun shes kauṇ+ḍi ‚V grags mchog ma'o// sgrol ma ni sna tshogs 'od 'chang mar gyur to// de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa ni sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa sman gyi bla dri ma med pa baiḍū4 'od du gyur to// rnam par snang byed de bzhin gshegs pa ni sangs rgyas stobs mchog seng ge thugs rjes 'od kyi snang ba mi zad par gyur to// 'od dpag tu med pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa paV'i 'od 'phro mi zad par gyur to// gdon mi za ba grub pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra'i rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur to// rin chen 'byung ldan ni de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog dpal rin chen 'od 'phro ba zhes bya bar gyur to// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' ni de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ye shes kun tu bzang po zhes bya bar gyur te// de ni gzhan yin par mi blta ste da ltar nga nyid yin no// gzhan yang rab tu bshad par bya ste/

khro bo'i rgyal po bcu rnams la 'di lta ste/ dpal gshin rje mthar byed ni de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas su gyur// bgegs mthar byed ni de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar gyur/ dpal rta mgrin ni rin chen 'od 'phro zhes bya bar gyur/ shes rab mthar byed ni sangs rgyas mya ngan med dpal zhes bya bar gyur/ khro bo mi g.yo ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa paVོ dam pa'i dpal zhes bya bar gyur/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'i dpal zhes bya bar gyur/ dbyug sngon can ni de bzhin gshegs pa gdugs dam par gyur/ khro bo stobs po che ni de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po glang po dam pa'i dpal zhes bya bar gyur/ khro bo gnod mdzes rgyal po ni sangs rgyas paV ོdam pa'i dpal zhes bya bar gyur/ khro bo gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ba dam pa'i zhes bya bar gyur to// bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong 'jig rten du mngon par 'byung ba la 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya dang gsang ba 'dzin pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chenan par byang chub pa 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid du gnas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs bdag nyid du gcig pa'i sku'o// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs pa ta la'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can ni mya ngan med pa'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa mar me can ni tsū ta'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel ni £ tha pa'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub ni ka ra tsa pa'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung ni par ka ti pa'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa ni par ti pa'i shing gi drung du'o// de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa ni nā ga ke sa ra'i shing gi drung du'o// de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dus gsum du 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du phyogs brgyad kyi zhing khams na zhugs shing yongs su skyong bar mdzad de/
